title: Ma bakudumis abantu

lines.translation: Praise & honour be to You, Lord, Father!
You ‘ve got the whole world in Your hands, Lord, Father
Praise & honour be to You, Son, Redeemer!
Forgiveness is attainable through You, Son, Redeemer
Praise & honour be to You, Holy Spirit!
You sanctify believers, You are holy
Glory & honour belongs to You
Our One, triune God
All of creation belongs to You
Our One, triune God

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ma bakudumis’abantu,
Wena, Thixo Bawo!
Praise & honour be to You, Lord, Father!
Ziya lawulwa iinto zonke
Nguwe, Thixo Bawo.
You ‘ve got the whole world in Your hands, Lord, Father

VERSE 2
Ma bakudumis’abantu,
Nyana, Mukhululi!
Praise & honour be to You, Son, Redeemer!
Bazuziswa uxolelo
Ngawe Mukhululi.
Forgiveness is attainable through You, Son, Redeemer

VERSE 3
Ma bakudumis’abantu,
Moya oyiNgcwele!
Praise & honour be to You, Holy Spirit!
Wenza ngcwele amakholwa,
Wena uyingcwele.
You sanctify believers, You are holy

VERSE 4
Bubobakho ubukhulu,
Glory & honour belongs to You
Thixo wethu umnye;
Our One, triune God
Zizezakho iinto zonke,
All of creation belongs to You
Thixo wethu umnye.
Our One, triune God
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Dumisani uYehova

lines.primary: Cast Your care on Jesus Today

lines.translation: Jesus is very near
Jesus is very near

lines.primary: He has risen from the dead

lines.translation: He is Lord
That Jesus Christ

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Dumisani uYehova
Ezulwini lonke;
Dumisani uYehova
Emhlabeni wonke.

VERSE 2
Nina niziithunywa zaKhe,
Dumisani Yena;
Nani bemikhosi yaKhe,
Dumisani Yena.

VERSE 3
Wena langa, nawe nyanga,
Dumisani Yena;
Nani nina zinkwenkwezi,
Dumisani Yena.

VERSE 4
Wena mlilo, nawe ngqele,
Dumisani Yena;
Wena ngqweqwe, nawe nkungu,
Dumisani Yena.

VERSE 5
Wena moya ogqumayo,
Mudumise Yena;
Nawe yenz’ imvumo yaKhe
Aph’ uviwa khona.

VERSE 6
Nina niziinkosi nonke,
Dumisani Yena;
Nani nina bantu nonke,
Dumisani Yena.

VERSE 7
Nina nonke madodana,
Dumisani Yena;
Nani niziintombazana,
Dumisani Yena.

VERSE 8
Nani bantu abadala,
Dumisani Yena;
Nani niziintsapho, nonke,
Dumisani Yena.

VERSE 9
Cast Your care on Jesus Today
Leave Your worry and fear,
Burdens are lifted at calvary
Jesus is very near

VERSE 10
Burdens are lifted at (Calvary X3)
Burdens are lifted at Calvary
Jesus is very near

VERSE 11
Ndiza kudumisa X3
Eyesu umsidinsi wam
Ndiza kudumisa X3
Ngoba ulungile

VERSE 12
Sithi helele X3
Ngenxa yobubele

VERSE 13
He is Lord x2
He has risen from the dead
And He is Lord
Every knee shall bow
He is Lord
Every tongue confess
That Jesus Christ
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ma zith iingqondo zethu

lines.translation: Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:
For his mercies endure forever
Let us blaze His name abroad
For his mercies endure forever
He, with all-commanding Might,
Filled the new-made world with light:
For his mercies endure forever
He feeds all things,
His full hand supplies all needs:
For his mercies endure forever
Even in times of pain
His eye watches over us
For his mercies endure forever
Among all other gods
There is none like Him
For his mercies endure forever

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ma zith' iingqondo zethu,
Let us with a gladsome mind
Zimbonge uYehova;
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:
Kuba iinceba zaKhe,
Zimi ngonaphakade.
For his mercies endure forever

VERSE 2
Ma sithi kulo lonke,
Sazis' igama laKhe;
Let us blaze His name abroad
Kuba iinceba zaKhe,
Zimi ngonaphakade.
For his mercies endure forever

VERSE 3
Ngawo amandla aKhe,
He, with all-commanding Might,
Ukhanyisel' ilizwe;
Filled the new-made world with light:
Kuba iinceba Khe,
Zimi ngonaphakade.
For his mercies endure forever

VERSE 4
Wondla izinto zonke,
He feeds all things,
Ngaso isandla saKhe;
His full hand supplies all needs:
Kuba iinceba zaKhe,
Zimi ngonaphakade.
For his mercies endure forever

VERSE 5
Ezintsizini zethu,
Even in times of pain
Iliso liya bona;
His eye watches over us
Kuba iinceba zaKhe,
Zimi ngonaphakade.
For his mercies endure forever

VERSE 6
Kubo bonke oothixo,
Among all other gods
Akukho onje ngaYe;
There is none like Him
Kuba iinceba zaKhe,
Zimi ngonaphakade.
For his mercies endure forever
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bathandi benKosi, yizani
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bathandi benKosi, yizani,
Nazise olwenu uvuyo,
Ngomanyo lwetsholo vumani,
Endlwini yenKos’ enikuyo.
Bangaala abangamaziyo
Owethu uThixo omkhulu;
Vumani ngelingapheliyo,
Lusapho lwenKosi yezulu.

VERSE 2
UThixo ohleli phezulu,
Epheth’ ubukhos’ emhlabeni,
Ethetha nolwandl’ olukhulu,
Esithi kumaza “Zolani.”
Ngowethu loo Thixo unjalo,
UBawo othando lukhulu;
Wothum’ izithunywa kwa ngalo,
Ukuza kusisa phezulu.

VERSE 3
Sobonana naYe ngobuso,
Kwelo zwe lingenas’ isoono,
Sosela kungekho ivuso,
Sisele umthombo wobomi.
Naxa singekayi phezulu,
Singe sinovuyo kwa futhi,
Kwa ngenxa yenyhweba enkulu
Eyoda ifike nakuthi.

VERSE 4
Usapho lofefe kwa lapha,
Luse lufumen’ ingcwaliso;
Umfuno wezulu ulapha,
Uzuz’ emhlaben’ intlumiso.
Ma zom’ iinyembezi kwa ngawo,
Sicande ilizwe loBawo,
Sisiya kwelihle phezulu.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bulelani kuYehova

lines.translation: Give thanks to the Lord
For He is good
For His mercy
Endures forever
Let all the congregation of Israel say
His mercy endures forever
I prayed to the Lord
I was in distress
The Lord answered and rescued me
The Lord is for me
I shall not fear
What can mere mortals do to me?
The Lord is for me
He will help me
I will triumph over those who hate me
To trust in the Lord
And find refuge in Him
Is the right thing to do
Than to trust humankind
My salvation is in You Lord
Bless me
My rest is in You Lord
Bless me kindly.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bulelani kuYehova,
Give thanks to the Lord
Kuba elungile;
For He is good
Kuba ububele baKhe,
For His mercy
Bubobaphakade.
Endures forever

VERSE 2
M’ atsho amaSirayeli,
Iindlu zawo zonke,
Let all the congregation of Israel say
Athi ububele baKhe
Bubobaphakade
His mercy endures forever

VERSE 3
Ndamemeza kuYehova,
I prayed to the Lord
Ndandisengxingweni
I was in distress
Wandinceda wandibeka
Endawen’ ebanzi
The Lord answered and rescued me

VERSE 4
Ingecala lam iNkosi,
The Lord is for me
Andisokoyika
I shall not fear
Ingasuka ithi ni na
Lento umntu kumi?
What can mere mortals do to me?

VERSE 5
Ingecala lam iNkosi,
The Lord is for me
Iyakundinceda
He will help me
Indincede ngokumnandi
Kwabandithiyayo
I will triumph over those who hate me

VERSE 6
Ukuthemba uYehova,
To trust in the Lord
Nokuphepha ngaYe
And find refuge in Him
Kuko okulungileyo
Is the right thing to do
Kungathenjwa bantu
Than to trust humankind

VERSE 7
Ma ndisinde ngaWe Nkosi,
My salvation is in You Lord
Undisikelele;
Bless me
Mandiphumle ngaWe Nkosi:
My rest is in You Lord
Undithamsanqele.
Bless me kindly.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, unamandla onke

lines.translation: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty
You alone are God, the Almighty King
Holy, holy, holy, You are Merciful
You are our Father, You are Jehovah
Holy, holy, holy, Creator, Ancient of Days
Who was, is, and evermore shall be
You are hidden from our eyes, You are incomprehensible
God in Three Persons, the King all nations praise
Holy, holy, holy, all saints adore You
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea
Cherubim & seraphim fall down before You
Your glory always makes them radiate
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty
All of creation worship and adore You
Holy, holy, holy, You are Merciful
God in Three Persons, blessed Trinity

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, unamandla onke,
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty
UnguThixo wedwa, uyiNkosi yaphezulu;
You alone are God, the Almighty King
Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, unenceba yonke,
Holy, holy, holy, You are Merciful
UnguBawo wethu Wena, unguy’ uYehova.
You are our Father, You are Jehovah

VERSE 2
Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, Mdali wamanyange,
Holy, holy, holy, Creator, Ancient of Days
Usahleli, wohlal’ ukho, ngamaxesha onke;
Who was, is, and evermore shall be
Usithele thina, akunakwaziwa,
You are hidden from our eyes, You are incomprehensible
Ubathathu umnye, Wena, Nkos’ edunyiswayo.
God in Three Persons, the King all nations praise

VERSE 3
Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, amabandla aKho
Holy, holy, holy, all saints adore You
Ayakudumisa Wena, awe phambi kwaKho;
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea
Ziya kuzukisa neengelosi zaKho,
Cherubim & seraphim fall down before You
Ezihlala zikhanyiswa kukukhanya kwaKho.
Your glory always makes them radiate

VERSE 4
Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, unamandla onke,
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty
Udunyiswa, uzukiswa, zizidalwa zonke;
All of creation worship and adore You
Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, unofefe lonke
Holy, holy, holy, You are Merciful
UnguThixo umnye Wena, ubathathu umnye.
God in Three Persons, blessed Trinity
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Thixo akunangqaleko

lines.translation: You are everywhere, at all times
God, we don’t know Your beginning nor Your ending
You have lived long before everything was created
Up with the stars, You are live in Heaven
You will reign eternally
You will live eternally
Everything will come to an end

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thixo akunangqaleko,
Thixo akunangqibeko;
Ukho eendaweni zonke,
You are everywhere, at all times
Ukho ngamaxesha onke.
God, we don’t know Your beginning nor Your ending

VERSE 2
Phaya ezinkwenkwezini,
Ukho, Wena, ezulwini;
Wab’ ukade sel’ ukhona,
You have lived long before everything was created
Xa zingekabikho zona.
Up with the stars, You are live in Heaven

VERSE 3
Zoda zigqibeke zonke,
Kuthi tshabalala konke;
You will reign eternally
Ube Wena ungapheli,
You will live eternally
Ube Wena usahleli.
Everything will come to an end
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Wazidala iinto zonke

lines.translation: You alone God, created all things
No human being assisted You
The mountains we see
Were crafted by You
They cannot be moved
You set their foundation
The water we drink, You have supplied
The food we eat, You have provided
You created humans in Your image
You gave them everything, and it was all good
The enemy came and robbed them
They loathed You, and listened to him
You responded with grace in order to save them
You gave Your one and only Son to die for them

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Wazidala iinto zonke,
Wena Thixo wedwa;
You alone God, created all things
Akwancedwa nangubani,
Ukuzenza kwaKho.
No human being assisted You

VERSE 2
Ezi ntaba ezimiyo,
The mountains we see
Zidaliwe nguWe;
Were crafted by You
Zimi ziqinile zona,
They cannot be moved
Ngokusekwa nguWe.
You set their foundation

VERSE 3
Nala manzi aselwayo,
Siwanikwe nguWe;
The water we drink, You have supplied
Noku kutya sikutyayo,
Sikuphiwe nguWe.
The food we eat, You have provided

VERSE 4
Wabadal’ abantu Wena,
Ngokufana naWe;
You created humans in Your image
Wabanika iinto zonke,
Bafanelwa zizo.
You gave them everything, and it was all good

VERSE 5
Kwakufik’ utshaba lwabo,
Lwabahlutha zona;
The enemy came and robbed them
Bakudela Wena Thixo,
Beva izwi lalo.
They loathed You, and listened to him

VERSE 6
Wath’ ukuze basindiswe,
Wenza ngezibele;
You responded with grace in order to save them
Wabanik’ uNyana waKho,
Eze kubafela.
You gave Your one and only Son to die for them
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Thixo, ulilanga lethu

lines.translation: God, You are the Sun to us
You shine Your Light over us
We can clearly see where we are headed
God, You are our Shield
Our enemies do not terrify us
You conquer our battles
You are our Source of Joy
You will be gracious unto us
You will sanctify us
You will lavish those who worship You
With countless blessings
Titanic blessings
Devine blessings
For the one who puts their trust in You
Because You love them dearly

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thixo, ulilanga lethu,
God, You are the Sun to us
Uyakhanya phezu kwethu;
You shine Your Light over us
Umphefumlo ungabona,
Apho uhambela khona.
We can clearly see where we are headed

VERSE 2
Thixo, ulikhaka lethu,
God, You are our Shield
Asoyik’ iintshaba zethu;
Our enemies do not terrify us
Zonke ziyasongwa nguWe,
You conquer our battles
Soza ngokonwaba kuWe.
You are our Source of Joy

VERSE 3
Wosiphatha ngobubele,
You will be gracious unto us
Wosinika ubungcwele;
You will sanctify us
Wopha abakukhonzayo,
You will lavish those who worship You
Okuthamsanqelekayo.
With countless blessings

VERSE 4
Ithamsanqa elikhulu,
Titanic blessings
Ithamsanqa elezulu;
Devine blessings
Likho kothembayo kuWe,
For the one who puts their trust in You
Ngokuba ethandwa nguWe.
Because You love them dearly
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Undiphengulule, Nkosi

lines.translation: Yo have examined me O God, You know my every thought
My coming and going, and my final rest
Where will I go to flee from Your Spirit?
Where will I go to get away from Your presence?
If I go to heaven, You are there
I can even go down to Hades, You are there
I can ride the wings of the morning
And dwell by the farthest oceans
Even there, Your hand will guide me
And Your Mighty Hand will support me
I may declare: “The darkness will hide me”
To You, the night shines as bright as the day

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Undiphengulule, Nkosi,
Uyazaz’ iingcinga zami;
Yo have examined me O God, You know my every thought
Ukugqala ukuhamba,
Nako ukulala kwami.
My coming and going, and my final rest

VERSE 2
Ndosuka ndiye phi na,
Ukupheph’ uMoya waKho?
Where will I go to flee from Your Spirit?
Ndakubalekela phi na,
Ukusab’ ubuso baKho?
Where will I go to get away from Your presence?

VERSE 3
Ndingesuka ndinyukele
Ezulwini, ukho apho;
If I go to heaven, You are there
Ndingade ndizandlalele
Ehadesi, ukho apho.
I can even go down to Hades, You are there

VERSE 4
Ndingesuka ndithabathe
Amaphiko awo umso;
I can ride the wings of the morning
Ndiye kuma kuz’ iindawo
Zokuphela kwal’ ulwandle.
And dwell by the farthest oceans

VERSE 5
Kwanalaph’ isandla saKho
Siya kundikhapha sona;
Even there, Your hand will guide me
Say’ esokunene saKho,
Siyakundibamba khona.
And Your Mighty Hand will support me

VERSE 6
Ndingesuka ndithi: “Bona
Ubumnyama bondifihla”;
I may declare: “The darkness will hide me”
Bungesuka nobusuku
Se bukhanya nje ngemini.
To You, the night shines as bright as the day
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ozimela ethunzini
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ozimela ethunzini
Lonamandla onke;
Uzifaka enqabeni,
Yongaphezu konke.

VERSE 2
Aziphikw’ iingozi zikho
Apha emhlabeni;
Nezingabonwayo zikho,
Ezisemnyameni.

VERSE 3
Kuzo zonke yena lowo
Ukhuselwa futhi;
NguYehova obonayo,
Enofefe kuthi.

VERSE 4
Akoyiki olo tolo
Lubalek’ emini;
Nazo zonke izothuso,
Azingemfumani.

VERSE 5
Ingonyama, kwa neramba
Uya zinyathela;
Yonke imibathalala,
Iya kumdedela.

VERSE 6
Uyaluswa ziingelosi,
Ugciniwe zizo;
Akangeze akhubeke,
Ukhangelwe zizo.

VERSE 7
Wokhuselwa ngezibele,
Entlalweni yakhe;
Wokusindiswa, anqatyiswe,
Bonk’ ubomi bakhe.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ulihlathi leth uThixo

lines.translation: God is our refuge
He is our strength
He is always ready to help in times of trouble
So we will not fear
Even if earthquakes come
And the mountains crumble into the sea
Let the oceans roar and foam
Let the mountains tremble as the waters surge
There is a river that brings joy to the city of God
The sacred home of the Most High
God Himself lives in that city
It cannot be destroyed
God will protect it at the break of day
The nations are in chaos and kingdoms crumble
God thunders
And the earth melts
The Lord of hosts is our God
He is our fortress, He is Almighty
We will find refuge in Him

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ulihlathi leth’ uThixo,
God is our refuge
Ungamandla ethu Yena;
He is our strength
Ekuxakekeni konke,
Uluncedo ngenyaniso.
He is always ready to help in times of trouble

VERSE 2
Asoyiki thina ngoko,
So we will not fear
Nok’ umhlab’ uguqulweyo;
Even if earthquakes come
Nok’iintaba ziphoswayo,
Enzulwini yal’ulwandle.
And the mountains crumble into the sea

VERSE 3
Ma kagqum’ amanzi alo,
Alephuze amagwebu;
Let the oceans roar and foam
Ma zizama-zam’ iintaba,
Ngako ukunyuka kwalo.
Let the mountains tremble as the waters surge

VERSE 4
Kukh’ umlambo omisinga,
Iwuvuyisayo lo mzi;
There is a river that brings joy to the city of God
Unobuhle bobungcwele,
Uyintlalo yophezulu.
The sacred home of the Most High

VERSE 5
Uphakathi kwawo Yena,
God Himself lives in that city
Awungek’ ushukunyiswe;
It cannot be destroyed
Uwunceda onamandla,
Kwa ngexesha elimsinya.
God will protect it at the break of day

VERSE 6
Zath’ iintlanga zababama,
Ath’ amazw’ azama-zama;
The nations are in chaos and kingdoms crumble
Lavakala iZwi laKhe,
God thunders
Zaza azabikho zona.
And the earth melts

VERSE 7
UYehova wemikhosi,
UnguThixo wethu Yena;
The Lord of hosts is our God
Uyinqaba, unamandla,
He is our fortress, He is Almighty
Sophephela kuYe thina.
We will find refuge in Him
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndiph iilwimi zokumbonga

lines.translation: Grant me a thousand tongues to give thanks
To my Redeemer
And let the whole world know, the Lord is Holy
My Gracious Master, assist me
To spread Your message
Throughout the world, to every living soul
Jesus, Your name comforts us
Heals the heart and brings us peace
Jesus, break the power of sin
Set the prisoner free
Your blood must make the defiled hearts clean
Speak and the dead will hear
And receive new life
And the sorrowful
Be engulfed by Your loving arms
All nations must look up to their God
Be saved and judged according to their faith
All sins have been laid on Jesus’ shoulders
God’s only Son has been made an offering, For every soul of man

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndiph’ iilwimi zokumbonga,
Grant me a thousand tongues to give thanks
Umkhululi wami;
To my Redeemer
Ndibalise ngobungcwele
BoKumkani wami.
And let the whole world know, the Lord is Holy

VERSE 2
Nkosi yam uz’ undincede,
My Gracious Master, assist me
Ndikushumayele;
To spread Your message
Bath’ abemi balo mhlaba,
Bonke ndibatyele.
Throughout the world, to every living soul

VERSE 3
Yesu, eli gama laKho,
Liya thuthuzela;
Jesus, Your name comforts us
Liphilis’ intliziyo,
Ibe nokuzola.
Heals the heart and brings us peace

VERSE 4
Yesu, qob’ amandl’ esoono
Jesus, break the power of sin
Kuy’ obanjiweyo;
Set the prisoner free
Lith’ igazi licokise,
Lowo uncholileyo.
Your blood must make the defiled hearts clean

VERSE 5
Thetha kuv’ ofileyo,
Speak and the dead will hear
Amkeliswe amandla;
And receive new life
Abe nokhedamileyo,
And the sorrowful
UkwesaKh’ isandla.
Be engulfed by Your loving arms

VERSE 6
Zonk’ izizwe ma zijonge
Kuy’ uThixo wazo;
All nations must look up to their God
Zisindiswe, zigwetyelwe,
Ngokukholwa kwazo.
Be saved and judged according to their faith

VERSE 7
Zonk’ inkohlakalo zomntu,
Zathwalisw’ iMvana;
All sins have been laid on Jesus’ shoulders
Wabingelwa lonk’ uluntu,
OkaThix’ uNyana.
God’s only Son has been made an offering, For every soul of man
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yesu, gama linoyolo

lines.translation: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds, in a believer’s ear
It soothes sorrows, heals the wound and drive away the fear
It makes the wounded spirit whole, and calms the troubled breast
It is manna to the hungry soul, and to the weary, rest.
Hit is the Shield, the Rock and hiding place
It has filled me with treasures of boundless stores of grace
Jesus, my Friend and Shepherd, my King
My Way, Truth and Life; accept the praise I bring
May I proclaim Your love always, as long as I live
And may the music of Your name refresh my soul in death
Until I sound it at the gates of heaven as I knock
And proclaim it as I greet the glorious company of heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yesu, gama linoyolo
Kulow’ ukholwayo;
How sweet the name of Jesus sounds, in a believer’s ear
Liphelisa zonk’ iintsizi,
Kulo woyikayo.
It soothes sorrows, heals the wound and drive away the fear

VERSE 2
Liphilisa umphefumlo,
Ongxweleriweyo;
It makes the wounded spirit whole, and calms the troubled breast
Lixhasa olambileyo,
Kwa nodiniweyo.
It is manna to the hungry soul, and to the weary, rest.

VERSE 3
Lilikhaka, kwa neliWa,
Elikhuselayo;
Hit is the Shield, the Rock and hiding place
Lanelise ngobutyebi,
Obungapheliyo.
It has filled me with treasures of boundless stores of grace

VERSE 4
Yesu, Mhlobo, noMalusi,
NoKumkani wami;
Jesus, my Friend and Shepherd, my King
Ndlela, Nene, Bomi bami,
Uyingoma yami.
My Way, Truth and Life; accept the praise I bring

VERSE 5
Ndinga ndingabonga njalo,
Ndisekobu bomi;
May I proclaim Your love always, as long as I live
Ze ndimemelele njalo,
Xa ndiwela iJordan.
And may the music of Your name refresh my soul in death

VERSE 6
Ndize ndinkqonkqoze ngalo
Kumasangw’ ezulu;
Until I sound it at the gates of heaven as I knock
Ndize ndibulise ngalo,
Kumkhosi wezulu.
And proclaim it as I greet the glorious company of heaven
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yivani ezi ndaba, yivani, bantu nonke.

lines.primary: Yivani ezi ndaba, yivani, bantu nonke.
lines.translation: Hear this news, hear everybody
In all corners of the world
On the mountain tops, and in the valleys
The deaf, the mighty and the lowly.
The Saviour died, He sacrificed His life
He died for the breakers of His own Law

lines.primary: Be ndone ngeento zonke, uyandamkela noko,

lines.translation: I had sinned in all respects, yet He accepts me, He forgave me, I will praise Him
I wish I had a thousand tounges
To proclaim my gratitude for His immeasurable grace

lines.primary: Ndincede Nkosi yam, ndivis’ izizwe zonke
lines.translation: Help me O Lord, let me tell the whole world
How You suffered to save me,and everybody should thank You
Jesus, the name so sweet
Your grace Jesus, is a blessing
Turns mourning into dancing, raises the dead
You have raised us, You have revived us
The deaf can hear, the blind can see
The lame can walk, praise Him
The sick are healed, all diseases are cured
As they arrive in numbers, He helps them all

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yivani ezi ndaba, yivani, bantu nonke.
Hear this news, hear everybody
Nihleli kulo mhlaba, eendaweni zonke.
In all corners of the world
Kuviwe ngaphezulu, kuviwe nangaphantsi,
On the mountain tops, and in the valleys
Ad’ eve nosithulu, nosentla nosezantsi.
The deaf, the mighty and the lowly.

VERSE 2
Wabuba uMkhululi, wancam’ ubomi baKhe,
The Saviour died, He sacrificed His life
Wafela abaphuli, baaphul’ umthetho waKhe.
He died for the breakers of His own Law
Be ndone ngeento zonke, uyandamkela noko,
Undixolele konke; mandimdumise ngoko.
I had sinned in all respects, yet He accepts me, He forgave me, I will praise Him

VERSE 3
Ndiswele imilomo, ayaba iliwaka,
I wish I had a thousand tounges
Ibonga ngentlokoma ufefe olungaka.
To proclaim my gratitude for His immeasurable grace
Ndincede Nkosi yam, ndivis’ izizwe zonke
Help me O Lord, let me tell the whole world
Owakuvayo ngami, babong’ abantu bonke.
How You suffered to save me,and everybody should thank You

VERSE 4
Igama laKho Yesu, limnandi endlebeni.
Jesus, the name so sweet
Ufefe lwaKho Yesu, lunoyol’ entliz’yweni.
Your grace Jesus, is a blessing
Kuvuya obelila, kuvuke ofileyo,
Turns mourning into dancing, raises the dead
EnguWe ongumvusi, low’ osivusileyo.
You have raised us, You have revived us

VERSE 5
Zithulu! Niya viswa, zimfama!, khangelani;
The deaf can hear, the blind can see
Ziqhwala! Nahanjiswa, mudumiseni nani.
The lame can walk, praise Him
Kuphila imilwelwe, kuncedw’ izifo zonke,
The sick are healed, all diseases are cured
Besiza beziihlwele, uya banceda bonke.
As they arrive in numbers, He helps them all
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Masibulele kuYesu

lines.translation: Let us give thanks to Jesus
For He died for us
What an act of grace
Pardon us Father, have mercy on us
You came to us, the people of darkness
You didn’t discriminate against anyone
You died for all sinners
Pardon us Father, have mercy on us
Blacks and whites must worship together
Let them sing and shout
And praise the Lord
Pardon us Father, have mercy on us

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Masibulele kuYesu ,
Let us give thanks to Jesus
Ngokuba wasifela;
For He died for us
Wasenzela izibele,
Ngokusifela kwaKhe.
What an act of grace
Taru! BAwo,
Yiba nofefe kuthi.
Pardon us Father, have mercy on us

VERSE 2
Thina bantwana beemfama
Oweza kuthi apha,
You came to us, the people of darkness
Akwakhetha bala lamntu,
You didn’t discriminate against anyone
Wafel’ abazimfama.
You died for all sinners
Taru! BAwo,
Yiba nofefe kuthi.
Pardon us Father, have mercy on us

VERSE 3
Abantsundu nabamhlophe,
Ma babulele kunye,
Blacks and whites must worship together
Mabavakalise bonke,
Let them sing and shout
Baculele iNkosi.
And praise the Lord
Taru! BAwo,
Yiba nofefe kuthi.
Pardon us Father, have mercy on us
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Hosana enyangweni! Ndivuma ngezwi lam

lines.translation: Hosanna in the Highest! I proclaim!
To David’s Son, who has come for me
Hosanna! Save me, I am in distress
My Saviour responds, even before I call on Him
What will I be wearing, when He come to visit?
Prepare, cleanse my heart O Lord
I surrender all to You, my Redeemer

lines.primary: Ma iqubude kuWe Ngenene, Nkosi yam.
lines.translation: I bow before You, earnestly my Lord
You set me free from my prison of sin
You broke the chain that bound me
That caused me to surrender my life to You
You have turned my mourning into dancing

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Hosana enyangweni! Ndivuma ngezwi lam;
Hosanna in the Highest! I proclaim!
Kunyana kaDavide, Ozayo ngenxa yam.
To David’s Son, who has come for me
Hosana! undisiza, Ebunzimeni bam;
Hosanna! Save me, I am in distress
Uyeza akabizwa OnguMsindisi wam.
My Saviour responds, even before I call on Him

VERSE 2
Ndovatha ezinjani Wakutyelela kum?
What will I be wearing, when He come to visit?
Yilungisele Wena Yonk’ intliziyo yam
Prepare, cleanse my heart O Lord
Ndiyinikele kuWe, OnguMhlanguli wam
I surrender all to You, my Redeemer
Ma iqubude kuWe Ngenene, Nkosi yam.
I bow before You, earnestly my Lord

VERSE 3
Ndandikhululwe nguWe, Entolongweni yam,
You set me free from my prison of sin
Se liqhawulwe nguWe, Ikhamandela lam
You broke the chain that bound me
Elandincamisayo, Ndalahl’ ubomi bam
That caused me to surrender my life to You
Se undivuyisile Ekulileni kwam.
You have turned my mourning into dancing
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Dumisani, bantu nonke

lines.translation: Praise the Lord! All nations
Praise the Lord! All creation
Today is a joyful day
Today is a delightful day
The Saviour has been born
A blessing has been delivered
Today, we have the grace God
Today, we have salvation
He is not the enemy
Spread the news
He is merciful
He has come to die for us
Spread the news
To the whole world
Everybody must thank Him!
All of creation must thank Him!

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Dumisani, bantu nonke!
Praise the Lord! All nations
Zidumise iinto zonke!
Praise the Lord! All creation
Namhla ngumhla weendumiso;
Today is a joyful day
Namhla ngumhla weemvuyiso.
Today is a delightful day

VERSE 2
UMkhululi sel’ ezelwe,
The Saviour has been born
Ithamsanqa lizisiwe;
A blessing has been delivered
Namhla ububele bukho,
Today, we have the grace God
Namhla usindiso lukho.
Today, we have salvation

VERSE 3
Akezanga ngobutshaba,
He is not the enemy
Hambisani ezi ndaba;
Spread the news
Uze kuthi ngobubele,
He is merciful
Uze ‘kuze asifele.
He has come to die for us

VERSE 4
Hambisani ezi ndaba,
Spread the news
Ziye kuwo wonk’ umhlaba;
To the whole world
Bulelani bantu nonke!
Everybody must thank Him!
Zibulele iinto zonke!
All of creation must thank Him!
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kulowo mzi ka Davide
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Kulowo mzi ka Davide,
Kwisitali seenkomo;
Lwabekwa apho usana,
Emkhombeni westali.
NguMariya unina,
NguYesu olo sana..

VERSE 2
Weza apha emhlabeni,
EyiNkosi enkulu,
Ebehlala nabaphantsi,
Wathobel’ abazali,
Wabeva wabathanda,
UmSindisi ongcwele

VERSE 3
Wathi ngokukhula kwakhe
Wangumzekeliso kuthi.
Uvuya kwa neenyembezi ,
Waziva kwa nje ngathi.
Nangok’ uya sivela
Emithwaleni yethu

VERSE 4
Sombona ekupheleni,
Ngenxa yothando lwakhe;
Kuba ngoku ezulwini,
UyiNkosi yabakhe.
Ebuka nabantwana
Ekhaya ezulwini.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Namhla ma simbonge sonke
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Namhla ma simbonge sonke,
UThix’ ophezu konke;
Kuba namhla sizalelwe,
Ukristu umSindisi.
Ma sivuye,
NgoKristu umSindisi.

VERSE 2
Zonk’ izizwe, zonk’ iintlanga
Ma zivum’ iindumiso,
Zimbulele uYehova,
Ngal’ ubabalo lwaKhe.
Ngokusipha
Ukristu umSindisi.

VERSE 3
Abalusi bayifiya
Yonk’ imihlambi yabo.
Babaleka ngobunxhamo,
Bay’ eBeteleheme.
Bamfumana,
Ukristu umSindisi.

VERSE 4
Yizani ke, simdumise,
NguY’ onguManuweli,
OnguThixo, ekuThixo,
Ongumntu ebantwini.
Ma simbonge
Ukristu umSindisi.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Uzuko enyangweni, Uxol emhlabeni

lines.primary: Ma sivuye ke ngoko kunye nabezulu

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Uzuko enyangweni, Uxol’ emhlabeni,
OnguThixo uhlile, waba sisihlobo,
UThix’ ongabonwayo, Lowo ungu “Ndikho”
Uphambukele kuthi, lowo unguYesu.

VERSE 2
Ubongwa zingelosi, lowo oyiNkosi
Iindaba ezingaYe ziya sikelela.
Ushiye ubukhosi kwa nozuko lwaKhe
Ongumthombo wendalo wafika wazalwa.

VERSE 3
OnguNyana kaThixo ufike waangumntu
Engowasezulwini, wahlal’ emhlabeni
Ngokuzithoba kwaKhe siya mangaliswa
Ad’ angabi nandawo yokubek’ intloko.

VERSE 4
Ma sivuye ke ngoko kunye nabezulu
Siyibonge iNkosi enguManuweli
Ma siqubude sonke ku “Mavela-tanci”,
Okwayinyama yethu kwanoThixo wethu.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Sinesipho esikhulu

lines.translation: We have a great gift
From the Lord
It is a rare gift
More beloved than anything else
It is strength to those that receive it
It is life to those that accept it
That gift is Jesus
He is the greatest gift to all believers
We thank the Lord
For this great gift
We thank God alone
For the gift of his only begotten Son

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Sinesipho esikhulu,
Esisiphiweyo thina;
We have a great gift
Sisiphiwe nguYehova,
Eso sipho esinaso.
From the Lord

VERSE 2
Sinqabile eso sipho,
Sisiphiwe nguYehova;
It is a rare gift
Basithanda sona kanye,
Phezu kweento abanazo.
More beloved than anything else

VERSE 3
Singamandla eso sipho,
Kwaabo basifumeneyo;
It is strength to those that receive it
Sibubomi eso sipho,
Kwaabo abasamkeleyo.
It is life to those that accept it

VERSE 4
Eso sipho singuYesu,
Esisiphiweyo thina;
That gift is Jesus
Usisipho esikhulu,
Kwaabo bakholiweyo.
He is the greatest gift to all believers

VERSE 5
Simbulela uYehova,
We thank the Lord
Ngeso sipho esikhulu;
For this great gift
Simbulel’ uThixo yedwa,
We thank God alone
Ngokusiph’ uNyana waKhe.
For the gift of his only begotten Son
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kukh induli eluhlaza

lines.translation: There is a green hill far away
Outside the city wall
Where Jesus Lord was wounded
And died, yet without sin
The pain He endured
We can only imagine
The sinful person
Cannot endure
The was no other option
Of settling the debt
There was no other way
To eradicate anxiety
The gate was locked
There was no key
There was no one good enough
Without Godliness
The angels could not
Die for His own
Because they could not save
Anybody from death
To pay the price for sin
He was the only one good enough
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven and let us in
O dearly, dearly has He loved
And we must love Him too
And trust in His redeeming blood
And try His works to do

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Kukh' induli eluhlaza,
There is a green hill far away
Engabiyelwanga;
Outside the city wall
Aph' uYesu bamlimaza,
Where Jesus Lord was wounded
Wafa engonanga.
And died, yet without sin

VERSE 2
Iintlungu awazivayo.
The pain He endured
Asingezixeli;
We can only imagine
Umntu yena owonayo,
The sinful person
Angenyamezeli.
Cannot endure

VERSE 3
Kwakungekho cebo limbi,
The was no other option
Lokuhlaw'l' ityala;
Of settling the debt
Kwakungekho ndlela yimbi,
There was no other way
Yokusus' ixhala.
To eradicate anxiety

VERSE 4
Lalivaliwe isango,
The gate was locked
Kungekho sitshixo;
There was no key
Kwakungekho nonebango,
There was no one good enough
Engenabuthixo.
Without Godliness

VERSE 5
Zazingeze neengelose,
The angels could not
Zifele abaKhe;
Die for His own
Kuba zazingesindise,
Because they could not save
Aabo bafi baKhe.
Anybody from death

VERSE 6
YayinguYe onebango
To pay the price for sin
Elinobunzulu,
He was the only one good enough
Bokuvula amasango,
He only could unlock the gate
Silingen' izulu.
Of heaven and let us in

VERSE 7
Hayi! olo thando lwaKhe,
O dearly, dearly has He loved
Nge simthanda nathi;
And we must love Him too
Sithemb' elo gazi laKhe,
And trust in His redeeming blood
'Ze simkhonze futhi.
And try His works to do
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kugqtyiwe! Kuhlawliwe
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Kugqtyiwe! Kuhlaw’liwe!
Naank’ uKristu esifele.
Inkululo izuziwe,
Naal’ idini se lanele.

VERSE 2
Ikhuselo likrazulwe,
Imivalo ivuliwe;
Naants’ indlela ilungile,
Zonk’ izizwe zibiziwe.

VERSE 3
Usathana woyisiwe,
Anqamkil’ amandla akhe;
UMsindisi ufezile,
Wonke umsebenzi waKhe.

VERSE 4
Lukho ngoku uxolelo,
Kubo bonk’ abakholwayo;
Zisusiwe iintintelo,
Ngaloo Mvana yabingwayo.

VERSE 5
Zazibekwe phezu kwaYo,
Zonk’ iinkohlakalo zethu;
Ngayo imivumbo yaYo,
Kuze ukuphila kwethu.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Thixo wam! Thixo wam
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thixo wam! Thixo wam!
Undishiya ngani?
Lamemeza elo lizwi,
Latsho kalusizi.

VERSE 2
Lizwi loMsindisi,
Limemez’ uYise;
Esezimbandezelweni,
Esiv’ ubuhlungu.

VERSE 3
Lizwi loMkhululi,
Esemnqamlezweni;
Ethwel’ ubunzima bethu,
Kwa nezoono zethu.

VERSE 4
Lamemez’ ibada,
Latsho umtyangampo;
“‘Ze undikhumbule Nkosi,
Kwelo khaya laKho.”

VERSE 5
Yaphendul’ iNkosi,
Ngezwi lobubele;
“Kwa namhla nje, kwa namhla nje,
SiseParadesi.”

VERSE 6
Sitsho nathi, Nkosi,
Isicelo sethu;
Z’usamkele ezulwini,
Mini sibubayo.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bawo baxolele

lines.translation: Father forgive them
They do not know
It has been planned long ago
Father forgive them
Father forgive them
They do not know
Paradise is open
Even to convicted criminals
Father forgive them
They do not know
Forsake me not my Father
At this dark hour
Father forgive them
They do not know
Woman! Here is your son
He will take care of you
Father forgive them
They do not know
I thirst, I thirst
I am suffering
Father forgive them
They do not know
It is finished, it is settled
The debt has been paid in full
Father forgive them
They do not know
Receive my Spirit
Father forgive them

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bawo baxolele,
Father forgive them
Kuba abazi nto;
They do not know
Ngummiselo wamanyange,
It has been planned long ago
Bawo baxolele.
Father forgive them

VERSE 2
Bawo baxolele,
Father forgive them
Kuba abazi nto;
They do not know
Ivuliw’ iParadesi,
Paradise is open
Kwa nakumabada.
Even to convicted criminals

VERSE 3
Bawo baxolele,
Father forgive them
Kuba abazi nto;
They do not know
Ungandishiyi Bawo wam,
Forsake me not my Father
Kuyo lentsunguzi.
At this dark hour

VERSE 4
Bawo baxolele,
Father forgive them
Kuba abazi nto;
They do not know
“Mfazi! naank’ unyana wakho,
Woman! Here is your son
Wokunyamekela.”
He will take care of you

VERSE 5
Bawo baxolele,
Father forgive them
Kuba abazi nto;
They do not know
“Ndiya nxanwa, ndiyanxanwa,
I thirst, I thirst
Kulo eli futhe
I am suffering

VERSE 6
Bawo baxolele,
Father forgive them
Kuba abazi nto;
They do not know
“Kuqhityiwe, kuhlaw’liwe,
It is finished, it is settled
Liphelil’ ityala
The debt has been paid in full

VERSE 7
Bawo baxolele,
Father forgive them
Kuba abazi nto;
They do not know
“Yamkel umphefumlo wam”,
Receive my Spirit
Bawo baxolele
Father forgive them
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Usizi naalu lumi lodwa

lines.translation: Behold the sorrow
Behold the pain
Behold the grace
On the cross
The Lord descended from heaven
And became flesh
He was made an offering for sinners
On the cross
Where is our faith instituted?
Where is our hope founded?
Where is our love warranted?
On the cross
All dangers can be eradicated
All debt is settled
All sins will be forgiven
On the cross
The angels gazed at what was happening below
And again, they stared
They witness this mystery
On the cross

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Usizi naalu lumi lodwa,
Behold the sorrow
Iintlungu nazi zimi zodwa;
Behold the pain
Naab’ ububele bumi bodwa,
Behold the grace
Emnqamlezweni.
On the cross

VERSE 2
INkosi yehla ezulwini,
The Lord descended from heaven
Eyaba ngumntu ebantwini;
And became flesh
Yeenzelwa thina boon’ idini,
He was made an offering for sinners
Emnqamlezweni.
On the cross

VERSE 3
Ukholo lwethu loma phi na?
Where is our faith instituted?
Ithemba lethu loma phi na?
Where is our hope founded?
Uthando lwethu loma phi na?
Where is our love warranted?
Emnqamlezweni.
On the cross

VERSE 4
Ingozi ingaphela yonke,
All dangers can be eradicated
Ityala liya hlaw’lwa lonke;
All debt is settled
Izoono zoxolelwa zonke,
All sins will be forgiven
Emnqamlezweni.
On the cross

VERSE 5
Zibon’ iingelosi phantsi,
The angels gazed at what was happening below
Ziqwalasele futh’ ezantsi;
And again, they stared
Zibona isimanga, naasi,
They witness this mystery
Emnqamlezweni.
On the cross
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Wazithwal izoono, Yesu

lines.translation: You bore our sins, Lord Jesus
Yet You were without sin
You paid the price, Lord Jesus
Yet You were without debt
You were a man of sorrows
You were without sin
Your blood was shed
Though You were Holy
All our transgressions
Were charged against You
All our inequities
Were charged against You

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Wazithwal’ izoono, Yesu,
You bore our sins, Lord Jesus
Zingezoono zaKho;
Yet You were without sin
Walihlaw’l’ ityala Yesu,
You paid the price, Lord Jesus
Lingetyala laKho.
Yet You were without debt

VERSE 2
Wawungumntu oneentsizi,
You were a man of sorrows
Ungemooni Wena;
You were without sin
Laphalal’ igazi laKho,
Your blood was shed
Uyingcwele Wena.
Though You were Holy

VERSE 3
Iziphoso zethu zonke
All our transgressions
Zabalelwa kuWe;
Were charged against You
Nezilandu zethu zonke,
All our inequities
Zabalelwa kuWe.
Were charged against You

VERSE 4
Sixolelwa, siphiliswa,
Ngezo ntlungu laKho;
Siya hlanjwa ezonweni,
Ngelo gazi laKho.
author: Your wounds; we are healed, forgiven

title: Ndakuqwalasel ikrusi

lines.primary: When I survey the wondrous cross

lines.translation: When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of Glory died
My richest gain I count but loss
And pour contempt on all my pride
Forbid it Lord, that I should boast
If it is not about Your cross
All the vain things that charm me most
I sacrifice them for Your sake
Just look at that body
Where the blood flowed
Have you ever seen love
And sorrow mingled together?
All the riches I have
I can never sacrifice them to You
I must sacrifice myself to You
And value that love

lyrics:
VERSE 1
When I survey the wondrous cross
Ndakuqwalasel’ ikrusi,
When I survey the wondrous cross
Ekwaxhonyw’ eyam iNkosi;
On which the Prince of Glory died
Ndoncama yonk’ inzuzo yam,
My richest gain I count but loss
Ndilidele nekratshi lam.
And pour contempt on all my pride

VERSE 2
Mandingaqhayisi Nkosi,
Forbid it Lord, that I should boast
Kungengay’ ikrusi yaKho;
If it is not about Your cross
Yonk’ imihlal’ ekhoyo,
All the vain things that charm me most
Ndiyincama ngenxa yaKho.
I sacrifice them for Your sake

VERSE 3
Kha ubone lowo mzimba,
Just look at that body
Apho kwampompoz’ igazi;
Where the blood flowed
Wakha walubon’ uthando,
Have you ever seen love
Luxubene nosizi?
And sorrow mingled together?

VERSE 4
Zonk’ iindyebo endinazo,
All the riches I have
Andingenikeli ngazo;
I can never sacrifice them to You
Mandizenze mna idini,
I must sacrifice myself to You
Ndixabise olothando.
And value that love
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Wakrazulwa ngenxa yami

lines.translation: Rock of Ages, cleft for me
Let me hide myself in You
Jesus’ raven side that flowed
What has caused the wounds
At Your side?
It is the blood, it is the water,
May they cleanse me
My tears can forever flow
But cannot accomplish anything
It is You alone Lord that can save
Everybody from sin
Nothing in my hand I bring
I am naked, Lord
Simply to the cross I cling
To be crucified
Rock of Ages, cleft for me
Let me hide myself in You
Jesus’ raven side that flowed

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Wakrazulwa ngenxa yami,
Liwa laphakade;
Rock of Ages, cleft for me
Kuze ndizifihle kuWe,
Let me hide myself in You
Nxeba likaYesu.
Jesus’ raven side that flowed

VERSE 2
Yeyani na lemikrozo,
What has caused the wounds
Kwelo cala laKho?;
At Your side?
Yeyegazi, yeyamanzi,
It is the blood, it is the water,
Ma ndihlanjululwe.
May they cleanse me

VERSE 3
Iinyembezi zeminyaka,
My tears can forever flow
Azingefeze nto;
But cannot accomplish anything
NguWe Nkosi osusayo
It is You alone Lord that can save
Zonk’ izoono zomntu.
Everybody from sin

VERSE 4
Andinanto esandleni,
Nothing in my hand I bring
Ndize kanye, Nkosi!
I am naked, Lord
Se ndondele ekrusini,
Simply to the cross I cling
Ekubethelweni.
To be crucified

VERSE 5
Wakrazulwa ngenxa yami,
Liwa laphakade;
Rock of Ages, cleft for me
Kuze ndizifihle kuWe,
Let me hide myself in You
Nxeba likaYesu.
Jesus’ raven side that flowed
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ngemini yeCawa
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ngemini yeCawa,
Le mini inkulu,
Iphumile enchwabeni
InKosi yezulu.

VERSE 2
Koyisiw’ ukufa,
Lahluthwa nenchwaba;
Uvukile umSindisi;
Bikani iindaba.

VERSE 3
Vuyani makholwa,
Nicule, ngelosi!
Uncamile uSathana;
Ihleli inKosi.

VERSE 4
Bonani bangcwele,
Inchwaba lenKosi,
Lihleli ze, ivukile,
Imkile inKosi.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Naal inchwaba livuliwe

lines.translation: The tomb is wide open
Why is it open?
The stone has been rolled
Why are you crying?
There are the burial cloths
Why are they wrapped?
“Go tell my disciples”
Why are you crying?
There is Mary standing
Who is she looking for?
Alone by the graveside
Why are you crying?
“They have taken the Lord
Where have they put him?”
The angels responded
Why are you crying?
Tell me Sir
Where have you put him?
I will go get him
Why are you crying?
“O Mary” ; “Teacher”
“Who are you looking for?
“Do not touch me
Why are you crying?”
“Go tell my disciples
I have risen
I am going to my Father”
Why are you crying?

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Naal’ inchwaba livuliwe,
The tomb is wide open
Livulelweni na?
Why is it open?
Naal’ ilitye liqengqiwe,
The stone has been rolled
Ulilela ni na?
Why are you crying?

VERSE 2
Naanz’ iiqhiya zokunchwaba,
There are the burial cloths
Zisongelwe ni na?
Why are they wrapped?
“Hamb’ ubike kubafundi”;
“Go tell my disciples”
Ulilela ni na?
Why are you crying?

VERSE 3
Naank’ uMariya emi,
There is Mary standing
Ufuna bani na?
Who is she looking for?
Ngasenchwabeni eyedwa,
Alone by the graveside
Ulilela ni na?
Why are you crying?

VERSE 4
“Bayisusile iNkosi,
“They have taken the Lord
Bayibeke phi?”
Where have they put him?”
Zaphendula iingelosi;
The angels responded
Ulilela ni na?
Why are you crying?

VERSE 5
“Ndixelele Nkosi ndini,
Tell me Sir
Uyibeke phi na?
Where have you put him?
“Ndoyithatha; ndixelele”,
I will go get him
Ulilela ni na?
Why are you crying?

VERSE 6
“Wa, Mariya!”; “Mfundisi” ,
“O Mary” ; “Teacher”
“Ufuna bani na?
“Who are you looking for?
“Uz’ ungandichukumisi,
“Do not touch me
Ulilela ni na?”
Why are you crying?”

VERSE 7
“Bikela abafundi baM,
“Go tell my disciples
Ndivukile Mina;
I have risen
Ndiya kuYe uBawo wam”,
I am going to my Father”
Ulilela ni na?
Why are you crying?
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Uvukile, nKosi, Yesu
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Uvukile, nKosi, Yesu,
Wawuphuma enchwabeni;
Wawuvuka ngobukhosi,
Akwahlala ekufeni.

VERSE 2
Yesu, ububomi bonke,
Akwabona ukubola;
Usahleli, uphilile,
Uya vuya nokuvuya.

VERSE 3
Yesu, siya kudumisa
Ngoku kufa wakufayo
Zonk’ iintshaba wazoyisa
Ngaloo mini wavukayo.

VERSE 4
Yesu, le nyaniso yaKho
Iya bonakala kanye.
Wenze amakholwa aKho
Abe yintw’ eninzi kanye.

VERSE 5
Aze athi ngomhla waKho,
Oya kuwavusa ngawo,
Abe secaleni laKho,
Eve ukuyola nawo.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Gcobani zizwe, nonke
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Gcobani zizwe, nonke,
Gcobani mhlaba wonke;
Gcobani nDalo yonke;
InKosi ivukile.

VERSE 2
Vukani Bantu nonke,
Niyibedef’ inKosi;
Nize ningamawaka;
InKosi ivukile.

VERSE 3
Isoyisel’ ukufa,
Isoyisel’ inchwaba;
Asinakukugwetywa,
InKosi ivukile.

VERSE 4
Ma sisondez’ izipho,
Ezinyaweni zaYo;
Sizinikele kuYo.
InKosi ivukile.

VERSE 5
Ma senze iindumiso,
Ma senze iimvuyiso,
Kube ngemihla yonke,
InKosi ivukile.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kumkani weengcwalisa! Zuthobamehlo aKho

lines.translation: Lord of Saints, behold us
Let us see, let us praise, at Your feet
Let us lift our praises
And magnify Your Name
You became flesh, You became a servant
You bore our sins, what an act of mercy
It produces gratitude from the heart
You were humble to the point of death, You were victorious
You were laid in a tomb,….
Behold O grave, the Lord of Life
O death, where is your sting?
Your apostles witnessed Your ascension
A cloud lifted You to heaven
All pain is gone
Joy is accomplished
Blow the trumpets!! O heaven, Scream!!
Audiences and Praise singers, extol the Lord of lords
As He enters the Temple
To sit with God at the Throne, eternally

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Kumkani weengcwalisa! Z’uthob’ amehlo aKho,
Lord of Saints, behold us
Sibone, sidumisa, Ezinyaweni zaKho,
Let us see, let us praise, at Your feet
Kusing’ ilizwi ngaphezulu,
Let us lift our praises
Libong’ obaKho ubukhulu.
And magnify Your Name

VERSE 2
Waamkel’ ubuntu bethu, Wavuma ubucaka,
You became flesh, You became a servant
Wathwal’ ityala lethu. Ufefe olungaka,
You bore our sins, what an act of mercy
Lubanga ebantwini bonke
Umbongo wentliziyo yonke.
It produces gratitude from the heart

VERSE 3
Wathoba ekufeni; Kukukweyisa kwaKho!
You were humble to the point of death, You were victorious
Walala enchwabeni; Ngumvuyelelo waKho.
You were laid in a tomb,….
Khangela,Nchwab’uSokuphila!
Behold O grave, the Lord of Life
Luphi na, kuFa, ulwavila?
O death, where is your sting?

VERSE 4
Wenyuka, bebonela Abapostile baKho;
Your apostles witnessed Your ascension
Ilifu lakwamkela Ekunyukeni kwaKho.
A cloud lifted You to heaven
Iintlungu zonke ziphelile;
All pain is gone
Uvuyelelo lufikile.
Joy is accomplished

VERSE 5
Vukani maxilongo!Memeza, wena, zulu!
Blow the trumpets!! O heaven, Scream!!
Mabandla naz’iimbongi, Bongan’ uSobukhulu,
Audiences and Praise singers, extol the Lord of lords
Esel’ engen’ etempileni.
As He enters the Temple
Wahlal’ ehlel’ eteroneni.
To sit with God at the Throne, eternally
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Naanko! Naanko! uMkhululi

lines.translation: Here is the Saviour!
He has died for sinners
To set them free
To save them
“Crucify Him! Crucify Him!
Yelled his enemies
“Kill Him!, Kill Him
Make our day”
He was led to Golgotha
He was crucified
“It is accomplished”, He said
And He died
A mystery of mysteries
On Sunday
He was seen, alive
The Christ
He said to His disciples:
“Hang around till You receive the promise
The Spirit”
The ultimate mystery happened
Jesus ascended to heaven
He is in the Holy of Holies
Even today
He appeals on our behalf
To the Father

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Naanko! Naanko! uMkhululi,
Here is the Saviour!
Ufel’ abooni;
He has died for sinners
Ukuze abakhulule,
To set them free
Basinde.
To save them

VERSE 2
“Mbethele! mbethele!”
“Crucify Him! Crucify Him!
Zatsho iintshaba;
Yelled his enemies
“Makafiswe! Makafiswe!”
“Kill Him!, Kill Him
Sonwabe.
Make our day”

VERSE 3
Wanyuselwa eGolgotha,
He was led to Golgotha
Wabethelelwa;
He was crucified
“Kugqityiwe” watsho Yena,
“It is accomplished”, He said
Wabuba.
And He died

VERSE 4
Isimanga sezimanga,
A mystery of mysteries
Ngemini yeCawa;
On Sunday
Uboniwe evukile,
He was seen, alive
UKristu.
The Christ

VERSE 5
Uthe kubafundi baKhe:,
He said to His disciples:
“Man’ ukulinda,
Elo dinga lamadinga,
“Hang around till You receive the promise
UMoya.”
The Spirit”

VERSE 6
Kuhle owokugqibela,
Ummangaliso;
The ultimate mystery happened
Ezulwini wenyukela,
UYesu.
Jesus ascended to heaven

VERSE 7
Ukwingcwele yeengcwele,
He is in the Holy of Holies
Kunanamhla nje;
Even today
Utaruzisela thina,
He appeals on our behalf
KuYise.
To the Father
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Vuyani nathi bakholwayo

lines.translation: Rejoice with us believers, we have received joy
When we come to think of it, it is wonderful!
Jesus descended from heaven to bring salvation
We now have life in abundance, it is amazing!
carried all our sins
He died for all of us, removing our transgressions
He
It is wonderful
In the midst of our darkness, He brought Light
We are no longer blinded by sin, it is amazing!
Even the one that backslides
Receives forgiveness, it is amazing!
Saints! You will hear in this life, even our praises
We’ll also glorify Him in Heaven, the Wonderful Counselor

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Vuyani nathi bakholwayo,
Siphiwe imvuyiso;
Rejoice with us believers, we have received joy
Sakuthi xa sinakanayo,
Sibon’ umangaliso!
When we come to think of it, it is wonderful!

VERSE 2
UYesu wehla ezulwini,
Ezisa usindiso;
Jesus descended from heaven to bring salvation
Se sibizelwa ebomini,
Yivan’ umangaliso!
We now have life in abundance, it is amazing!

VERSE 3
Wafela thina booni sonke,
carried all our sins
Esusa izigqitho;
He died for all of us, removing our transgressions
Ethwal’ ityala lethu sonke,
He
Ikwangumangaliso!
It is wonderful

VERSE 4
Phakathi kobumnyama bethu,
Wamisa inkanyiso;
In the midst of our darkness, He brought Light
Kuphele ubumfama bethu,
Bonan’ umangaliso!
We are no longer blinded by sin, it is amazing!

VERSE 5
Nodaniswayo enkonzweni,
Kwa ngazo iziwiso;
Even the one that backslides
Wamkelwa eluxolelweni,,
Ukwangumangaliso!
Receives forgiveness, it is amazing!

VERSE 6
Bangcwele! Nova ebomini,
Nezethu iindumiso;
Saints! You will hear in this life, even our praises
Sobonga nathi ezulwini,
USomimangaliso!
We’ll also glorify Him in Heaven, the Wonderful Counselor
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nzulu yemfihlakalo!Nzulu yesimanga

lines.translation: Deep mystery, great amazement
That has filled the earth, and the sky
This deep mystery, is God’s own Son
That came to save all people
He saw everybody, fallen into sin
Every soul, populated by misfortune
He felt deep, amazing compassion
He took their shame upon Himself
His birth was miraculous
He lived and taught convincingly
His cross was amazing
He died, and defeated death, what a miracle

lines.primary: Hayi! Obo bunzulu Bolu thando lwaKho;
lines.translation: O! the depth of Your love
And Your work we can’t comprehend
There is no condemnation to all who believe
Praise be to You Lord, now and forever more

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nzulu yemfihlakalo!Nzulu yesimanga!
Deep mystery, great amazement
Ezalise umhlaba,Nesibaka-baka.
That has filled the earth, and the sky
Lenzulu yesimanga, NgokaThix’ uNyana;
This deep mystery, is God’s own Son
Oweza ebantwini, Ngokubasindisa.
That came to save all people

VERSE 2
Wabon’ uluntu lonke,Luwe esonweni;
He saw everybody, fallen into sin
Imiphefumlo yonke;Ihlel’ elishweni;
Every soul, populated by misfortune
Wasikwa yimfesane, Engumangaliso;
He felt deep, amazing compassion
Wathabathela kuYe, Lonk’ ihlazo labo.
He took their shame upon Himself

VERSE 3
Kwaba ngummangaliso,Ukuzalwa kwaKhe;
His birth was miraculous
Waphila wafundisa, Ngokuncamisayo.
He lived and taught convincingly
Waba ngummangaliso Umnqamlezo waKhe;
His cross was amazing
Wafa, wooyis’ ukufa, Saba sisimanga.
He died, and defeated death, what a miracle

VERSE 4
Hayi! Obo bunzulu Bolu thando lwaKho;
O! the depth of Your love
Naloo msebenzi waKho Ongenakuqondwa.
And Your work we can’t comprehend
Abakholwayo namhla Abanakugwetywa;
There is no condemnation to all who believe
Ma udunyiswe Nkosi, Kus’ ephakadeni.
Praise be to You Lord, now and forever more
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yesu, Wena uyindlela
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yesu, Wena uyindlela,
Soya ngaWe ezulwini;
Wanga ungasikhokela,
Sisindiswe ebubini.

VERSE 2
Yesu, Wena uyinene,
Nawo onk’ amazwi aKho;
Bonke ubumene-mene,
Bubi ebusweni baKho.

VERSE 3
Yesu, ububomi Wena,
Se sinokuphila ngaWe;
Koba njalo sakungena,
Ezulwini, sibe naWe.

VERSE 4
Ndlela, Nene, Bomi bethu,
Se sikubulela sonke;
Ngazo iintliziyo zethu,
Sobulela maxa onke.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Khangelani nizibone

lines.translation: Open your eyes and see
Such Amazing Grace
That has been revealed about the Saviour
Who died for all people
We were walking in the dark
We had no light
We lived according to our sinful nature
We knew no righteousness
You rescued us, O God
You gave us Your Son
You brought light through Him
We, sinners, give thanks to Jesus
He took all our sins
And carried them all by Himself
You, O Holy Spirit
Come into our hearts
Help us to see and acknowledge
Jesus’ works (of salvation and transformation)

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Khangelani nizibone
Open your eyes and see
Izibele ezingaka,
Such Amazing Grace
Zityhiliwe ngomSindisi,
That has been revealed about the Saviour
Owafela thina Bantu.
Who died for all people

VERSE 2
Be sihamba emnyameni,
We were walking in the dark
Singenalo ukhanyiso;
We had no light
Be sihamba ekoneni,
We lived according to our sinful nature
Singakwazi ukulunga.
We knew no righteousness

VERSE 3
Wasinceda Wena, Thixo,
You rescued us, O God
Ngobubele obukhulu;
Wasinik’ uNyana waKho,
You gave us Your Son
Wasikhanyisela ngaYe.
You brought light through Him

VERSE 4
Simbulela onguYesu,
Thina booni abonayo;
We, sinners, give thanks to Jesus
Wazizek’ izoono zethu,
He took all our sins
Wazithwala Yena yedwa.
And carried them all by Himself

VERSE 5
Wena, Moya oyiNgcwele!
You, O Holy Spirit
Ma ungene kuthi sonke,
Come into our hearts
Usincede, sikubone
Help us to see and acknowledge
Oko kwenziwayo nguYe.
Jesus’ works (of salvation and transformation)
author: Your immeasurable Grace

title: Ndikhangele ngobubele

lines.translation: Have mercy on me
O my Lord!
You died for me
O my Lord!
You descended from heaven
You sacrificed your life
In order to save me
O my Lord!
I was wandering in darkness
O my Lord!
I was heading towards destruction
O my Lord!
Your servants came to me
They proclaimed Your Good News
They informed me about Your grace
O my Lord!
I want to experience Your grace
O my Lord!
I want to be saved
O my Lord!
Take all my sins away
Cleanse my heart
Hear me, forgive me
O my Lord!

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndikhangele ngobubele,
Have mercy on me
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!
Nguwe owabundifele,
You died for me
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!

VERSE 2
Wehla ezulwini laKho,
You descended from heaven
Wabuncam’ ubomi baKho,
You sacrificed your life
Ndive usindiso lwaKho,
In order to save me
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!

VERSE 3
Be ndihleli emnyameni,
I was wandering in darkness
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!
Be ndisinga ekufeni,
I was heading towards destruction
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!

VERSE 4
Zeza izicaka zaKho,
Your servants came to me
Zandivisa izwi laKho,
They proclaimed Your Good News
Zandityel’ ufefe lwaKho,
They informed me about Your grace
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!

VERSE 5
Ma ndiluv’ ufefe lwaKho,
I want to experience Your grace
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!
Ndibe lisindiswa laKho,
I want to be saved
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!

VERSE 6
Zonk’ izoono ma ziphele,
Take all my sins away
Intliziyo ibe ngcwele.
Cleanse my heart
Yiva, undithethelele,
Hear me, forgive me
O nKosi yam!
O my Lord!
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kristu, Mukhululi wethu

lines.translation: Christ, our Redeemer
Our hope is in You
You are the hope
Of all people
You are the real hope
You do not deceive us
You are the eternal hope
That cannot be moved
You are the hope of sinners
They confess their sins
Because, You are their hope
You are the hope of those who mourn
Those who cry: “We have sinned””
You are the hope of all believers
You are the only Hope
So, be our only Hope
At all times
Until we are called up yonder
Before You in heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Kristu, Mukhululi wethu,
Christ, our Redeemer
Wena ulithemba lethu;
Our hope is in You
Ulithemba labo bonke,
You are the hope
Abasemhlabeni wonke.
Of all people

VERSE 2
Ulithemba lenyaniso,
You are the real hope
Akunayo inkohliso;
You do not deceive us
Ulithemba elimiyo,
You are the eternal hope
Lona lingashukumiyo.
That cannot be moved

VERSE 3
Ulithemba laabo booni,
Ababuya ezonweni;
You are the hope of sinners
Bakuxel’ izoono zabo,
They confess their sins
Wena ulithemba labo.
Because, You are their hope

VERSE 4
Ulithemba labalili,
You are the hope of those who mourn
Abo bathi: “Awu, sonile”
Those who cry: “We have sinned””
Ulithemba lamakholwa,
You are the hope of all believers
Ulithemba elilodwa.
You are the only Hope

VERSE 5
Ngako masithembe sonke
So, be our only Hope
KuWe ngamaxesha onke;
At all times
Side size enyhwebeni,
Until we are called up yonder
Phambi kwaKho ezulwini.
Before You in heaven
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Hayi! Izibele zaKho

lines.translation: Lord, Your mercies stretch
To all that are guilty of sin
You want to save them
You want to heal them
Jesus, Son of the Living God
Listen to the wrong-doers
Save, and reconcile with
All who have offended You
Your mercies, Lord Jesus
Are sufficient for all of us
They cannot be measured
They endure forever
Thieves and drunkards
Robbers and criminals
Everybody has been called
To receive Your gift of salvation
When they weep, be compassionate
When they confess, forgive them
Support them in their acts of faith
And they will worship You in Spirit and in Truth

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Hayi! Izibele zaKho
Lord, Your mercies stretch
Ngaabo abasetyaleni,
To all that are guilty of sin
Obafuna besindile,
You want to save them
Obafuna bephilile.
You want to heal them

VERSE 2
Yesu, Nyana lo kaThixo!
Jesus, Son of the Living God
Phulaphula abaginwa;
Listen to the wrong-doers
Usindise, uphilise,
Save, and reconcile with
Abaphuli bemithetho.
All who have offended You

VERSE 3
Izibele zaKho, Yesu!
Your mercies, Lord Jesus
Ziwanele wonk’ umhlaba;
Are sufficient for all of us
Azinakulinganiswa,
They cannot be measured
Azinakuphela ndawo.
They endure forever

VERSE 4
Amasela namanxila,
Thieves and drunkards
Abaphangi namabada;
Robbers and criminals
Bonke bayabizwa nguWe,
Everybody has been called
Baze bonke basindiswe.
To receive Your gift of salvation

VERSE 5
Se bekhala, ma ubeve!
When they weep, be compassionate
Se bevuma baxolele!
When they confess, forgive them
Yomelez’ ukholo lwabo,
Support them in their acts of faith
Bakukhunge ngenyaniso.
And they will worship You in Spirit and in Truth
author: Traditional Methodist

title: UYesu lithemba lami

lines.translation: I put my trust in Jesus
That I will truly proclaim
I believe in Him
I will proclaim persistently
My human dignity has been restored
I am full of life
He is the Source of Life
The lover of sinners
I longed for Him
I set out in search
I gave up all things
Until I found Him
All along, Jesus saw me
As I wept
He called me and said: “Come to me”
And I responded
Now I have found rest in Jesus
He has been gracious to me
I am optimistic
For He is merciful

lyrics:
VERSE 1
UYesu lithemba lami,
I put my trust in Jesus
Ndotsho ndinyanise;
That I will truly proclaim
Ndiya kholwa kuYe nami,
I believe in Him
Ndotsho ndizingise.
I will proclaim persistently

VERSE 2
Ndifumen’ ubuntu ngaYe,
My human dignity has been restored
Ndizuze ubomi;
I am full of life
Ongumthombo wabo nguYe,
He is the Source of Life
Umthandi wabooni.
The lover of sinners

VERSE 3
Ndamnxanelwa ngako konke,
I longed for Him
Ndalila ndimfuna;
I set out in search
Ndalahla izinto zonke,
I gave up all things
Ndada ndamfumana.
Until I found Him

VERSE 4
Kant’ uYes’ uyandibona,
All along, Jesus saw me
Xa ndilila njalo;
As I wept
Wandibiza wathi: “Yiza”,
He called me and said: “Come to me”
Ndasabela njalo.
And I responded

VERSE 5
Ngoku ndiphumle kuYesu,
Now I have found rest in Jesus
Ngokofefe lwaKhe;
He has been gracious to me
Ndinethemba elikhulu,
I am optimistic
Ngay’ inceba yaKhe.
For He is merciful
author: Traditional Methodist

title: UYes uyakulawula

lines.translation: Jesus will reign, wherever the sun goes
His Kingdom shall stretch from shore to shore
Till suns shall rise and set no more
For Him shall endless prayer be made
and be His crown
Praises will rise
to glorify His name
Offerings will be burned,
All people will dwell on His love with sweetest song
All voices will sing beautifully in different languages
thriving with a sound
Children’s voices will be heard
where Jesus reigns
Blessings will abound
Prisoners will be set free, chains will be broken
the needy will be provided for
The tired will be rested,
must kneel before Him
All living creatures,
They will boast, about the power of His grace
And join up with Heavenly creatures
Giving Him His prominence

lyrics:
VERSE 1
UYes’ uyakulawula
Aph’ ilanga lihambayo;
Jesus will reign, wherever the sun goes
Both’ ubukumkani baKhe
Buzalise zonk’ iindawo;
His Kingdom shall stretch from shore to shore
Zid’ iinyanga zingathwasĭ,
Neminyaka ingapheli.
Till suns shall rise and set no more

VERSE 2
Iintandazo ngeentandazo
Zohlokoma ngenxa yaKhe;
For Him shall endless prayer be made
Zonyukela iindumiso,
and be His crown
Zibe sisitshaba saKhe;
Praises will rise
Kuqhunyiswe amadini
to glorify His name
Okuqhol’ igama laKhe.
Offerings will be burned,

VERSE 3
Boluncom’ uthando lwaKhe,
Ngaz’ iingoma ezimnandi;
All people will dwell on His love with sweetest song
Zithi zonk’ iilwimi zabo,
Zitsholoze okumnandi
All voices will sing beautifully in different languages
Kuvakal’ amazw’ eentsana,
thriving with a sound
Ehlokoma kwa ngesandi.
Children’s voices will be heard

VERSE 4
Kozalis’ iintsikelelo,
where Jesus reigns
Aph’ uYes’ alawulayo;
Blessings will abound
Amakhonkxwa akhululwe,
Awe amakhamandela;
Prisoners will be set free, chains will be broken
Aphunyuzw’ odiniweyo,
the needy will be provided for
Aneliswe osweleyo.
The tired will be rested,

VERSE 5
Izidalwa ezikhoyo,
must kneel before Him
Ma ziguqe phambi kwaKhe;
All living creatures,
Zibe zeziqhayisayo,
Ngaw’ amandl’ ofefe lwaKhe;
They will boast, about the power of His grace
Zidibane nabezulu,
And join up with Heavenly creatures
Ngokumnik’ udumo lwaKhe.
Giving Him His prominence
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Phezu komhlaba ngamazwe ngamazwe

lines.translation: In this world, there are many nations
In this world, there are many races/tribes
That speak different languages
That practice various traditions
Even though they are different
They agree on one issue
All nations have fallen into sin
All nations are facing destruction
Here on earth, no one can bring salvation
Here on earth, no one can give us life
We yearn and long for heaven
Where the Saviour of sinners will come
Jesus, You alone can save us
Jesus, You alone can heal us
We trust in Your unmatched Power
We are holding onto Your hand
You died for all sinners
You brought Good News to all races
All nations must praise You
All races must worship You

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Phezu komhlaba ngamazwe ngamazwe,
In this world, there are many nations
Phezu komhlaba zizizwe ngezizwe;
In this world, there are many races/tribes
Apho iintetho zahluka-hlukayo,
That speak different languages
Apho maninz’ amasiko enzwayo.
That practice various traditions

VERSE 2
Kodwa nangona zahluka-hlukayo,
Even though they are different
Kukho indawo zihlangana ngayo;
They agree on one issue
Zonke izizwe zihlel’ ezonweni,
All nations have fallen into sin
Zonke izizwe zotshon’ ekufeni.
All nations are facing destruction

VERSE 3
Apha ngaphantsi uncedo alukho,
Here on earth, no one can bring salvation
Apha ngaphantsi ubomi abukho;
Here on earth, no one can give us life
Phaya phezulu silangazelela,
We yearn and long for heaven
Apho uMncedi wabooni wovela.
Where the Saviour of sinners will come

VERSE 4
Yesu, inguWe onokusindisa,
Jesus, You alone can save us
Yesu, inguWe onokuphilisa;
Jesus, You alone can heal us
Se sithembele kwawaKho amandla,
We trust in Your unmatched Power
Sesibambile esaKho isandla.
We are holding onto Your hand

VERSE 5
Wena, wafela abooni bomhlaba,
You died for all sinners
Wena, wazisa izizwe iindaba;
You brought Good News to all races
Yiba nodumo, kumazwe ngamazwe,
All nations must praise You
Yiba nodumo, kwizizwe ngezizwe.
All races must worship You
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Naantsi nKosi, le ntlangano
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Naantsi nKosi, le ntlangano,
Yeli bandla laKho;
Yithobel’ uMoya waKho,
Ngokwedinga laKho.

VERSE 2
Ababini nabathathu,
Bedibene ngaMi;
Mina Thixo, obaThathu,
Ndoba khona naMi.

VERSE 3
Moya oyiNgcwele yihla,
Hobe laphezulu;
NgobuThixo bakho yiza,
Siqu soPhezulu.

VERSE 4
Moya oyiNgcwele yiza,
Sikhokelwe nguwe;
Solahleka thina sonke,
Siyekelwe nguwe.

VERSE 5
Yihla Moya oyiNgcwele,
Singcwaliswe nguwe;
Iindumiso uzamkele,
Esizenza kuwe.

VERSE 6
Ma siyenze indumiso,
KuThix’ onguYise,
KonguNyana, nonguMoya,
BenguThixo emnye.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Sakumthanda umSindisi
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Sakumthanda umSindisi,
Osithandileyo;
Sohlaziywa ngumNgcwalisi,
Lo amthumileyo.

VERSE 2
Yena wosebenza kuthi
Ngokuqhuba kwakhe;
Asithuthuzele futhi
Ngoku kuza kwakhe.

VERSE 3
Uya kuyikhanyisela
Yonk ingqondo yethu;
Uya kusingcwalisela
Yonk imilo yethu.

VERSE 4
Wosixhasa endleleni,
Asikhaphe sonke;
Siphelele enyhwebeni,
Sidl= uyolo lonke.

VERSE 5
Ma simthande umSindisi,
Sithembele kuYe;
Simamkele umNgcwalisi
Othunyiwe nguYe.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Phakamis iingcinga zethu

lines.translation: Lift our thoughts
Holy Spirit
Let us remember your Mighty works
And proclaim them
The events of the day You descended to be repeated
And Your fire
Must fall on us
Touch our tongues
To proclaim You
Set our hearts on fire
To lift prayers of supplication to You
We await the fulfillment of Your promise
Come, Holy Spirit
Work in us
Come as a raging thunderstorm
Fill the place
Till we feel Your Power
And Your Mighty works
We long for Your descent
Holy Spirit
Hear our prayer
And fall on us

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Phakamis’ iingcinga zethu,
Lift our thoughts
Moya oyiNgcwele;
Holy Spirit
Sikhumbul’ izenzo zakho,
Let us remember your Mighty works
Sizishumayele.
And proclaim them

VERSE 2
Leya mini wehla ngayo,
Ma iphindwe kuthi;
The events of the day You descended to be repeated
Uze lowo mlilo waKho,
And Your fire
Uwe apha kuthi.
Must fall on us

VERSE 3
Chukumis’ iilwimi zethu,
Touch our tongues
Zikushumayele,
To proclaim You
Tshisa nentliziyo zethu,
Set our hearts on fire
Sizithandazele.
To lift prayers of supplication to You

VERSE 4
Ukufezwa kwamadinga,
Sikulinda apha;
We await the fulfillment of Your promise
Yihla, Moya oyiNgcwele,
Come, Holy Spirit
Usebenze apha.
Work in us

VERSE 5
Yiz’ uxela isaqhwithi,
Come as a raging thunderstorm
Uzalis’ indawo;
Fill the place
Size siv’ amandla aKho,
Till we feel Your Power
Kwa nokwenza kwaKho.
And Your Mighty works

VERSE 6
Sinxhamel’ ukuhla kwaKho,
We long for Your descent
Moya oyiNgcwele;
Holy Spirit
Yiva umthandazo wethu,
Hear our prayer
Uze usihlele.
And fall on us
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Phefumlela, Thixo wethu

lines.translation: Breathe on us, O God
When we pray to You
Create in us new life
Be the light in our path
We can feel Your presence
You are so close to us
We can hear Your voice
Your Spirit speaks to us
Christ, our Divine Advocate
Give us a testifying Spirit
To support us in truth
When tempted to sin
Tolerate us dear Father
When coaxed by the heart
That knows the way, yet leads us astray
When we have no compassionate companion
Help us Holy Comforter
And bid our anxious fears subside

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Phefumlela, Thixo wethu,
Breathe on us, O God
Xa sithandazayo kuWe;
When we pray to You
Sidalel’ ubom’ obutsha,
Create in us new life
Masikhanyiselwe nguWe.
Be the light in our path

VERSE 2
Siya buv’ ubukho baKho,
We can feel Your presence
Ukho ukufuphi kuthi;
You are so close to us
Siya liv’ iliZwi laKho,
We can hear Your voice
Uyatheth’ uMoya waKho.
Your Spirit speaks to us

VERSE 3
Kristu, Mthetheleli wethu,
Christ, our Divine Advocate
Siph’ uMoya onqhinayo,
Give us a testifying Spirit
Asixhase ngenyaniso,
To support us in truth
Xa isoono sihendayo.
When tempted to sin

VERSE 4
Z’usinyamezele Bawo,
Tolerate us dear Father
Sakuxakwa yintliziyo;
When coaxed by the heart
Ethi nok’ indlel’ iyazi,
Ib’ ithanda ukunxaxha.
That knows the way, yet leads us astray

VERSE 5
Xa singenawumb’ umhlobo,
Onokuvelana nathi;
When we have no compassionate companion
Z’ usincede Mthuthuzeli,
Help us Holy Comforter
Kuphel’ izoyiko zethu.
And bid our anxious fears subside
author: Traditional Methodist

title: SineliZwi likaThixo

lines.translation: The Mighty Word of God
Gives us life
We are conscious of our sins
And of the living Saviour
It has reached many nations
And it is still in motion
Many nations far, far away
Await to hear it
Your enemies are defeated
The whole world will be filled
With Your Word, Lord
The rivers of this world
Will delight in it
The children of this world
Will be nourished by Your Word
The wars will end
There will be peace everlasting
Through Your Word, God

lyrics:
VERSE 1
SineliZwi likaThixo,
The Mighty Word of God
Sinobomi ngalo;
Gives us life
Siyazaz’ izoono zethu,
We are conscious of our sins
NomSindisi ngalo.
And of the living Saviour

VERSE 2
Lihambile elo liZwi,
It has reached many nations
Lisahamba lona;
And it is still in motion
Ezo zizwe ezikude,
Many nations far, far away
Zilindele lona.
Await to hear it

VERSE 3
Ziyoyisw’ iintshaba zaKho,
Your enemies are defeated
NgeZwi laKho, nKosi;
Wozalisw’ umhlaba wonke,
The whole world will be filled
NgeZwi laKho, nKosi.
With Your Word, Lord

VERSE 4
Imilambo yelilizwe
The rivers of this world
Yovuyiswa ngalo;
Will delight in it
Abantwana bezi zizwe,
The children of this world
Botyetyiswa ngalo.
Will be nourished by Your Word

VERSE 5
Zakuphel’ iimfazwe zonke,
The wars will end
NgeZwi laKho, Thixo;
Kwakulaw’l’ uxolo lodwa,
There will be peace everlasting
NgeZwi laKho, Thixo.
Through Your Word, God
author: the Power of Your Word, Lord

title: Vuthelani ixilongo

lines.translation: Blow the trumpet, ye His people
The trumpet of the Gospel
Must be sound.
The Gospel vehicle must take off
And reach all nations with Jesus’message.
Blow the trumpet, ye His people
ALL sinners must hear it
Blow the trumpet, ye His people
His Word must be preached
Throughout the world
Nations far, far away
Must come to know it
They must look up to the Saviour
And receive Him

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Vuthelani ixilongo,
Nina bantu baKhe!
Blow the trumpet, ye His people
Ixilongo leZwi laKhe,
The trumpet of the Gospel
Ma lihlokonyiswe.
Must be sound.

VERSE 2
Leyo nqwelo yeZwi laKho,
Ma ihambe yona.
The Gospel vehicle must take off
Kulo lonk’ ilizwe Yesu,
Ma ifike khona.
And reach all nations with Jesus’message.

VERSE 3
Vuthelani ixilongo,
Nina bantu baKhe!
Blow the trumpet, ye His people
Ma liviwe iZwi lalo,
Ngaabo bangabooni.
ALL sinners must hear it

VERSE 4
Vuthelani ixilongo,
Nina bantu baKhe!
Blow the trumpet, ye His people
Lihanjiswe iZwi laKhe,
His Word must be preached
Elizweni lonke.
Throughout the world

VERSE 5
Ezo zizwe ezikude,
Nations far, far away
Ma zilazi lona;
Must come to know it
Zikhangele kuMsindisi,
They must look up to the Saviour
Zimamkele Yena.
And receive Him
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Lizalis idinga laKho

lines.translation: Fulfill Your promise
O God, Lord of truth
Let every nation, every race
Receive the gift of salvation
Every knee should bow before You
Every tongue should confess
That You are the Lord of lords
Reign, reign, Lord Jesus
Only You will bring us joy
Through our rebellion
The world has been corrupted
Behold the land of our forefathers
Forgive the sins of her sons & daughters
Do not unleash Your wrath
Lest it be fatally destroyed
Teach us Lord, not to despise
The teachings of Your Word
Until we have been revived
To accept the truth that comes from You

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Lizalis’ idinga laKho,
Fulfill Your promise
Thixo, Nkosi yenyaniso!
O God, Lord of truth
Zonk’ iintlanga, zonk’ izizwe,
Let every nation, every race
Ma zizuze usindiso.
Receive the gift of salvation

VERSE 2
Amadolo kweli lizwe,
Makagobe phambi kwaKho;
Every knee should bow before You
Zide zithi zonk’ iilwimi,
Every tongue should confess
Ziluxel’ udumo lwaKho.
That You are the Lord of lords

VERSE 3
Law’la, law’la, Nkosi Yesu!
Reign, reign, Lord Jesus
Koza ngaWe ukonwaba;
Only You will bring us joy
Ngeziphithi-phithi zethu,
Through our rebellion
Yonakele imihlaba.
The world has been corrupted

VERSE 4
Bona izwe lakowethu,
Behold the land of our forefathers
Uxolel’ izoono zalo;
Forgive the sins of her sons & daughters
Ungathob’ ingqumbo yaKho,
Do not unleash Your wrath
Luze luf’ usapho lwalo.
Lest it be fatally destroyed

VERSE 5
Yaala, Nkosi singadeli
Teach us Lord, not to despise
Iimfundiso zeZwi laKho;
The teachings of Your Word
Uze usivuselele,
Until we have been revived
Sive inyaniso yaKho.
To accept the truth that comes from You
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Lizwi linamandla

lines.translation: Thou whose Almighty Word, chaos and darkness heard, and took their flight
Hear us, we humbly pray, may it bring about, the light!
You, who brought on Your redeeming wing, healing and sight
Health to the sick in the mind, sight to the blind, O now to all mankind, let there be light!
Spirit of truth and love, Life-giving, holy dove, take flight
Spreading the beams of grace, and in earth’s darkest place, let there be light!
Holy Three, blessed and glorious Trinity; Merciful God
Love boundless as oceans tide, rolling in fullest pride; declare in Your Might: Let there be light!

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Lizwi linamandla, liviwa bumnyama, Bubaleke.
Thou whose Almighty Word, chaos and darkness heard, and took their flight
Siyakubongoza, ngeli Lizwi laKho,
Langa lingazisa, ukhanyiso.
Hear us, we humbly pray, may it bring about, the light!

VERSE 2
Wena wezisayo ngamaphiko aKho, impiliso.
You, who brought on Your redeeming wing, healing and sight
Kwaabo baf’ ingqondo, nakwabazimfama;
Yithi kubo bonke, Ma kukhanye.
Health to the sick in the mind, sight to the blind, O now to all mankind, let there be light!

VERSE 3
Moya wenyaniso, Hobe lobungcwele, Phaphazela.
Spirit of truth and love, Life-giving, holy dove, take flight
Wanqumle amanzi kwand’ ufefe lwaKho;
Kuyo lentsunguzi, Ma kukhanye.
Spreading the beams of grace, and in earth’s darkest place, let there be light!

VERSE 4
Mtriniti ongcwele, ozukekileyo; Solufefe.
Holy Three, blessed and glorious Trinity; Merciful God
Luthand’ olukhulu, lwambes’ izwe lonke;
Yithi ngamandl’ aKho, Ma kukhanye.
Love boundless as oceans tide, rolling in fullest pride; declare in Your Might: Let there be light!
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bonani! bonani! bonani!
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bonani! bonani! bonani!
Kuvulwa ucango lwezulu.
Yivani! yivani! yivani!
Kwavel’ intlokoma enkulu.

VERSE 2
Lobalwa ngubani inani
Labemi entlanganisweni?
Bebonga uthando lweMvana,
Egazi likhuph’ etyaleni.

VERSE 3
Yivani amazwi eculo!
Amazwi avel’ ezulwini,
Avunywa ziithunywa zezulu,
Asel’ evakel’ ezizweni.

VERSE 4
Udumo, nombongo, namandla,
Alunge kwiMvana yedini;
Egazi lihlamb’ amabandla,
Angene emhloph’ ezulwini.

VERSE 5
Vuyani! vuyani! vuyani!
Mabandla asesemhlabeni;
Bongani! bongani! bongani!
Nje ngabasebungcwaliseni.

VERSE 6
Kubizwa kwa nathi phezulu,
Sandis’ amabandl’ aabangcwele,
Kuviwe nelethu iculo
Elingasokuze liphele.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Sibizelwe enyhwebeni

lines.translation: God has called us, blessings await us
Spread the Word
To everybody
Declare that we need to repent
Declare that we need to forsake our wayward lifestyles
The worldly pleasures
Have deceived us
True joy is and has always been found in Christ
Divine grace & peace is on offer
Unconditional love, undeserved blessings
Life in abundance

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Sibizelwe enyhwebeni
Thina bantu sonke;
God has called us, blessings await us
Izwi livakaliseni
Spread the Word
Emhlabeni wonke.
To everybody

VERSE 2
Kuthwa, ma siphume sonke
Ezonweni zethu:
Declare that we need to repent
Kuthwa, ma siyeke konke
Ukugeza kwethu.
Declare that we need to forsake our wayward lifestyles

VERSE 3
Imihlali yangaphantsi,
The worldly pleasures
Isikhohlisile;
Have deceived us
Eyeyenyaniso, naantsi!
Kade ilungile.
True joy is and has always been found in Christ

VERSE 4
Naal' ufefe, naal' uxolo,
Lolwasezulwini;
Divine grace & peace is on offer
Naal' uthando, naal' uyolo,
Unconditional love, undeserved blessings
Lolwasebomini.
Life in abundance
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kukh iindlela ezimbini
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Kukh’ iindlela ezimbini,
Okuhanjwa ngazo apha;
Enye iya ekufeni,
Enye iya ebomini.

VERSE 2
Leyo iya ekufeni,
Igudile, intle kambe;
Iyahanjwa ngabaninzi,
Besenziwa kuyithanda.

VERSE 3
Bephikele leyo ndlela,
Ngobudenge nokumatha;
Boda bazintywilisele,
Ebubuni baphakade.

VERSE 4
Enye incinyane yona,
Inamatye, inameva;
Iyahanjwa ngabambalwa,
Ngenxa yobunzima bayo.

VERSE 5
Kanti iba mnandi noko,
Kwaabo bayiqhelileyo;
Kuba iya ekhayeni,
Elo balinxhameleyo.

VERSE 6
Iya ebungcwaliseni,
Iya ekukhazimleni;
Iya kuMkhululi wabo,
Iya eNkosini yabo.

VERSE 7
Ma nizame le indlela,
Nakuba inzima njalo;
Kuba yona iyaphelela,
Kumihlali neziyolo.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Buyani! Buyani!
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Buyani! Buyani!
Buyani ke booni!
Yizani! Yizani!
Nibuba ngani na? H

VERSE 2
Funani ngexesha,
Funan' uYehova,
Naanku ke sel' ekho:
Nibuba ngani na?

VERSE 3
Nisalindele ni?
Nisalindele ni?
Naanku nje sel' emi:
Nibuba ngani na?

VERSE 4
YiMvana yezulu,
Eyafel' uluntu,
Naasi isitshaba:
Nibuba ngani na?

VERSE 5
Naal' ihlokondiba,
Naazo izithunywa,
Zilindele nina:
Nibuba ngani na?

VERSE 6
Kothanda-buzayo
Ilishwa! Ilishwa!
Koqhanqalazayo
Ukufa! Ukufa!
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Naanku ndimi ndinkqonkqoza

lines.translation: Behold me standing at the door of your heart, sinner
With a gentle & tender voice, I plead:
May I come in? May come in?
I standing at the door, knocking
Patiently, pleading with you
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
May I come in? May come in?
I endured the cruel wounds of crucifiction
All for you, LOSER!!!
May I come in? May come in?
I standing at the door, knocking
Patiently, pleading with you
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
May I come in? May come in?
I bore the pain of the cross
I was laid in a tomb
All of that to bring you joy
May I come in? May come in?
I standing at the door, knocking
Patiently, pleading with you
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
May I come in? May come in?
I bring you peace, that surpasses all understanding
I bring you joy from heaven above
To relieve you of the anxiety of sin
May I enter? May I enter?
I standing at the door, knocking
Patiently, pleading with you
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
May I enter? May I enter?
I am a friend, I am the Life
I am the Shield, I am the Rock
That you can find refuge in
May I come in? May come in?
I standing at the door, knocking
Patiently, pleading with you
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
May I come in? May come in?
Time is running out
Your day is almost over
You’re heading for destruction, still
May I come in? May come in?
I standing at the door, knocking
Patiently, pleading with you
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
May I come in? May come in?

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Naanku ndimi ndinkqonkqoza,
Kolu cango lwakho mooni,
Behold me standing at the door of your heart, sinner
Ngelithambiley’ ilizwi:
With a gentle & tender voice, I plead:
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 2
Chorus
Ndim’emnyango ndinkqonkqoza,
I standing at the door, knocking
Ndimi ndicenga ngomonde,
Patiently, pleading with you
Uthi ni moon’ olusizi
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 3
Ndawanyamezela mina
Amanxeb’ okubethelwa,
I endured the cruel wounds of crucifiction
Ngenxa yakho mgqithi ndini:
All for you, LOSER!!!
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 4
Chorus
Ndim’emnyango ndinkqonkqoza,
I standing at the door, knocking
Ndimi ndicenga ngomonde,
Patiently, pleading with you
Uthi ni moon’ olusizi
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 5
Ndev’ iintlungu zomnqamlezo,
I bore the pain of the cross
Ndalala nasenchwabeni;
