I was laid in a tomb
Ndizond’ ukonwaba kwakho:
All of that to bring you joy
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 6
Chorus
Ndim’emnyango ndinkqonkqoza,
I standing at the door, knocking
Ndimi ndicenga ngomonde,
Patiently, pleading with you
Uthi ni moon’ olusizi
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 7
Ndiza ndinoxolo lwakho,
I bring you peace, that surpasses all understanding
Ndiza nokonwaba kwakho,
I bring you joy from heaven above
Wen’ unamaxhal’ ezoono:
To relieve you of the anxiety of sin
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I enter? May I enter?

VERSE 8
Chorus
Ndim’emnyango ndinkqonkqoza,
I standing at the door, knocking
Ndimi ndicenga ngomonde,
Patiently, pleading with you
Uthi ni moon’ olusizi
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I enter? May I enter?

VERSE 9
Ndingumhlobo, ndibubomi,
I am a friend, I am the Life
Ndilikhaka, ndililiwa,
I am the Shield, I am the Rock
Ongazinqabisa kulo:
That you can find refuge in
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 10
Chorus
Ndim’emnyango ndinkqonkqoza,
I standing at the door, knocking
Ndimi ndicenga ngomonde,
Patiently, pleading with you
Uthi ni moon’ olusizi
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 11
Yemka ke imini yakho,
Time is running out
Latshona ilanga lakho,
Your day is almost over
Usesendlelen’ yembubo:
You’re heading for destruction, still
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?

VERSE 12
Chorus
Ndim’emnyango ndinkqonkqoza,
I standing at the door, knocking
Ndimi ndicenga ngomonde,
Patiently, pleading with you
Uthi ni moon’ olusizi
What’s it gonna be, woeful sinner?
Ndingene na? ndingene na?
May I come in? May come in?
author: Traditional Methodist

title: UYesu uya sibiza
lyrics:
VERSE 1
UYesu uya sibiza,
Singabahilizayo;
Usicenga yonk’ imihla,
“Yiza undilandele”.

VERSE 2
Beva aabo bakudala,
Kwelo laseGalili;
Bawancama amakhaya abo,
Basuka bamlandela.

VERSE 3
NguYesu osibizayo,
Sikhonza okwelizwe;
Esithi kwabavumayo,
“Ndilandeleni nani”.

VERSE 4
Kwezo ntsizi neziyolo,
Esizivayo thina;
Nakwiimbandezelo zethu,
Sifanel’ ukumthanda.

VERSE 5
Ngazo izibele zaKhe,
Usicengela kuYe;
Ma simnike intliziyo,
Zibe lidini kuYe.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Thixo onguSo-mandla

lines.translation: Lord God Almighty
Lead me out of Egypt
With Your Mighty arm, walk with me, carry me
Lord set me free from the Egypt of sin
In all that resembles sin, Lord release me
As I am about to cross the Red Sea
Let me see stand still & see Your salvation
The cloud to cover me
With a holy radiance
In the long journey through the dessert
Accompany me with the Shekinah
In times of starvation and temptation
Feed me with the manna
When snake bites threaten to kill me
Let me look up to You
As I am tempted time and time again
Let me put my trust in You alone
When I reach the shores of Jordaan
Help me sail across to Cannan
My eternal home

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thixo onguSo-mandla,
Lord God Almighty
Ndikhuphe eJiphethe,
Lead me out of Egypt
Ngengalo enamandla,
Ndikhaphe, undiphathe.
With Your Mighty arm, walk with me, carry me

VERSE 2
KwiJiphethe yesoono,
So-Mandla ndihlangule,
Lord set me free from the Egypt of sin
Kwisimo esesoono,
Yehova ndikhulule.
In all that resembles sin, Lord release me

VERSE 3
Kolubomvu ulwandle,
As I am about to cross the Red Sea
Ma ndibon’ usindiso;
Let me see stand still & see Your salvation
Ilifu lindiphahle,
The cloud to cover me
Ngengcwele inkanyiso.
With a holy radiance

VERSE 4
Ebudeni bentlango,
In the long journey through the dessert
Ndikhaphe Ngeekina;
Accompany me with the Shekinah
Kwiindlala nezilingo,
In times of starvation and temptation
Ndixhase ngaloo mana.
Feed me with the manna

VERSE 5
Kubuhlungu beenyoka,
When snake bites threaten to kill me
Ma ndikhangele kuWe;
Let me look up to You
Kwiinzingo zeminyaka,
As I am tempted time and time again
Ma ndithembele kuWe.
Let me put my trust in You alone

VERSE 6
Ndakufik’ eJordane,
When I reach the shores of Jordaan
Ndiwezele phesheya;
Ndiwelel’ eKanana,
Help me sail across to Cannan
Eliphezul’ ikhaya.
My eternal home
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bawo, ngobubele baKho

lines.translation: Father, have mercy on me,
I am in tears before You
Take all my sins away
Here I am before You
Please do not reject my plea
I am asking for forgiveness
Take all my sins away
Lord, I haven’t had enough
Hear my cry
You will not refuse me
Take all my sins away
Lord, Father, I am dirty
Cleanse my heart
I am regretful
Take all my sins away

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bawo, ngobubele baKho,
Bona umphefumlo wam;
Father, have mercy on me,
Ndiya lila phambi kwaKho,
I am in tears before You
Susa zonk’ izoono zam.
Take all my sins away

VERSE 2
Ndikho ebusweni baKho,
Here I am before You
Z’ungalahli izwi lam;
Please do not reject my plea
Ndiphe uxolele lwaKho,
I am asking for forgiveness
Susa zonk’ izoono zam.
Take all my sins away

VERSE 3
Nkosi yam, andikaneli,
Lord, I haven’t had enough
Yiva ukubiza kwam;
Hear my cry
Wen’ ungendibandezeli;
You will not refuse me
Susa zonk’ izoono zam.
Take all my sins away

VERSE 4
Nkosi, bawo, ndincholile,
Lord, Father, I am dirty
Hlaanza intliziyo yam;
Cleanse my heart
Ngezi zoono ndidanile,
I am regretful
Susa zonk’ izoono zam.
Take all my sins away
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Udiniwe Utyafile
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Udiniwe? Utyafile?
Unobubi na?
“Yiza kum,” kukh’ otshoyo,
Uphumle.

VERSE 2
Unawo na amanxeba,
UMkhokeli wam?
Bon’ iinyawo kwanezandla,
Necala.

VERSE 3
Unaso na isitsaba,
Kwintloko yaKhe?
Ewe, unas’ isitsaba
Sameva.

VERSE 4
Xa ndifikileyo kuYe,
Ndozuza ntoni na?
Awu! Usizi, Awu! Ububi,
Neentlungu.

VERSE 5
Xa ndizingisayo kuYe,
Ndoba yini na?
Wondixhasa andiweze,
EJordan.

VERSE 6
Xa ndithi ma kandamkele,
Angandaala na?
Hayi! ‘de kudlul’ izulu,
Nomhlaba.

VERSE 7
Ndakuba sendimfumene,
Wondichasa na?
Onke amanqhina athi:
“Nakanye”.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Akwaba se ndivuma, Nangentliziyo yami

lines.translation: If I could it in my heart to confess
To repent from and forsake my ungodly lifestyle
And embark on a journey that leads to salvation
If I could feel the internal distress
That will direct me to repentance
It follows the road that leads to Joy - Devine
If I could have the faith that cheers me on
And hold on to the One that died for my sins
And always put my trust in my Redeemer
If I could have the Devine strength
To be able to resist the worldly temptations, and look up to heaven
Restore me O God, save me from evil

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Akwaba se ndivuma, Nangentliziyo yami;
If I could it in my heart to confess
Ukwahlukana nayo, Inkohlakalo yami.
To repent from and forsake my ungodly lifestyle
Ndisuke ndiye kuYe, OnguMsindisi wami.
And embark on a journey that leads to salvation

VERSE 2
Akwaba ndinokuva, Usizi emoyeni,
If I could feel the internal distress
Olona lusingisa, Kwa seluguqukweni,
That will direct me to repentance
Luhamba ngaloo ndlela
Iphela emgcobeni.
It follows the road that leads to Joy - Devine

VERSE 3
Akwaba ndinokholo Luqhub’ umxhelo wami.
If I could have the faith that cheers me on
Ndibambelele kuYe, Ofel’ ityala lami,
And hold on to the One that died for my sins
Ndihlale ndithembela
Kuloo Mhlaw’leli wami.
And always put my trust in my Redeemer

VERSE 4
Akwaba ndinamandla, Avela eNkosini,
If I could have the Devine strength
Ndikwale okomhlaba, Ndibeke ezulwini.
To be able to resist the worldly temptations, and look up to heaven
Ndivuselele, Thixo, Ndiphume ebubini.
Restore me O God, save me from evil
author: Traditional Methodist

Elaphalazwa ngenxa yam:

Se ndisiza, se ndisiza.
O Lamb of God I come, I come

VERSE 2
Ndiza ndingento yalutho
As destitute as I am I come
Ndize kuhlanjwa nguLowo,
I’ve come to be cleansed by the One
Onamandla okuhlamba:
Who has the power to cleanse
Se ndisiza, se ndisiza.
O Lamb of God I come, I come

VERSE 3
Ndiza ndingento yalutho
As destitute as I am I come
Ndingoyimfama zizoono,

Ndize kuzivuma kuWe:

Se ndisiza, se ndisiza.
O Lamb of God I come, I come

VERSE 4
Ndiza ndingento yalutho,
As destitute as I am I come
Ndizele yintanda-buzo;
I am doubtful
Noko ndinoko koyika:
Even though I am terrified
Se ndisiza, se ndisiza.
O Lamb of God I come, I come

Ndiza ndingento yalutho,
As destitute as I am I come
Ndize kucela uxolo,
I’ve come to ask for forgiveness
Ndize kufun’ inkululo:
I long to be set free
Se ndisiza, se ndisiza.
O Lamb of God I come, I come

VERSE 6
Ndiza ndingento yalutho,
As destitute as I am I come
Se nditsalwa lolo thando,
Drawn by that free love
Endandingalwazi mina:
That can never be measured
Se ndisiza, se ndisiza.
O Lamb of God I come, I come

Ntat’ a rona ea ma |holimong,

bubukhulu bobungcwalisa baKho.

baxolele, ubamkele,

title: Hay ukuba nzima kwamatyala am

lines.translation: I am heavy laden with my sins
That I have because of my sinful nature
They have caused all my misfortunes
They have rewarded me with death

lines.primary: Taru, taru Nkosi, taru, taru Kristu.
lines.translation: Pardon me Lord, Pardon me Christ.
My efforts have not helped me at all
My mistakes have tied me up
God’s own Son, substituted me
Suffered and died for my sins

lines.primary: Taru, taru Nkosi, taru, taru Kristu.
lines.translation: Pardon me Lord, Pardon me Christ.
If my Deliverer had not come
If He had not died for my sins
I would have had to endure my punishment
And curses from God

lines.primary: Taru, taru Nkosi, taru, taru Kristu.
lines.translation: Pardon me Lord, Pardon me Christ.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Hay’ ukuba nzima kwamatyala am,
I am heavy laden with my sins
Endinawo mina ngokuvela kwam;
That I have because of my sinful nature
Andingenisile emashweni am,
They have caused all my misfortunes
Wona abangile konk’ ukufa kwam.
They have rewarded me with death
Taru, taru Nkosi, taru, taru Kristu.
Pardon me Lord, Pardon me Christ.

VERSE 2
Andincedekanga ngumsebenzi wam
My efforts have not helped me at all
Ndibanjiwe kanye ziziphoso zam.
My mistakes have tied me up
OkaThix’ unyana, endaweni yam,
God’s own Son, substituted me
Weva ubunzima, wafa ngenxa yam.
Suffered and died for my sins
Taru, taru Nkosi, taru, taru Kristu.
Pardon me Lord, Pardon me Christ.

VERSE 3
Xa ebengezanga uMkhululi wam,
If my Deliverer had not come
Xa engafelanga amatyala am
If He had not died for my sins
Nge ndiba ndithwala ukubethwa kwam,
I would have had to endure my punishment
Neziqalekiso zikaThixo wam.
And curses from God
Taru, taru Nkosi, taru, taru Kristu.
Pardon me Lord, Pardon me Christ.
author: Traditional Methodist

lines.translation: I am guilty as charged
I am a sinner before You,
I despised Your Word with all of my heart
I neglected Your precepts through my mischief
But now I come to You, Do not ignore my tears
I am hear, for You have called me, Hear my lamentation
Father, I run to You, be my Saviour
I confess my transgressions before You
I am bowing at Your feet, in penitent prayer
Asking for Your pardon, pardon me My Lord!

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndingumooni phambi kwaKho,
I am guilty as charged
Ndinetyala, Thixo wam!
I am a sinner before You,
Ndalidela iZwi laKho
Futhi entliz’yweni yam.
I despised Your Word with all of my heart
Ndaala imithetho yaKho,
Ngabo ubugeza bam.
I neglected Your precepts through my mischief

VERSE 2
Kodwa ngoku ndiza kuWe,
Bona iinyembezi zam,
But now I come to You, Do not ignore my tears
Ndiza ndibiziwe nguWe,
Yiva ukulila kwam,
I am hear, for You have called me, Hear my lamentation
Bawo, ndinxhamele kuWe,
Yiba unguMncedi wam.
Father, I run to You, be my Saviour

VERSE 3
Ndizixela phambi kwaKho
Zonk’ iinkohlakalo zam,
I confess my transgressions before You
Ndiwe eenyaweni zaKho
Ekuthandazeni kwam.
I am bowing at Your feet, in penitent prayer
Ndilifun’ itaru laKho,
Taru! Taru! Nkosi yam!
Asking for Your pardon, pardon me My Lord!
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nkosi! Ndive ngezibele

lines.translation: Lord! I’ve heard of showers of mercy
Of blessings, of life
That You pour out
Let the drops fall on me, fall on me
Pass me not, Lord, Father
Don’t forsake me my Lord
I am a sinner
Nevertheless, come to me, come to me
Pass me not gentle Saviour
Do not forsake me, my Lord
You are calling, I am yearning
Call me, so I can come, I can come
Pass me not, Holy Spirit
Don’t leave me, my Lord
Open my eyes
Speak the Word unto me, unto me
Your unconditional love, O God
Your precious blood, my Lord
All your tender mercies
Must abide in me, in me

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nkosi! Ndive ngezibele,
Lord! I’ve heard of showers of mercy
Ezesisa, ezobom;
Of blessings, of life
Ozigalelayo Wena,
That You pour out
Ma zifike zize kum
Zize kum.
Let the drops fall on me, fall on me

VERSE 2
Ndingadlulwa Nkosi, Bawo!
Pass me not, Lord, Father
Ndingashiywa, Nkosi yam!
Don’t forsake me my Lord
Ndinezoono entliz’yweni,
I am a sinner
Kodwa noko yiza kum,
Yiza kum.
Nevertheless, come to me, come to me

VERSE 3
Ndingadlulwa Musindisi!
Pass me not gentle Saviour
Ndingalahlwa, Nkosi yam!
Do not forsake me, my Lord
Uya biza ndiya nqwena,
You are calling, I am yearning
Z’undibize ndize nam,
Ndize nam.
Call me, so I can come, I can come

VERSE 4
Ndingadlulwa, Moy’ oNgcwele!
Pass me not, Holy Spirit
Ndingashiywa, Nkosi yam!
Don’t leave me, my Lord
Mandibone mina mfama,
Open my eyes
Theth’ iliZwi phezu kwam,
Phezu kwam.
Speak the Word unto me, unto me

VERSE 5
Olo thando lwakho, Thixo!
Your unconditional love, O God
Elo gazi, Nkosi yam!
Your precious blood, my Lord
Izibele zaKho zonke,
All your tender mercies
Ma zihlale apha kum.
Apha kum.
Must abide in me, in me
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bawo! Ndingumntwana waKho

lines.translation: Father, I am Your child
Even though I have sinned
I come to you in tears
Father, forgive me
My transgressions are countless
Nevertheless, I come to You
Father, forgive me
I broke all the rules
I despised You
I abandoned the Saviour
Father, forgive me
I have sinned through my speech
I have sinned through my thoughts
I even sinned through my actions
Father, forgive me
Although I was supposed to thank You
I have sinned by forgetting You
Father, forgive me
Through my countless sins
Father, I have ruined my chances
I have disgraced You
Father, forgive me
You are the generous and merciful God
That is why I cry out to You saying:
Father, forgive me

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bawo! Ndingumntwana waKho,
Father, I am Your child
Noko ndonileyo;
Even though I have sinned
Ndiya lila phambi kwaKho,
I come to you in tears
Bawo! ndixolele.
Father, forgive me

VERSE 2
Iziphoso zam zininzi,
Azinakubalwa;
My transgressions are countless
Noko ndibekise kuWe,
Nevertheless, I come to You
Bawo! ndixolele.
Father, forgive me

VERSE 3
Imithetho ndiyaphule,
I broke all the rules
Wena ndakudela;
I despised You
UMsindisi ndimlahlile,
I abandoned the Saviour
Bawo! ndixolele.
Father, forgive me

VERSE 4
Ndone ngako ukuthetha,
I have sinned through my speech
Ndone nangeengcinga;
I have sinned through my thoughts
Ndone nangemisebenzi,
I even sinned through my actions
Bawo! ndixolele.
Father, forgive me

VERSE 5
Noko ndibe ndifanele,
Ukukubulela;
Although I was supposed to thank You
Ndone ngokukulibala,
I have sinned by forgetting You
Bawo! ndixolele.
Father, forgive me

VERSE 6
Ngaz’ izoono ezininzi,
Through my countless sins
Bawo, ndizonele;
Father, I have ruined my chances
Wena ndikuhlazisile,
I have disgraced You
Bawo! ndixolele.
Father, forgive me

VERSE 7
UnguThixo onenceba,
Engazang’ iphele;
You are the generous and merciful God
Ngako ndiyalila, ndithi:
That is why I cry out to You saying:
“Bawo! ndixolele.”
Father, forgive me
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nje ngoko ndinjalo, nKosi

lines.translation: Just as I am, Lord
I trust You and You alone
You are the One who has called me
Lord I come, Lord I come
There is no other remedy
That can cure sin
You alone can purify me
Lord I come, Lord I come
I am overwhelmed by my struggles
I am doubtful
I am fearful
Lord I come, Lord I come
I am needy, I am blind
I am spiritually dead
You alone can satisfy me
Lord I come, Lord I come
As I am You will accept me
You will forgive me and give me joy
Just as You have promised
Lord I come, Lord I come
That free and immeasurable love, Lord
Has caused me to give up on myself
I surrender my life to You, Lord, let me be Yours
Lord I come, Lord I come
I want to experience the depth of Your love in this life
You will fulfill it when we meet in heaven
Lord I come, Lord I come

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nje ngoko ndinjalo, nKosi,
Just as I am, Lord
Ndithembele kuWe wedwa;
I trust You and You alone
NguWe ondibizileyo,
You are the One who has called me
Kungoko ndizayo.
Lord I come, Lord I come

VERSE 2
Akukho limbi icebo
There is no other remedy
Lokuhlambulul’ isoono;
That can cure sin
Nguw’ ongandicokisayo,
You alone can purify me
Kungoko ndizayo.
Lord I come, Lord I come

VERSE 3
Ndiphakathi kwamadabi
I am overwhelmed by my struggles
Andithanda-buzisayo;
I am doubtful
Andibangel’ ukoyika,
I am fearful
Kungoko ndizayo.
Lord I come, Lord I come

VERSE 4
Ndilihlwempu, ndiyimfama,
I am needy, I am blind
Andiphili ngeenxa zonke;
I am spiritually dead
Nguw’ onokundanelisa,
You alone can satisfy me
Kungoko ndizayo.
Lord I come, Lord I come

VERSE 5
Ndingonje ke, wondamkela,
As I am You will accept me
Uxolele, uvuyise,
You will forgive me and give me joy
Ngokwesakh’ isithembiso,
Just as You have promised
Kungoko ndizayo.
Lord I come, Lord I come

VERSE 6
Olo thando lwaKho, nKosi,
That free and immeasurable love, Lord
Lundincamisile kanye;
Has caused me to give up on myself
Ma ndibe ngowaKho, nKosi
I surrender my life to You, Lord, let me be Yours
Kungoko ndizayo.
Lord I come, Lord I come

VERSE 7
Ubunzulu bolu thando,
Ma ndibuve ndiselapha,
I want to experience the depth of Your love in this life
Ze ndifezelw’ ezulwini,
You will fulfill it when we meet in heaven
Kungoko ndizayo.
Lord I come, Lord I come
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nkosi, Thixo ufihliwe

lines.translation: Lord, God, You are out of reach
Even though I am yearning for You
You haven’t been revealed to me, though I so desire
I am a sinner, indeed
I am guilty as charged
I have been full of mischief
Despite knowing Your Word
My heart rejected You
It was full of pride
For You called me, and I refused to come
I pretended I was deaf
Please, don’t disown me
Even though I did the same to You

lines.primary: Ndothi ni na, ndoya phi na,
lines.translation: What will I say, where will I go
If I am rejected by You?
Pardon me Lord! I have sinned against You
I despised Your Word
My soul has fallen into sin
Pardon me! Have mercy on me.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nkosi, Thixo ufihliwe
Lord, God, You are out of reach
Noko ndikugulelayo;
Even though I am yearning for You
Akubonakalisiwe
Kumi, noko ndifunayo.
You haven’t been revealed to me, though I so desire

VERSE 2
Ndinezoono okunene,
I am a sinner, indeed
Ndinetyala phambi kwaKho;
I am guilty as charged
Ndandinobumene-mene,
I have been full of mischief
Noko ndandinezwi laKho.
Despite knowing Your Word

VERSE 3
Intliziyo yamangala,
My heart rejected You
Yaanekrhatshi elikhulu;
It was full of pride
Oko wandibiza, ndaala,
For You called me, and I refused to come
Ndandizenza isithulu.
I pretended I was deaf

VERSE 4
Ma ungandilahli mina,
Please, don’t disown me
Noko ndenje njalo kuWe;
Even though I did the same to You
Ndothi ni na, ndoya phi na,
What will I say, where will I go
Xa ndilahliweyo nguWe?
If I am rejected by You?

VERSE 5
Taru! nKosi, ndikonile,
Pardon me Lord! I have sinned against You
Be ndidela izwi laKho;
I despised Your Word
Umphefumlo wam uwile,
My soul has fallen into sin
Taru! ngobubele baKho.
Pardon me! Have mercy on me.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yesu! Wena ungumhlobo

lines.translation: Jesus! You are the friend
The soul mate
I come to You asking for help
Help my sinful heart
I have no other hope
That I can hold on to
I have no other refuge
That I can run into
I present myself before You, Lord
I am a lonely sinner
My only hope is in Your mighty acts of love and grace
You alone are the Fountain of Life
Where all sinners can be cleansed
Cleanse my heart
Sanctify it
Make it right, purify it
Make it blameless

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yesu! Wena ungumhlobo,
Jesus! You are the friend
Umhlobo womphefumlo;
The soul mate
Ndiza kuWe undincede,
I come to You asking for help
Uncede le ntliziyo
Help my sinful heart

VERSE 2
Themba limbi andinalo,
I have no other hope
Endingabamba lona;
That I can hold on to
Nqaba yimbi andinayo,
I have no other refuge
Endingangena kuyo.
That I can run into

VERSE 3
Ndizibika kuWe nKosi,
I present myself before You, Lord
Ndiyintw’ engenamhlobo;
I am a lonely sinner
Ndithembela kumsebenzi,
Wothando lwaKho lodwa.
My only hope is in Your mighty acts of love and grace

VERSE 4
NguWe wedwa ongumthombo,
Umthombo wab’ ubomi;
You alone are the Fountain of Life
Apho bangahlamba khona
Abangabooni bonke.
Where all sinners can be cleansed

VERSE 5
Hlamba le ntliziyo yami,
Cleanse my heart
Uyenze ngcwele yona,
Sanctify it
Yilungise, yicokise,
Make it right, purify it
Uyenze msulwa yona.
Make it blameless
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yesu, bendikulahlile

lines.translation: Jesus, I had deserted You
Even though You have died for me!
But, today I am regretful
Take me back again
I am not worthy of Your grace
But, what will I do?
Take me back again
My sins are higher than the mountain
I am lifting my eyes to the hills
Take me back again
All that I’ve done is evil, I am remorseful
My Lord, I am for real
Take me back again
Lord Jesus, I am weeping, have mercy on me
I am weeping for my sin
Take me back again

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yesu, bendikulahlile,
Jesus, I had deserted You
Noko wabe undifele!
Even though You have died for me!
Kodwa namhla ndidanile,
But, today I am regretful
Ma uphinde undamkele.
Take me back again

VERSE 2
Andisafanele mina,
Ukwenzelwa izibele;
I am not worthy of Your grace
Koko ndiya kuthi ni na?
But, what will I do?
Ma uphinde undamkele.
Take me back again

VERSE 3
Ndinezoono ezikhulu,
My sins are higher than the mountain
Namhla zindibandezele;
T…
Ndikhangele ngaphezulu,
I am lifting my eyes to the hills
Ma uphinde undamkele.
Take me back again

VERSE 4
Konke endikwenzileyo,
Kubi kum, ndikudanele.
All that I’ve done is evil, I am remorseful
Nkosi yam, ndinyanisile;
My Lord, I am for real
Ma uphinde undamkele.
Take me back again

VERSE 5
Nkosi, Yesu, ndiya khala,
Naanku ndikukhedamele;
Lord Jesus, I am weeping, have mercy on me
Ndililel’ elam ityala,
I am weeping for my sin
Ma uphinde undamkele.
Take me back again
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Amahlathi aphelile

lines.translation: My treasures have been eroded
Nobody wants to be associated with me
I have nothing, I don’t know where to go
I will set out and go to my Father
I’ll say to him: “Father
Indeed I have sinned against you
Take me back again
I don’t deserve to be your child

lines.primary: Ndothi ni na, ndoya phi na?
lines.translation: What will I do, where will I go?
Take me back again
Make me your household servant
So at least I can see you everyday
Take me back again
I have done you wrong
I shut you out
But as I come back
Take me back again
Take me back again
I come just as I am
Take me back again
O merciful Father
Don’t chase me away
Even though I am a hobo
Take me back again

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Amahlathi aphelile,
My treasures have been eroded
Andisafunwa mntu;
Nobody wants to be associated with me
Ndilambile, ndikhohliwe,
Apho ndingayayo.
I have nothing, I don’t know where to go

VERSE 2
Ndosuka ndiye kuBawo,
I will set out and go to my Father
Ndithi kuye: “Bawo,
I’ll say to him: “Father
Okunene ndikonile,
Indeed I have sinned against you
Buya undamkele.”
Take me back again

VERSE 3
“Andisafanele kanye,
Ukubizwa ngaWe;
I don’t deserve to be your child
Ndothi ni na, ndoya phi na?
What will I do, where will I go?
Buya undamkele.”
Take me back again

VERSE 4
“Uz’ undenze isicaka
Sasendlwini yaKho,
Make me your household servant
Ze ndihlale ndikubona;
So at least I can see you everyday
Buya undamkele.”
Take me back again

VERSE 5
“NguWe endikonileyo
I have done you wrong
Ndakutshikilela,
I shut you out
Kodwa ngoku ndibuyayo;
But as I come back
Buya undamkele.”
Take me back again

VERSE 6
“Ubujacu endibubo
Buya bonwa nguWe,
Take me back again
Noko se ndisiza nabo;
I come just as I am
Buya undamkele.”
Take me back again

VERSE 7
“Bawo onenceba kanye,
O merciful Father
Uz’ ungandigxothi,
Don’t chase me away
Noko ndiliyaka-yaka,
Even though I am a hobo
Buya undamkele.”
Take me back again
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Hayi! Umntu endinguye

lines.translation: Woe! The kind of person I am
Behold, my destruction is imminent
Anxieties have taken over
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!
I am a nobody
I throw myself at Your feet
You are my only hope
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!
My weapons have fallen
The devil has robbed me
Behold, I am standing, folding my hands
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!
You, the friend of criminals
Come now, lift me up
As you did with ancient one (on the cross)
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!
If You forsake me
I will be spilt like water
Evil will kill me
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!
Carry me, always, in Your merciful hands
I throw myself at Your feet
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Hayi! Umntu endinguye,
Woe! The kind of person I am
Naaku se nditshabalala;
Behold, my destruction is imminent
Se kuvuke namaxhala,
Anxieties have taken over
Nkosi, Yesu, ndiphuthume.
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!

VERSE 2
Ndiludwayi olungento,
I am a nobody
Se ndizilahlela kuWe,
I throw myself at Your feet
Kuba ndingathembe lutho,
You are my only hope
Nkosi, Yesu, ndiphuthume.
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!

VERSE 3
Izixhobo zam ziwile,
My weapons have fallen
Zithathiwe ngusathana.
The devil has robbed me
Naaku se ndisong’ izandla,
Behold, I am standing, folding my hands
Nkosi, Yesu, ndiphuthume.
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!

VERSE 4
Wena mhlobo wamabada,
You, the friend of criminals
Yiza ngoku undichole,
Come now, lift me up
Kwa njengelo lakudala;
As you did with ancient one (on the cross)
Nkosi, Yesu, ndiphuthume.
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!

VERSE 5
Xa ndiyekelelwa nguWe,
If You forsake me
Ndophalala njengamanzi,
I will be spilt like water
Ze ndifele ebubini;
Evil will kill me
Nkosi, Yesu, ndiphuthume.
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!

VERSE 6
Z’undithwale nakaloku,
Ngezongalo zobubele,
Carry me, always, in Your merciful hands
Ndiziphosa kuWe ngoku,
I throw myself at Your feet
Nkosi, Yesu, ndiphuthume.
Lord, Jesus, quickly, save me!
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndiya khala kuWe, nKosi

lines.translation: I cry out to You, O Lord
Holy Father, hear me
In this chaos, hear me
In this sinful world
I am a sheep gone astray
Find me, bring me back home
I am scared of these hills
Fetch me, take me home
I drifted away, I followed a wrong path
I despised Your grace
In the midst of disastrous doubt
I am falling off
In thick, foggy weather, at the hour of death
Arise, O Sun of Righteousness!
Lead me to the right path
Save me
Escort me, my Redeemer
Let me follow your lead
How pleasant will it be, to journey with You and never be tired
Therefore, I will walk with You, Gracious Lord
I will climb the highest mountains
And pass through the darkest forests

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndiya khala kuWe, nKosi!
I cry out to You, O Lord
Bawo oyiNgcwele, ndive
Holy Father, hear me
Kobu bugxwayiba, ndive
In this chaos, hear me
Ekweneni kweli lizwe.
In this sinful world

VERSE 2
Ndiyigusha, ndalahleka;
I am a sheep gone astray
Ma ndifunwe, ndibuyiswe;
Find me, bring me back home
Ndiyoyika kula mawa,
I am scared of these hills
Ma ndilandwe, ndigoduswe.
Fetch me, take me home

VERSE 3
Ndaphambuka emendweni,
I drifted away, I followed a wrong path
Ndalushiy' ufefe lwaKho,
I despised Your grace
Kwezi ntanda-buzo zimbi
In the midst of disastrous doubt
Se ndeyele, ndiya tshona.
I am falling off

VERSE 4
Enkungwini, ekufeni,
In thick, foggy weather, at the hour of death
Phuma, Langa lolungiso!
Arise, O Sun of Righteousness!
Ma ndingene endleleni
Lead me to the right path
Ndilubone usindiso.
Save me

VERSE 5
Ndipheleke,muKhululi!
Escort me, my Redeemer
Ma ndiphathelele kuWe;
Let me follow your lead
Koba mnandi ndakuhamba
NaWe, ndize ndingadinwa.
How pleasant will it be, to journey with You and never be tired

VERSE 6
Ngoko ndinga ndingahamba
NaWe, nKosi enofefe;
Therefore, I will walk with You, Gracious Lord
Ndiwanyuke amaqhina
I will climb the highest mountains
Neentsunguzi ezimnyama.
And pass through the darkest forests
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Thixo, ndocula ngezibele zaKho

lines.translation: Lord, I will sing of Your mercies
That have given me joy
I take delight in Your Word, it has given me hope in life
You sent Your servants, to teach me Your ways
They preached Your Precepts
They have revealed my sins
Father, I wept in Your presence
When my guilt was proved
But Your forgiveness
Has taken my grief away
Son of God, Your blood has been shed for my sins
It has settled the debt, it has cleansed me
For this reason, I thank You, my Saviour

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thixo, ndocula ngezibele zaKho,
Lord, I will sing of Your mercies
Ezindinika olu vuyo lwam;
That have given me joy
Lindivuyisa eli lizwi laKho,
Elindiphileyo ithemba lam.
I take delight in Your Word, it has given me hope in life

VERSE 2
Wandithumela izicaka zaKho,
Zokufundisa umphefumlo wam;
You sent Your servants, to teach me Your ways
Zashumayela imithetho yaKho;
They preached Your Precepts
Yabonakalisa izoono zam.
They have revealed my sins

VERSE 3
Bawo, ndalila ebusweni baKho,
Father, I wept in Your presence
Ndakuboniswa ubutyala bam;
When my guilt was proved
Kodwa kaloku uxolelo lwaKho,
But Your forgiveness
Lususile lonke ulilo lwam.
Has taken my grief away

VERSE 4
Nyana kaThixo, elo gazi laKho
Laliphalazwa ngelityala lam;
Son of God, Your blood has been shed for my sins
Lilihlaw’lile, landihlambulula,
It has settled the debt, it has cleansed me
Ndibulela ngoko, Msindisi wam.
For this reason, I thank You, my Saviour
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nje ngebadi libadula

lines.translation: As a deer pants for the streams of water
So I long for You, O God!
My heart is thirsty, thirsty for God
Yes, the Living God!
They questioned me, and I burst in tears
My enemies continually mock me, asking:
“Where is this God of Yours”
I wept in my loneliness
As I remembered the multitudes that had passed on
As I am all alone today
I used to walk among crowds of worshippers to Your House
Indeed, I will ask: “My God, why have You forsaken me?
Such that my enemies scoff: “Where is this God of Yours”
Why O my soul, are you so sad
Troubled and restless?
The One from whom deep calls out from deep
Through its waterfalls
Put your trust in Him
And find comfort

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nje ngebadi libadula,
Ukufun’ umthombo,
As a deer pants for the streams of water
Iya funa njalo, Thixo!
Intliziyo yami.
So I long for You, O God!

VERSE 2
Inxaniwe intliziyo,
Inxanel’ uThixo,
My heart is thirsty, thirsty for God
Ewe lowo, waziwayo
Ungophilileyo.
Yes, the Living God!

VERSE 3
Bandibuza ndasibeka
Isililo mina,
They questioned me, and I burst in tears
Bakuhlala bendibuza:
My enemies continually mock me, asking:
“UnoThixo phi na?”
“Where is this God of Yours”

VERSE 4
Zaphalala iinyembezi
Ndakuba ndindedwa;
I wept in my loneliness
Ndakucinga ngabaninzi:
Abangasekhoyo.
As I remembered the multitudes that had passed on

VERSE 5
Kuba namhla ndinje nje nje,
Ndililolo apha,
As I am all alone today
Ndandisiya nezihlwele,
Kuyo indlu yaKho.
I used to walk among crowds of worshippers to Your House

VERSE 6
Ndotsho ndithi: “Thixo wami!
Undilahlele ni?
Indeed, I will ask: “My God, why have You forsaken me?
‘De ndihlekwe luth’ utshaba,
UnoThixo phi na?”
Such that my enemies scoff: “Where is this God of Yours”

VERSE 7
Kungani na, muphefumlo!
Udakumbileyo,
Why O my soul, are you so sad
Waxhalaba ngaphakathi,
Ungenakuzola?
Troubled and restless?

VERSE 8
Lo ubizwa naziinzulu,
The One from whom deep calls out from deep
Ngeengxangxasi zazo,
Through its waterfalls
Bek’ ithemba lakho kuYe,
Put your trust in Him
Uthuthuzeleke.
And find comfort
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yanga intliziyo yam, Ingaphuma ezonweni

lines.translation: I wish my heart can repent from sin
I wish my soul can be sanctified
Hear, hear, my Lord, hear my petition
I wish my lifestyle can resemble that of heaven

lines.primary: Zanga zonk’ izenzo zam, Zingayama eNkosini.
lines.translation: I wish all my actions can be inspired by the Lord
Help, help, my Lord, help me overcome temptations

lines.primary: Kwanga ukuvuya kwam Ndingavuya futhi ngaWe
lines.translation: I wish I can only find joy in You, Lord
I wish in my endeavors, I may follow You
Approve, approve, my Lord, my admittance into heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yanga intliziyo yam, Ingaphuma ezonweni;
I wish my heart can repent from sin
Wanga umphefumlo wam Ungangen’ ebungcweleni.
I wish my soul can be sanctified
Yiva, yiva, Nkosi yam,
Yiva ukukhunga kwam.
Hear, hear, my Lord, hear my petition

VERSE 2
Kwanga ukuhamba kwam Kungabeka ezulwini
I wish my lifestyle can resemble that of heaven
Zanga zonk’ izenzo zam, Zingayama eNkosini.
I wish all my actions can be inspired by the Lord
Nceda, nceda, Nkosi yam,
Nceda ukulinga kwam.
Help, help, my Lord, help me overcome temptations

VERSE 3
Kwanga ukuvuya kwam Ndingavuya futhi ngaWe
I wish I can only find joy in You, Lord
Kwanga ukuzama kwam Ndingalandelana naWe.
I wish in my endeavors, I may follow You
Vuma, vuma, Nkosi yam
Ndiye ezulwini nam.
Approve, approve, my Lord, my admittance into heaven
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Loo nto ayithiyileyo

lines.translation: What my Lord has disapproved
May I not desire in my heart
Assist me Lord not to go against Your will, come, abide in me
Launch Your work of salvation in me
Plant Your image deep in my soul
That I may obey Your Holy Spirit
So, You can defeat my sinful nature
Make me a new creation, make me holy
In all and through all I do
Wholly cleanse me till all my dirt is gone

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Loo nto ayithiyileyo,
Lowo unguThixo wam,
What my Lord has disapproved
Mandingabe ndiyifuna
Ngayo intliziyo yam.
May I not desire in my heart

VERSE 2
Ndize, Bawo ndingayenzi,
Yiza Wen’ uhlale kum
Assist me Lord not to go against Your will, come, abide in me
Uwumise umsebenzi
Wosindiso lwaKho kum.
Launch Your work of salvation in me

VERSE 3
Tyal’ umfanekiso waKho
Kuwo umphefumlo wam;
Plant Your image deep in my soul
Ndithobel’ uMoya waKho,
That I may obey Your Holy Spirit
Uyoyis’ imvelo yam.
So, You can defeat my sinful nature

VERSE 4
Ndenze kutsha, ndibe ngcwele
Make me a new creation, make me holy
Ngayo yonk’ imikhwa yam
In all and through all I do
Ndicokise, ‘ze kuphele
Konke ukungcola kwam.
Wholly cleanse me till all my dirt is gone
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndingenal uthando

lines.translation: If I do not have the love
To love God
And all people
I am no good to anybody
Even if
I have the gift to speak
As the heavenly messengers
Love is the real thing
Even if
I have all the knowledge
And have insight into mysteries
Love is the real thing
Even if
I have the faith
That moves mountains
Love is the real thing
Even if, through my wealth
I support the poor
Love is the real thing
Bestow me with that love
So I can love everybody
With all of my soul and all of my mind
And with all of my strength

lyrics:
VERSE 1
I Cor 13: 1
Ndingenal’ uthando,
If I do not have the love
Lokuthand’ uThixo;
To love God
Kunye nabo bonk’ abantu,
And all people
Andincedi lutho.
I am no good to anybody

VERSE 2
Ndingafanelana
Even if
Ndiphiw’ ukuthetha,
I have the gift to speak
Nje ngezithunywa zezulu,
As the heavenly messengers
Luthand’ eyona nto.
Love is the real thing

VERSE 3
Ndingafanelana
Even if
Ndinokwazi konke,
I have all the knowledge
Ndizazi neemfihlakalo,
And have insight into mysteries
Luthand’ eyona nto.
Love is the real thing

VERSE 4
Ndingafanelana
Even if
Ndinalo nokholo,
I have the faith
Olususa kwa neentaba,
That moves mountains
Luthand’ eyona nto.
Love is the real thing

VERSE 5
Ndingafanelana
Ndobutyebi bam,
Even if, through my wealth
Amahlwempu ndiwaxhasa,
I support the poor
Luthand’ eyona nto.
Love is the real thing

VERSE 6
Ndiphe olo thando,
Bestow me with that love
Ndibathande bonke;
So I can love everybody
Ngomphefumlo nangengqondo,
With all of my soul and all of my mind
Nangamandla onke.
And with all of my strength
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndanga ndinganentliziyo
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndanga ndinganentliziyo
Yokubong’ uThixo wami,
Intliziyo ekhululwe
Kuzo zonk’ izoono zami.

VERSE 2
Ndanga ndinganentliziyo
Yokumthand’ uYesu yedwa,
Enokholo, nethembela
Egazini laKhe lodwa.

VERSE 3
Ndanga ndinganentobeko,
Ndilulanyiselwe kuWe;
Ndifundiswe, ndilungiswe,
Ndiphelele, nKosi, kuWe.

VERSE 4
Ndinga nKosi ndingavuma
Leyo ndlela yaKho yodwa;
Ndibe nayo nentliziyo
Ezamela yona yodwa.

VERSE 5
Yang’ ingathi le ntliziyo
Ekucamangeni kwayo;
Yenzwe kutsha, icokiswe
Iyithand’ inKosi yayo.

VERSE 6
Ndakuhlanjwa nguWe, Thixo;
Ndangcwaliswa, Thixo wami!
Ndoba nayo intliziyo
Yokubong’ umFeli wami.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Oko kwanga kulumkile

lines.translation: All that which is prudent, Gives me power, Lord Jesus
I have given everything up
Ever since Your light shone on me
Have become for me wisdom from God
You, Lord
My guilty verdict
When the law laid down
And I couldn’t afford
To pay the price and be set free
You, Lord, came and provided justification for me
Darkness hovered over me
had always been unclean,
I was spiritually dead
There was nothing right in my life
Until You came and sanctified me
knew I was in danger
I felt the anxiety
didn’t enjoy life
I was terrified of dying
Until You came and delivered me
Lord, I will only boast about You
And give myself to You
Without You, I have nothing
You are my everything
You are my everything
Lord, Jesus

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Oko kwanga kulumkile,
Kunamandla, Yesu, kum;
All that which is prudent, Gives me power, Lord Jesus
Konke sendikulahlile,
I have given everything up
Ngokukhanya kwaKho kum,
Ever since Your light shone on me
Wena, Nkosi,
Have become for me wisdom from God
Waba bubulumko kum.
You, Lord

VERSE 2
Xa umthetho wandityela,
My guilty verdict
Konke ukugwetywa kwam;
When the law laid down
Ndada andabona ndlela
And I couldn’t afford
Yokuhlaw’l’ ityala lam.
To pay the price and be set free
Wena, Nkosi,
Waba bulungisa bam.
You, Lord, came and provided justification for me

VERSE 3
Be ndihleli ndincholile,
Darkness hovered over me
Kwaabumnyama bodwa kum;
had always been unclean,
Umphefumlo wawufile,
I was spiritually dead
Kungalunge nento kum;
There was nothing right in my life
Waza Wena,
Waba yingcwaliso kum.
Until You came and sanctified me

VERSE 4
Ukuxhala ndandikuva,
knew I was in danger
Ndiyibon’ ingozi yam;
I felt the anxiety
Ubumnandi andabuva,
didn’t enjoy life
Ngokoyik’ ukufa kwam;
I was terrified of dying
Waza Wena,
Waba yinkululo yam.
Until You came and delivered me

VERSE 5
Nkosi ndoqhayisa ngaWe,
Lord, I will only boast about You
Ndikuncame okukum,
And give myself to You
Andinanto ndingenaWe,
Without You, I have nothing
Wen’ uzinto zonke kum,
You are my everything
Nkosi, Yesu,
You are my everything
Wen’ uzinto zonke kum.
Lord, Jesus
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ma ndithwale iziqhamo

lines.translation: of the Holy Spirit ;
May I bear the fruit
Goodness, humility,Righteousness and kindness,
All that are of faith, Of love and peace
In my heart all the time ;
All these should grow,
From my countless sins that defeat me ;
Yes, they should help to free me,
And everything associated with them
Pride and jealousy,
lots and lots of fruit ;
Yes, Lord, may I bring forth
Everything that is loveable & righteous,
And be quick to pursue
So that my behavior and my ways can never be questioned.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ma ndithwale iziqhamo,
of the Holy Spirit ;
EzoMoya oyiNgcwele ;
May I bear the fruit
Ubunchathu nolulamo,
Ukulunga nobubele,
Goodness, humility,Righteousness and kindness,
Zonke ezizezenkolo
Zezothando, nezoxolo.
All that are of faith, Of love and peace

VERSE 2
Ezi zinto ma zikhule
In my heart all the time ;
Entliz’yweni onk’ amaxa ;
All these should grow,
Zindincede ndinyothule,
From my countless sins that defeat me ;
Konke oko kuzixaka ;
Yes, they should help to free me,
Okwekratshi nokomona,
And everything associated with them
Neento eziphuma khona
Pride and jealousy,

VERSE 3
Ewe, Nkosi, ma ndihlume
lots and lots of fruit ;
Ndibe ngoxakathileyo ;
Yes, Lord, may I bring forth
Ndizamele, ndiphuthume,
Everything that is loveable & righteous,
Konke okulungileyo,
And be quick to pursue
Iz’ ingabi nakuphikwa,
Yonk’ imilo kwa nemikhwa.
So that my behavior and my ways can never be questioned.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Naab ubomi bami Nkosi

lines.translation: This is my life Lord
Consecrated I give to You
enter into a Covenant with You
I want to be Yours
Here are my hands
Take them
May they work out all
That You desire
Here are my feet
Take them
So they may work for You
For as long as I live
And do take this tongue
And my mouth
Let me speak, proclaim
About my King
Everyday, all the time
All of my life
I sacrifice myself for You
Even my very self
As well all my wealth
And all my gains
My soul, my heart
I give them all to You
All the love I have
And all that is in me
I sacrifice to You
Jesus, my Lord

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Naab’ ubomi bami Nkosi,
This is my life Lord
Buthabathe Wena,
Consecrated I give to You
Ndiyanqiphisana naWe,
enter into a Covenant with You
Mandibe ngowaKho.
I want to be Yours

VERSE 2
Naaz’ izandla zami Nkosi,
Here are my hands
Ndizinika Wena
Take them
Ma zikusebenze konke,
May they work out all
Okuthandwa nguWe.
That You desire

VERSE 3
Naaz’ iinyawo zami Nkosi,
Here are my feet
Zithabathe Wena,
Take them
Zize zikusebenzele,
So they may work for You
Yonk’ imihla.
For as long as I live

VERSE 4
Z’uthabathe olu lwimi,
And do take this tongue
Nalomlomo wami,
And my mouth
Mandithethe, ndintsholoze,
Let me speak, proclaim
NgoKumkani wami.
About my King

VERSE 5
Yonk’ imihla, lonk’ ilixa,
Everyday, all the time
Yonk’ impilo yami,
All of my life
Ndiyazincamela Wena,
I sacrifice myself for You
Kwa nesiqu sami.
Even my very self

VERSE 6
Ngokunjalo yonk’ imfuyo,
As well all my wealth
Kwa nenzuzo yonke,
And all my gains
Umphefumlo, kwa nomxhelo,
My soul, my heart
Ndikunika konke.
I give them all to You

VERSE 7
Lonk’ uthando lomphefumlo,
All the love I have
Nento yonke yami;
And all that is in me
Ndiyincamela kwa Wena,
I sacrifice to You
Yesu, Nkosi yami.
Jesus, my Lord
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Soloko intliziyo yam

lines.translation: For a long time now, my heart has been trapped in sinfulness
For a long time now my soul has been in darkness
But today, my Lord You’ve come to save me
Light has descended on me, it lights up my way
Even as I was lost I heard Your Word
Your messengers came to me
And proclaimed Your grace
believed in my Redeemer
Who came to earth
To settle my debt
And save me from sin
Great is the blessing I have gained from You
Great is the joy I have received from You
Today, my desire is to be in heaven
Today, I am heading towards eternal life

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Soloko intliziyo yam,
Ibanjwe ezonweni;
For a long time now, my heart has been trapped in sinfulness
Soloko umphefumlo wam
Uhleli emnyameni.
For a long time now my soul has been in darkness

VERSE 2
Kanti ke namhla, Nkosi yam
Usel’ undisindisa;
But today, my Lord You’ve come to save me
Kuhle ukhanyo phezu kwam,
Lwase lundikhanyisa.
Light has descended on me, it lights up my way

VERSE 3
Kwa sekulahlekeni kwam,
Ndaliva izwi laKho
Even as I was lost I heard Your Word
Kwafika abafuni bam,
Your messengers came to me
Baxel’ ufefe lwaKho.
And proclaimed Your grace

VERSE 4
Ndakholwa nguMkhululi wam,
believed in my Redeemer
Oweza emhlabeni;
Who came to earth
Ukuz’ ahlaw’l’ ityala lam,
To settle my debt
Ndisinde ezonweni.
And save me from sin

VERSE 5
Likhulu ithamsanqa lam
Endilizuza kuWe,
Great is the blessing I have gained from You
Kukhulu ukuvuya kwam,
Endikuphiwa nguWe.
Great is the joy I have received from You

VERSE 6
Namhla nje iminqweno yam,
Ibeka ezulwini;
Today, my desire is to be in heaven
Namhla nje umphefumlo wam
Usinga ebomini.
Today, I am heading towards eternal life
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nkosi yam, ubundithanda

lines.translation: My Lord, You loved me, even while I was lost
My Lord, You searched for me
Until You found me.
My Lord, Your Word is light unto my path
My Lord, Your grace is my delight
I have joy, my Lord
My Lord, Your Holy Spirit sanctifies me
My Lord, Your heaven is my eternal home
Let me in, my Lord.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nkosi yam, ubundithanda,
Ekulahlekeni kwam;
My Lord, You loved me, even while I was lost
Nkosi yam, waman’ ulanda,
Futhi emkhondweni wam.
My Lord, You searched for me
Ndafunyanwa, Nkosi yam.
Until You found me.

VERSE 2
Nkosi yam, ilizwi laKho
Lingumkhanyiseli wam.
My Lord, Your Word is light unto my path
Nkosi yam, ufefe lwaKho,
Lusisonwabiso sam.
My Lord, Your grace is my delight
Ndinovuyo, Nkosi yam.
I have joy, my Lord

VERSE 3
Nkosi yam, uMoya wakho,
Uyandingcwalisa nam.
My Lord, Your Holy Spirit sanctifies me
Nkosi yam, izulu laKho,
Lona lilikhaya lam.
My Lord, Your heaven is my eternal home
Ma ndingene, Nkosi yam.
Let me in, my Lord.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Mthandi womphefumlo wam

lines.translation: Lover of my soul
Protect me
When the waters roll
While the tempest is high
O Saviour hide me,
Till the storm of life is past
Guide my soul into Thine haven
Receive my soul at last
Other refuge I have none
That I can hide in
Other hope I have none
That I can hold on to
In my weakness
Comfort me
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of your wing
I want You, O Christ
You are my everything
You raise the fallen
You lead the blind
Just and holy is Your name
I am all unrighteous
I am full of sin
You are full of truth and grace
Plenteous grace to cover all sin is found in You
Let the healing streams abound, and keep me pure within
You are the Fountain of Life
Let me find contentment in You
Spring up within my heart
Rise to all eternity

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Mthandi womphefumlo wam,
Lover of my soul
Ma undikhusele nam;
Protect me
Zakufik’ iinzingo zam,
When the waters roll
Nokuthandabuza kwam.
While the tempest is high

VERSE 2
Ndifihle Mkhululi wam,
O Saviour hide me,
‘De zidlul’ iingozi zam;
Till the storm of life is past
Khokel’ umphefumlo wam
Guide my soul into Thine haven
Undamkele Nkosi yam.
Receive my soul at last

VERSE 3
Andinanqaba yimbi
Other refuge I have none
Endingatshona kuyo;
That I can hide in
Andinathemba limbi,
Other hope I have none
Endingalibambayo.
That I can hold on to

VERSE 4
Ebuthathakeni bam
In my weakness
Ma undithuthuzele
Comfort me
Yikhusel’ intloko yam
Cover my defenceless head
Ngephiko lobubele.
With the shadow of your wing

VERSE 5
Ndifuna Wena, Kristu,
I want You, O Christ
Ndiyakwanela nguWe;
You are my everything
Onceda owileyo,
You raise the fallen
Nalow’ ongaboniyo.
You lead the blind

VERSE 6
Lingcwel’ igama laKho
Just and holy is Your name
Indim’ oncholileyo;
I am all unrighteous
Ndizele yinkohliso,
I am full of sin
NguWe oyinyaniso.
You are full of truth and grace

VERSE 7
IkuWe yonk’ inceba
Yokuselel’ isoono;
Plenteous grace to cover all sin is found in You
UMthomb’ ophilisayo
Ma undihlambulule.
Let the healing streams abound, and keep me pure within

VERSE 8
NguWe lo Mthombo wobom,
You are the Fountain of Life
Ma ndikholiswe nguWe,
Let me find contentment in You
Mpompoz’ entliz’yweni yam,
Spring up within my heart
Ndinyuselw’ ezulwini.
Rise to all eternity
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam

lines.translation: I love my Saviour
He is my Peacemaker
He makes peace between me and God
I love my Saviour
He is my Redeemer
He has settled my debt
And has overturned my guilty verdict
I love my Saviour
He has cleansed me
He helps me defeat sin
He purifies my heart
I love my Saviour
He is my Light
His Word is my lamp
That lights up my path
I love my Saviour
He is my Helper
He bears my sorrow
He helps me defeat my sinful nature
I love my Saviour
He is THE real Friend
He is with me in my youth
And in my old age
I love my Saviour
He is always there for me
When everybody I know is gone
He is my reason for living

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam,
I love my Saviour
Nguyena onguMlamli wam;
He is my Peacemaker
Wenzela min’ uxolo lwam,
Phakathi kwam noThixo wam.
He makes peace between me and God

VERSE 2
Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam,
I love my Saviour
Nguyena uMhlaw’leli wam;
He is my Redeemer
Ugqibe lonk’ ityala lam,
He has settled my debt
Kwa nako ukugwetywa kwam.
And has overturned my guilty verdict

VERSE 3
Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam,
I love my Saviour
Nguyena onguMhlanzi wam;
He has cleansed me
Undoyisel’ izoono zam,
He helps me defeat sin
Uhlambe intliziyo yam.
He purifies my heart

VERSE 4
Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam,
I love my Saviour
Nguyena okukhanya kwam;
He is my Light
Olizwi lisibane sam,
His Word is my lamp
Likhanyisel’ indlela yam.
That lights up my path

VERSE 5
Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam,
I love my Saviour
Nguyena onguMsizi wam;
He is my Helper
Uthwala zonk’ iintsizi zam,
He bears my sorrow
Unceda eenkohleni zam.
He helps me defeat my sinful nature

VERSE 6
Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam,
I love my Saviour
Nguyena onguMhlobo wam;
He is THE real Friend
Unam nasebutsheni bam,
He is with me in my youth
Nasekwaluphaleni kwam.
And in my old age

VERSE 7
Ndimthanda uMsindisi wam,
I love my Saviour
Uhlal’ ehleli Yena nam;
He is always there for me
Bakumka abazana nam,
When everybody I know is gone
Usekho ebubomi bam.
He is my reason for living
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndingahlulwa yinto ni na
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndingahlulwa yinto ni na
NaWe Nyana wophezulu?
Izothuso, nobunzima,
Aziqali ukufika.

VERSE 2
Zangeniswa kukungeva,
Nokwaphul' owakh' umthetho;
Ngamanyange okuqala,
Ayebekwe emyezweni.

VERSE 3
Waza, Yesu, nKosi yami
Wahlangula kuloo ngozi;
Ngokuthath' ukufa kwami,
'Ze ubomi ndibuzuze.

VERSE 4
Wandibek' elulwalweni,
OlunguWe mSindisi;
Waba sisigxekwa Wena
Endaweni yabaginwa.

VERSE 5
Hay' uvuyo nokonwaba,
Kwentliziyo, enethemba;
Ezaliswe nalukholo,
Egazini lomKhululi.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Sicela kuwe, mEnzi wethu

lines.translation: We beseech You, our Mighty Creator
Who is Lord over us,
We surrender our lives
To Your will, You know best
We do not know what tomorrow holds
You are the only One who knows
Your will be done, You know best
You are Omnipotent
You are Omniscient
You are Merciful
Your will be done, You know best
In times of wealth
IIn times of starvation
Even, in times of catastrophe
Your will be done, You know best
In times of sickness
And in times of health
Until of death we part
Your will be done, You know best

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Sicela kuwe, mEnzi wethu,
We beseech You, our Mighty Creator
OnguKumkani phezu kwethu,
Who is Lord over us,
Ma uthi entlalweni yethu
We surrender our lives
Wenze ngentando yaKho.
To Your will, You know best

VERSE 2
Sihleli thina ngokungazi,
Iinto zangomso asizazi,
We do not know what tomorrow holds
EnguWe wedwa onokwazi,
You are the only One who knows
Yenza ngentando yaKho.
Your will be done, You know best

VERSE 3
EnguWe onamandla onke,
You are Omnipotent
Onabo nobulumko bonke,
You are Omniscient
EnguWe onofefe lonke,
You are Merciful
Yenza ngentando yaKho.
Your will be done, You know best

VERSE 4
Ngexesha lobutyebi bethu,
In times of wealth
Ngexesha lokuswela kwethu,
IIn times of starvation
Nakulo lonk' ilishwa lethu,
Even, in times of catastrophe
Yenza ngentando yaKho.
Your will be done, You know best

VERSE 5
Kwa semikhuhlaneni yethu,
In times of sickness
Nakuko ukuphila kwethu,
And in times of health
Kude kufik' ukufa kwethu,
Until of death we part
Yenza ngentando yaKho.
Your will be done, You know best
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bawo! xa ndilahlekayo

lines.translation: Father! When I go astray
In this life’s journey
Teach me to always say:
Your will be done”
In this journey there are dangers
In this journey there are enemies
You have sent them to test me
Your will be done”
When you have taken back
That which is dear to me
I will be returning Your own
Your will be done”
When I become weak because of illness
And I become powerless
I will try, Father to say:
Your will be done”
Change my own will
Align it to Yours
Remove all doubts
Your will be done”

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bawo! xa ndilahlekayo
Father! When I go astray
Kolu hambo lweli lizwe;
In this life’s journey
Hlal' undifundis' ukuthi:
Teach me to always say:
"Ma yenzek' intando yaKho."
“
Your will be done”

VERSE 2
Olu hambo luneengozi,
In this journey there are dangers
Olu hambo luneentshaba,
In this journey there are enemies
Zezithunywe nguWe zonke;
You have sent them to test me
"Ma yenzek' intando yaKho."
“
Your will be done”

VERSE 3
Xenikweni wandihlutha
When you have taken back
Into endiyithandayo,
That which is dear to me
Ndoba ndibuyis' eyaKho;
I will be returning Your own
"Ma yenzek' intando yaKho."
“
Your will be done”

VERSE 4
Ndakuhliwa nasisifo,
When I become weak because of illness
Onk' amandla am ahluthwe,
And I become powerless
Ndakuzama, Baw' ukuthi,
I will try, Father to say:
"Ma yenzek' intando yaKho.“
“
Your will be done”

VERSE 5
Yiguqul' eyam intando,
Change my own will
Yifanise nay' eyaKho;
Align it to Yours
Susa konke ukukrokra,
Remove all doubts
"Ma yenzek' intando yaKho.“
“
Your will be done”
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndinga nga sekhuselweni
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndinga nga sekhuselweni
Longaphezu konke;
Ndingahlala ethunzini
Lonamandla onke.

VERSE 2
Ndiya kuthi ngoYehova,
Uyinqaba yami;
Ndiya kuthembela kuWe,
OnguThixo wami.

VERSE 3
Wondiphahla ngokulunga
Wondilwela nami;
Wondigubungela Yena,
Ngamaphiko aKhe.

VERSE 4
Ndophephela kuYehova
Ngexa ndoyikayo,
Aya kuwa amawaka
Kungezi nto kumi.

VERSE 5
Uya kuyalela zona
Iingelosi zaKhe,
Zindigcine, ndifunqulwe
Endleleni yaKhe.

VERSE 6
Ndiya kukholiswa ngabo
Ububele baKhe;
Ndophiliswa, ndambathiswe
Lusindiso lwaKhe.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: UMalusi nguYehova
lyrics:
VERSE 1
UMalusi nguYehova,
Ondigcinileyo;
Ukuswela akubikho
Kothembela kuYe.

VERSE 2
Amadlelo aluhlaza,
Ndiya dliswa kuwo;
Ndiya lala ngokonwaba,
Ndingothuswa lutho.

VERSE 3
Uya vusa umphefumlo
Uyawenz’ uphile;
Ukulunga ndiba nako,
Ngenxa yoMasuli.

VERSE 4
Xa ndihamba emnyameni,
Andinakoyika;
Kuba Wena uba nami,
Uya ndonwabisa.

VERSE 5
Isithebe ndiba naso,
Noko ndineentshaba;
Ine-oli intloko yami,
Andiswele lutho.

VERSE 6
Ukulunga, nezibele,
Ziya ndilandela;
Kusendlwini kaYehova,
Apho ndiphilayo.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Unezimvu zaKho, Nkosi

lines.translation: You abide with Your sheep, Lord
You lead them
Even Your lambs, Jesus
Are led by You
They know Your voice
They follow only You
They do not know the voice of any other shepherd
They refuse to follow him
You protect Your sheep, O Lord
None of them can be snatched out of Your hand

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Unezimvu zaKho, Nkosi,
You abide with Your sheep, Lord
Ziyaluswa nguWe;
You lead them
Kwa neemvana zaKho Yesu,
Even Your lambs, Jesus
Zikhokelwa nguWe.
Are led by You

VERSE 2
Ziyaliva izwi laKho,
Ezo zimvu zaKho;
They know Your voice
Zilandela Wena, Yesu,
Zize emva kwaKho.
They follow only You

VERSE 3
Izwi lomalusi wumbi,
Azilazi lona;
They do not know the voice of any other shepherd
Azivumi kumlandela,
Ziya maala Yena.
They refuse to follow him

VERSE 4
Zigciniwe nguWe, Nkosi,
Eezo zimvu zaKho;
You protect Your sheep, O Lord
Kungebiwe nanye yazo,
Esandleni saKho.
None of them can be snatched out of Your hand
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Unabantu baKho, Thixo

lines.translation: You abide with Your people, Lord
At all times
You protect them, You help them
Wherever they are
You journey with them as they cross rivers
You are with them even in the blazing furnace
You give them courage in times of persecution
You protect them from ferocious animals
They fix their eyes on You, Lord at all times
They are forever grateful, and they trust You always

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Unabantu baKho, Thixo,
You abide with Your people, Lord
Ngamaxesha onke;
At all times
Ubagcina, ubancede,
You protect them, You help them
Endaweni zonke.
Wherever they are

VERSE 2
Bakuwela imilambo,
Uba nabo Wena;
You journey with them as they cross rivers
Bakutshiswa ngemililo,
Uba nabo Wena.
You are with them even in the blazing furnace

VERSE 3
Apho batshutshiswa khona,
Bomelezwa nguWe;
You give them courage in times of persecution
Nasemaramncweni, Thixo,
Bagciniwe nguWe.
You protect them from ferocious animals

VERSE 4
Bakhangela kuWe, Nkosi,
Aabo bantu baKho;
They fix their eyes on You, Lord at all times
Babulela, bakuthembe,
Aabo bantu baKho.
They are forever grateful, and they trust You always
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndikhokele, O Yehova

lines.translation: Guide me, O Thou Great Jehovah
I’m a passerby, my Lord
You are strong, I am weak
O Saviour, You are my shield
That crystal fountain of salvation
That was opened for my sake
May it erupt and flow
To wash away all my sins
O Saviour, You are my Help
I am on the verge of Jordaan
Bid my anxious fears subside
Accompany me as I cross over
Be my Helper
O Saviour, You are my Hope

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndikhokele, O Yehova,
Guide me, O Thou Great Jehovah
Ndingumhambi Nkosi yam;
I’m a passerby, my Lord
Unamandla: andinawo,
Onobuthathaka ndim.
You are strong, I am weak
O Msindisi!
NguWe olikhaka lam.
O Saviour, You are my shield

VERSE 2
Lowo mthombo wosindiso
That crystal fountain of salvation
Owavulwa ngenxa yam,
That was opened for my sake
Ma uvele umpompoze,
May it erupt and flow
Uzihlamb’ izoono zam.
To wash away all my sins
O Msindisi!
NguWe oluncedo lwam.
O Saviour, You are my Help

VERSE 3
Ndifikile eJordane,
I am on the verge of Jordaan
Susa izoyiko zam;
Bid my anxious fears subside
Z’undikhaphe sendiwela,
Accompany me as I cross over
Yiba unguMncedi wam.
Be my Helper
O Msindisi!
NguWe olithemba lam.
O Saviour, You are my Hope
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Lukhangela kuWe, Mvana

lines.primary: Lukhangela kuWe, Mvana yeKalvari, Ukholo lwam.
lines.translation: My faith looks up to You, O Lamb of Calvary
Now hear me while I pray, take my guilt away
O let me from this day on, be wholly Yours
Give me strength and patience, O Gracious Father

lines.primary: Uthando lwam kuWe, ma luvuthe nene,
lines.translation: my love for You, pure & warm, changeless should be, a living fire
Because, You died for me
While I tread life’s dark maze, and grief around me spreads, be my Guide
Turn darkness into light, wipe sorrow’s tears away
Don’t let me ever stray, from You, You are the Way!
When life comes to an end, death drawing nearer, Remember me
Saviour, with Love, drive out all fear
Take me to heaven, where I will rest eternally

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Lukhangela kuWe, Mvana yeKalvari, Ukholo lwam.
My faith looks up to You, O Lamb of Calvary
Ndive ndithandaza, susa ityala lam,
Now hear me while I pray, take my guilt away
Kususela namhla, ndenz’ owaKho.
O let me from this day on, be wholly Yours

VERSE 2
Ndinike amandla, kwa nenzondelelo, SoluFefe!
Give me strength and patience, O Gracious Father
Uthando lwam kuWe, ma luvuthe nene,
my love for You, pure & warm, changeless should be, a living fire
Ekubeni Wena, wandifela.
Because, You died for me

VERSE 3
Ndisacand’ udada, lwentlalo enzima, Ndikhokele.
While I tread life’s dark maze, and grief around me spreads, be my Guide
Khanyis’ ubumnyama, sula iinyembezi,
Turn darkness into light, wipe sorrow’s tears away
Ma ndingaze ndimke, kuWe, Ndlela.
Don’t let me ever stray, from You, You are the Way!

VERSE 4
Kwakuphel’ ubomi, kwakufik’ ukufa, Ndivelele.
When life comes to an end, death drawing nearer, Remember me
Msindisi ngothando, shenxis’ uloyiko,
Saviour, with Love, drive out all fear
Ndise ezulwini, ndiphunyuzwe.
Take me to heaven, where I will rest eternally
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kukho ekaThix incwadi

lines.translation: There is God’s Book of Life
The register of all saints
All those who believe in Him
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”
The pages are elegant
Always clean
They will last forever
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”
Even if you are not known
Even if you are not famous
“Is your name known in heaven?”
In the earthly books
Your name may be registered
However, in the Book of Life
“Does your name feature?”
The earthly books
Get used up, and may get lost
God’s Book stays forever new
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”
Time is ticking by
Opportunities pass by
Answer the question right now:
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Rev 23:27
Kukho ekaThix’ incwadi,
There is God’s Book of Life
Yamagam’ abangcwele,
The register of all saints
Yaabo bakholwayo kuYe:
All those who believe in Him
“Likhonan’ igama laKho?”
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”

VERSE 2
Amaphepha ayo mahle,
The pages are elegant
Soloko ecocekile,
Always clean
Ohlala ngonaphakade”
They will last forever
“Likhonan’ igama laKho?”
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”

VERSE 3
Noxa apha alaziwa,
Even if you are not known
Noxa aph’ alidumanga,
Even if you are not famous
Phezulu phay’ ezulwini:
“Likhonan’ igama laKho?”
“Is your name known in heaven?”

VERSE 4
Kwezisemhlaben’ iincwadi,
In the earthly books
Lingabakh’ igama laKho,
Your name may be registered
Kodwa kweyobom’ incwadi:
However, in the Book of Life
“Likhonan’ igama laKho.”
“Does your name feature?”

VERSE 5
Ezalapha emhlabeni,
The earthly books
Ziyaguga, zilahleke,
Get used up, and may get lost
EkaThixo ayigugi,
God’s Book stays forever new
“Likhonan’ igama laKho?”
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”

VERSE 6
Liyabaleka ixesha,
Time is ticking by
Limka namathuba akho,
Opportunities pass by
Wuphendule ngok’ umbuzo:
Answer the question right now:
“Likhonan’ igama laKho?”
“Is your name written in the Book of Life?”
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Eyona nt inexabiso

lines.translation: The valuable thing in life
Is not food and clothing
It is neither good health nor being merry
What shall it profit anyone
To gain the whole world?
Yet the soul be thrown in the burning furnance
The most valuable thing
Is the works of faith
To carry the cross
Blessed are the ones who surrender their earthly possessions
And run their race up to the finish line
I want to live as a saint
And die like one
I will walk in paths of righteousness
And overcome like the One

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Eyona nt’ inexabiso,
Kobubomi sibudlayo,
The valuable thing in life
Asikudla nezambatho,
Is not food and clothing
Asimpilo nokonwaba.
It is neither good health nor being merry

VERSE 2
Komnceda ni na umntu,
What shall it profit anyone
Ukuzuza lonk’ ilizwe?
To gain the whole world?
Uze umphefumlo wona,
Ulahlelwe emlilweni.
Yet the soul be thrown in the burning furnance

VERSE 3
Eyona nt’ inexabiso,
The most valuable thing
Yimisebenzi yokholo;
Is the works of faith
Kukuthwala umnqamlezo,
To carry the cross
Ngentobeko nengqoboko.
W….

VERSE 4
Banoyolo abashiya,
Iinto zonke zehlabathi;
Blessed are the ones who surrender their earthly possessions
Babalek’ ugqatso lwabo,
Bade baluphumelele.
And run their race up to the finish line

VERSE 5
Ma ndiphile nje ngelunga,
I want to live as a saint
Ndize ndif’ ukufa kwalo;
And die like one
Ndakuhamba ngokulunga,
I will walk in paths of righteousness
Ndakoyisa kwa nje ngalo.
And overcome like the One
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ngubani na ongahlala

lines.translation: Who can reside
In Your tent Lord?
Who can stand
On Your Holy Mountain?
The one who walks in righteousness
Who has clean hands
Who speaks the truth
Who is pure at heart
The one that does not gossip
Who commits no evil
Who does not insult
Who does not …
The one that does not magnify the devil
But fears the Lord
And …
The one that keeps his/her word
Who does not lend money
And charge an exorbitant interest
The one that does not accept bribes
And victimise innocent people
Whoever does these
They will not be moved
They abide in God’s tent
And will stand on His Holy Mountain

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ngubani na ongahlala,
Who can reside
Ententeni yaKho, Nkosi?
In Your tent Lord?
Ngubani na oya kuma,
Who can stand
Entabeni eyingcwele?
On Your Holy Mountain?

VERSE 2
Ngokuhamba kulungile,
The one who walks in righteousness
Olungis’ ukwenza kwakhe
Who has clean hands
Okuthetha kuyinene,
Who speaks the truth
Ongenantliziyo mbini.
Who is pure at heart

VERSE 3
Nguye ongahlebi bantu,
The one that does not gossip
Ongabenzi oko kubi,
Who commits no evil
Ongathandi ukuthuka,
Who does not insult
Ongabuk’ intlebendwane.
Who does not …

VERSE 4
Nguye othi ngendawo
Angamnik’ ubukhulu,
The one that does not magnify the devil
Kodwa aboyik’ uThixo,
But fears the Lord
Bona ababeke futhi.
And …

VERSE 5
Ngolibamb’ izwi lakhe,
The one that keeps his/her word
Noko azonayo ngalo,
Ongabolekiyo mali,
Who does not lend money
Ngokufun’ inzuz’ enkulu.
And charge an exorbitant interest

VERSE 6
Ngozigcin’ izandla zakhe,
Zingamkeli amabaso,
The one that does not accept bribes
Kuqotyolwe abamsulwa,
Kugwetyelwe onetyala.
And victimise innocent people

VERSE 7
Ozenzayo ezizinto,
Whoever does these
Akasoz’ ashukunyiswe;
They will not be moved
Sel’ ehleli ententeni,
They abide in God’s tent
Woda eme entabeni.
And will stand on His Holy Mountain
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Phezulu eNkosini

lines.translation: Heaven is inhabited by the righteous only
Heaven is populated by the saints only
Whoever wants to make their way there
Should plead for themselves
And be prepared for it, by the Holy Spirit
Jesus died for us
Our debt has been settled
Our souls have been sanctified
So that when death sweeps us from earth
We may not be denied entry into heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Phezulu eNkosini,
Ngabalungile bodwa;
Heaven is inhabited by the righteous only
Phezulu ezulwini,
Kuhlel’ iingcwele zodwa.
Heaven is populated by the saints only

VERSE 2
Ofun’ ukuya khona,
Whoever wants to make their way there
Ma kazithandazele;
Should plead for themselves
Alungiselwe lona,
NguMoya oyiNgcwele.
And be prepared for it, by the Holy Spirit

VERSE 3
UYesu usifele,
Jesus died for us
Kuphel’ ityala lethu;
Our debt has been settled
Iz’ ithi ibe ngcwele,
Nemiphefumlo yethu.
Our souls have been sanctified

VERSE 4
Ukuze sakuhliwa,
Kukufa emhlabeni;
So that when death sweeps us from earth
Singabi nakwaliwa,
Ukuya ezulwini.
We may not be denied entry into heaven
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Hay inyhweba abanayo

lines.translation: O how blessed are the saints that are in heaven
Who are standing in front of the Heavenly Throne
It is a beautiful sight as angels surround them
Sweet is the melody they make as they praise God!
There they are in the middle
The ones whose clothes have been cleansed
Made white by the blood of the Lamb that was slain
As they lift their praises, they applaud that Lamb
They thank their God for all He had done for them
All charges have been withdrawn
All evil has been eradicated
There are no more anxieties, they neither thirst nor starve
They have attained eternal rest
They will forever rejoice
Tears have been wiped form their eyes
All the pain is gone
I wish I can be in their midst of those saints
And worship their King
The Lamb that died for them

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Hay’ inyhweba abanayo
Abangcwele baphezulu
O how blessed are the saints that are in heaven
Abemiyo phambi kwayo
Iterone yekomkhulu
Who are standing in front of the Heavenly Throne

VERSE 2
Sihle isihlwele sabo,
Iingelosi zibangqonga!
It is a beautiful sight as angels surround them
Iintle naloo ntsholo yabo
Bayenzayo bakubonga!
Sweet is the melody they make as they praise God!

VERSE 3
Naabo khon’ esazulwini,
There they are in the middle
Abangubo zahlanjwayo,
The ones whose clothes have been cleansed
Zeenzwa mhlophe egazini
Laloo Mvana yalophayo.
Made white by the blood of the Lamb that was slain

VERSE 4
Bathi ukubonga kwabo
Bayibong’ iMvana leyo,
As they lift their praises, they applaud that Lamb
Bambulel’ uThixo wabo
Konke abakwenzelweyo.
They thank their God for all He had done for them

VERSE 5
Kupheliswe lonk’ ityala,
All charges have been withdrawn
Kugqityelwe ubunqambi;
All evil has been eradicated
Akasekho namaxhala;
Abanxanwa, abalambi.
There are no more anxieties, they neither thirst nor starve

VERSE 6
Ukuphumla bakuphiwe,
They have attained eternal rest
Baya hlala bonwabile;
They will forever rejoice
Iinyembezi zisuliwe,
Tears have been wiped form their eyes
Zong’ iintlungu ziphelile.
All the pain is gone

VERSE 7
Ndinga nam ndingema nabo,
Aabo Bantu abangcwele;
I wish I can be in their midst of those saints
Ndidumis’ inKosi yabo,
And worship their King
Leyo Mvana ibafele.
The Lamb that died for them
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Zulu, khaya lami,Uthandiwe ndimi
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Zulu, khaya lami,Uthandiwe ndimi.
Zulu, khaya lami,Ulindiwe ndimi.
Zulu, khaya lami,Unqwenelwa ndimi,
Unobawo wami;UnenKosi yami.

VERSE 2
Zulu, khaya lami,Uthenjiwe ndimi,
Zulu, khaya lami,Unobomi bami.
Ndakubeka phantsi, Obubudlulayo,
Ndobamkela kuwe Obo buhlalayo.

VERSE 3
Zulu, khaya lami,Uthenjiwe ndimi,
Zulu, khaya lami,Unobomi bami.
Ndakubeka phantsi, Obubudlulayo,
Ndobamkela kuwe Obo buhlalayo.

VERSE 4
Unelifa lami,Elo lingafiyo;
Unelifa lamiLona lihleliyo.
Zulu, khaya lami,Uvuyelwe ndimi,
Unobuhle bami,Unophumlo lwami.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Jerusalem, ikhaya lam

lines.translation: Jerusalem, my beloved eternal home
When shall my labours have an end?
So I can come home to rest
When will my eyes behold
Those beautiful, pearly gates
And the streets of shining gold
Of the home of salvation?
The dwelling more beautiful than Eden
Nor sin nor sorrow know
And the beautiful, blest seats
I long for you
Why should I shrink at pain and death?
I have the eternal Canaan’s goodly land in view
And the glorious company of apostles
Stand around the Saviour
And soon my friends in Christ below, will join the glorious band
I long for you
New Jerusalem
Then shall my labours have an end
When I thy joys shall see

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Jerusalem, ikhaya lam,
Jerusalem, my beloved eternal home
Endilithandayo;
Wofezwa nin’ umzamo wam?,
When shall my labours have an end?
Ze ndiphumle kuwe
So I can come home to rest

VERSE 2
Obona nin’ amehlo am
When will my eyes behold
Loo masango mahle;
Those beautiful, pearly gates
Nezitrata zegolide,
And the streets of shining gold
Zomzi wosindiso?
Of the home of salvation?

VERSE 3
Umzi omhle kune Eden,
The dwelling more beautiful than Eden
Ongangenwa soono,
Nor sin nor sorrow know
Nezihlalo zawo zihle,
And the beautiful, blest seats
Ndikhumbula wona.
I long for you

VERSE 4
Zingandidakumbisa na
Iintlungu nokufa?
Why should I shrink at pain and death?
Sendiyibon’ iKanana,
Engunaphakade.
I have the eternal Canaan’s goodly land in view

VERSE 5
Namabandl’ abapostile
And the glorious company of apostles
Angqong’ uMsindisi;
Stand around the Saviour
Nabo bonk’ abakuKristu,
Baya kuya khona.
And soon my friends in Christ below, will join the glorious band

VERSE 6
Ndiya kulangazelela,
I long for you
Jerusalem entsha;
New Jerusalem
Imizamo yam yophela,
Then shall my labours have an end
Ndakufika kuwe.
When I thy joys shall see
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndinik amehlo ndikhangele

lines.translation: Give me the wings of faith to rise within the veil and see
So I can see the saints, rejoicing in the Lord
While they were on earth, they poured out tears
They wrestled hard with sin, and doubt, and fears
I see now they have overcome, I asked: “How?”
“It is through Him”, they answered “that died for us”,
They walked in His footsteps, His zeal was their reason for living
Having followed the incarnate God, they now possess the promised rest
Our glorious Leader claims our praise, for His own pattern given
Let there be no shortage of those who will follow Him

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndinik’ amehlo ndikhangele,
Phezulu ezulwini,
Give me the wings of faith to rise within the veil and see
Ndibone khona abangcwele,
Bevuya eNkosini.
So I can see the saints, rejoicing in the Lord

VERSE 2
Okuya babesemhlabeni,
Belila iinyembezi,
While they were on earth, they poured out tears
Babandezelwa zizilingo,
Umlingi engaphezi.
They wrestled hard with sin, and doubt, and fears

VERSE 3
Ndibona se bezoyisile,
Ndabuza: “Kungani na?”;
I see now they have overcome, I asked: “How?”
“Kungaye,” batsho, “obefile,
Owayefela thina.”
“It is through Him”, they answered “that died for us”,

VERSE 4
Babona inyathelo laKhe,
Libeka ebomini;
They walked in His footsteps, His zeal was their reason for living
Bahamba emkhondweni waKhe,
Baphumla ezulwini.
Having followed the incarnate God, they now possess the promised rest

VERSE 5
Ma kadunyiswe uMkhokheli,
Ngaloo mzekelo waKhe;
Our glorious Leader claims our praise, for His own pattern given
Kungasweleki umlandeli,
Wasemkhondweni waKhe.
Let there be no shortage of those who will follow Him
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndinga ngakhe ndisithele
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndinga ngakhe ndisithele,
Kwiimpazamo zonke;
Ndbe nemizuzu ndedwa,
Ekuthandazeni.

VERSE 2
Ndinga ngakhe ndiphalaze,
Le ntliziyo yami,
Ndililele ezi zoono,
Kowandifelayo.

VERSE 3
Ndinga ngakhe ndicamange,
Ngobubele baKhe;
Ndicele uxolelo,
Lo mphefumlo wami.”

VERSE 4
Ndinga nginganal’ iliso,
Lokubon’ ikhaya;
Ndomelezwe emandleni,
Kwimizamo yami.

VERSE 5
Ndinga lakutshon’ ilanga,
Lobu bomi bami;
Ndingamkelwa ngabangcwele,
BakwaThixo wami.
author: Traditional Methodist
