title: Yisabatha namhla, Nkosi

lines.translation: Today is the Sabbath day, Lord, Your Holy day
Your people are rejoicing today.
It is the day You walked out of Your tomb
You defeated Your own death
Through Your resurrection
You have risen, the Head of the Church
We’ll be raised as well, since we believe.
Multitudes must hear Your Word today
Be raised from death, and be with You today
We thank You Lord Jesus,
Right here, in Your house
We have everything
Through Your resurrection

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yisabatha namhla, Nkosi,
Iyimini yaKho;
Today is the Sabbath day, Lord, Your Holy day
Bayavuy’ abantu baKho,
Ngale mini yaKho.
Your people are rejoicing today.

VERSE 2
Wawuphuma namhla, Nkosi,
Enchwabeni laKho;
It is the day You walked out of Your tomb
Wakufis’ ukufa kwaKho,
You defeated Your own death
Ngokuvuka kwaKho.
Through Your resurrection

VERSE 3
Uvukile Wena, ntloko,
Yabo bakholwayo;
You have risen, the Head of the Church
Sakuvuka nathi ngoko,
Thina sikholwayo.
We’ll be raised as well, since we believe.

VERSE 4
Ma liviwe iZwi laKho
Ngabaninzi namhla;
Multitudes must hear Your Word today
Mabavuswe ekufeni,
Babe naWe namhla.
Be raised from death, and be with You today

VERSE 5
Sibulela Wena Yesu
We thank You Lord Jesus,
Kuyo lendlu yaKho;
Right here, in Your house
Sinezinto zonke thina;
We have everything
Ngokuvuka kwaKho.
Through Your resurrection
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bongani, bongani inKosi yezulu

lines.translation: Give thanks & praise to the God of the Heavens
For the day of worship has dawned on us
It is a God’s Day, a Great Day
The Greatest Day, consecration to the people
God created Heaven & earth
And He rested on this Day
It is the most blessed day
And it is a Holy day
Christ had His own Day
He rose from the dead and was seen by many
That is why it is chosen as a Holy Day
Instead of the one that was allotted before
Throughout the world today
God’s people are gathered
In One Spirit, God’s Spirit
Worshipping God, rejoicing indeed

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bongani, bongani inKosi yezulu,
Give thanks & praise to the God of the Heavens
Kunamhla sibon’ ukukhanya kweCawa.
For the day of worship has dawned on us
Yimini kaThixo, yimini enkulu,
It is a God’s Day, a Great Day
Yimini yeemini, licham ebantwini.
The Greatest Day, consecration to the people

VERSE 2
UThixo wadala izulu nomhlaba,
God created Heaven & earth
Wabuya waphumla ngemini yeCawa.
And He rested on this Day
Ithamsanqa laKhe labekwa ke kuyo,
It is the most blessed day
Kungoko loo mini kusithwa ingcwele.
And it is a Holy day

VERSE 3
Ukristu kanjalo, ngeyaKhe imini,
Christ had His own Day
Wavuk’ ekufeni, wabonwa ehleli.
He rose from the dead and was seen by many
Kungoko kumiswe le mini yenKosi,
That is why it is chosen as a Holy Day
Ndaweni yaleya yamiswa kuqala.
Instead of the one that was allotted before

VERSE 4
Ngemini engcwele kundawo ngeendawo
Throughout the world today
Abantu benKosi bahlanganisene,
God’s people are gathered
NgoMoya kaThixo, uMoya kabawo,
In One Spirit, God’s Spirit
Besenza inkonzo, bevuya kunene.
Worshipping God, rejoicing indeed
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Imini yeCawa ibuye yavela

lines.translation: Sunday is upon us again, the Day of Great Joy
The Day of gathering of the people of God.
It is the day the Gospel bell is sound, people be taught
It is the Day the Word of Life be preached
It is the Day to give thanks to the Creator
It is the Day God rested from creating heaven & earth
It is the Day the Saviour emerged out of His tomb
It is the Day God’s people get used to hearing the news of great Joy
It is the Day the believers yearn for heaven
Rejoice believers! Rejoice saints,
Give thanks to the King of Kings
The promise of the eternal home will be fulfilled
And you will rest in heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Imini yeCawa ibuye yavela,
Imini yomvuyo omkhulu;
Sunday is upon us again, the Day of Great Joy
Imini enkulu yentlanganisela,
Yabantu beNkosi yeZulu.
The Day of gathering of the people of God.

VERSE 2
Yimini intsimbi yobizo ibethwe,
Imini abantu bayalwe;
It is the day the Gospel bell is sound, people be taught
Yimini iLizwi lobomi lithethwe,
It is the Day the Word of Life be preached
Yimini kubongwe uMdali.
It is the Day to give thanks to the Creator

VERSE 3
Yimini yaphumla iNkosi yeZulu,
Kukwenza izulu nomhlaba;
It is the Day God rested from creating heaven & earth
Yimini wesuk’ uMkhululi omkhulu,
Waphuma kwelaKhe inchwaba.
It is the Day the Saviour emerged out of His tomb
.

VERSE 4
Yimini abantu beNkosi baqhele
Ukuva iindaba zovuyo;
It is the Day God’s people get used to hearing the news of great Joy
Yimini amakholwa alangazelele
Indawo asinga ngakuyo.
It is the Day the believers yearn for heaven

VERSE 5
Vuyani makholwa! Vuyani zingcwele
Rejoice believers! Rejoice saints,
Bongani iNkosi enkulu;
Give thanks to the King of Kings
Kofik’ ukufezwa kweendino ziphele;
The promise of the eternal home will be fulfilled
Niphumle kwanani phezulu.
And you will rest in heaven
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yiva, nKosi yeSabatha
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yiva, nKosi yeSabatha
Ngale mini yaKho;
Yiva ukucula kwethu,
Kuyo le ndlu yaKho.

VERSE 2
Sidumisa, sibulela,
Umsebenzi waKho;
Ufanele indumiso
Yabathengwa baKho.

VERSE 3
IiSabatha zangaphatsi,
Sisathanda zona;
Noko leyo yaphezulu,
Sinqwenela yona.

VERSE 4
Ngoko phulaphula, nKosi
Ukucela kwethu:
Uzilungisele yona
Iintliziyo zethu.

VERSE 5
Sibe ngabakukhonzayo
Apha emhlabeni;
Siphutum' uyolo lwayo,
Apho ezulwini.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yimini yeSabatha

lines.translation: It is the Sabbath Day, a Holy Day
I will also draw near to my God, and fall down before Him
It is the Sabbath Day, the Day of Ressurection
My Lord, who died for me, emerged out of the grave
It is the Sabbath Day, the Day of Fellowship
I’ll also join in, where I am, and experience the Devine joy
It is the Sabbath Day, the Day of Celebration
My tongue & my spirit will lift my praises
It is the Sabbath Day, even in Heaven
My spirit can hear the songs of Praise to the King
All Hail! King of the Sabbath
For as long as I live
It is my hope that I will also ascend and join the party

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yimini yeSabatha,
Yimini eyingcwele,
It is the Sabbath Day, a Holy Day
Ma ndithi nam
KuThixo wam
Ndiguqe, ndisondele.
I will also draw near to my God, and fall down before Him

VERSE 2
Yimini yeSabatha,
Yemvuko ekufeni;
It is the Sabbath Day, the Day of Ressurection
InKosi Yam,
UmFeli wam,
Waphuma enchwabeni.
My Lord, who died for me, emerged out of the grave

VERSE 3
Yimini yeSabatha
Ekuhlanganwa ngayo;
It is the Sabbath Day, the Day of Fellowship
Ndoba kho nam,
Kwindawo yam,
Ze ndiv'uyolo ngayo.
I’ll also join in, where I am, and experience the Devine joy

VERSE 4
Yimini yeSabatha
Yimini yemvuyiso;
It is the Sabbath Day, the Day of Celebration
Ngolwimi lwam,
Nomoya wam,
Ndoyenza indumiso.
My tongue & my spirit will lift my praises

VERSE 5
Yimini yeSabatha,
Naphaya ezulwini,
It is the Sabbath Day, even in Heaven
Ngomoya wam,
Ndiyeva nam,
Imvumo enKosini.
My spirit can hear the songs of Praise to the King

VERSE 6
A! Nkosi yeSabatha!
All Hail! King of the Sabbath
Ndisekho emhlabeni,
For as long as I live
Lithemba lam,
Ndonyuka nam,
Ndingen' endumisweni.
It is my hope that I will also ascend and join the party
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Umhla weSabatha, nKosi

lines.translation: We’ve lived to see another Sabbath day
We’ve come into Your Holy House, once again
Come be with us, let us feel Your presence
May our hearts accept Your Word
There are others who have been less fortunate
Some are sick, and are not here with us today.
Enthuse Your servants (Ministers, pastors, preachers)
So they may preach Your Word with boldness & conviction
Remove evil thoughts, lest they trouble us
And ungodly desires, in case they disturb us
Make us understand our needs
So we can make them known to You
Show us our sinfulness
And our waywardness.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Umhla weSabatha, nKosi,
Sibuye sawubona.
We’ve lived to see another Sabbath day
Indlu yaKho yobungcwele,
Sibuye sayingena.
We’ve come into Your Holy House, once again

VERSE 2
Ngena nokungena kwethu,
Sibuv’ ubukho baKho.
Come be with us, let us feel Your presence
Zithi, iintliziyo zethu
Zamkele izwi laKho.
May our hearts accept Your Word

VERSE 3
Bakho ongabanikanga
Le ntsikelelo yaKho;
There are others who have been less fortunate
Bakho abayimilwelwe
Abangekhoyo apha.
Some are sick, and are not here with us today.

VERSE 4
Bona izicaka zaKho
Uzikhuthaze zonke,
Enthuse Your servants (Ministers, pastors, preachers)
Zize ziwathethe namhla
Amazwi aKho onke.
So they may preach Your Word with boldness & conviction

VERSE 5
Gxoth’ ingcinga engendawo,
Ingasixakanisi;
Remove evil thoughts, lest they trouble us
Nenkumbulo engendawo
Ingasiphazamisi.
And ungodly desires, in case they disturb us

VERSE 6
Siqondis’ iintswelo zethu,
Make us understand our needs
Ukuze sizibike;
So we can make them known to You
Sibonis’ ukoona kwethu,
Show us our sinfulness
Nobutyhakala bethu.
And our waywardness.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Icawa iya phela,Umyali egqibela
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Icawa iya phela,Umyali egqibela,
Ma se silibulelaIzwi esilivile.
Lilizwi elikhulu,LenKosi yaphezulu.
Abangezizithulu, Boba bekholisile. I

VERSE 2
Umyali wasiyala;Ilizwi nge lihlala
Lingabi salityalwa,Ezintliz'yweni zethu.
Lilizwi lenkanyiso,Lilizwi loqondiso,
Lilizwi lemvuyiso, Kwimiphefumli yethu.

VERSE 3
IiCawa ziya dlula:Singe siphulaphula,
Simane sikhumbula,Izwi lasenKosini.
Ze sithi, xenikweni,Simkile emhlabeni,
Singene eCaweni,Phezulu ezulwini.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nkosi sihlangene

lines.translation: house
Lord We are gathered, in your
Come be with us as we enter into Your presence
Our hearts are yearning for You
Even our spirits, long for You
We desire to have communion with You
Your word is read, Be revealed to us

Make us righteous, sanctify us
When we pass on, accept us in heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nkosi sihlangene,
house
Kuyo indlu yaKho;
Lord We are gathered, in your
Yiza naWe, se singene,
Ebusweni baKho.
Come be with us as we enter into Your presence

VERSE 2
Iintliziyo zethu,
Ziya kugulela;
Our hearts are yearning for You
Kwa nemiphefumlo yethu
Iya kukhangela.
Even our spirits, long for You

VERSE 3
Ubuncoko baKho,
Bawo, masibuve;
We desire to have communion with You
Lakutyhilwa iZwi laKho,
Your word is read, Be revealed to us
NaWe masikuve.
As

VERSE 4
Ma usilungise,
Thina bantu baKho;
Make us righteous, sanctify us
Sakububa, singenise,
Ezulwini laKho.
When we pass on, accept us in heaven
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Sobeka phi na, Thixo
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Sobeka phi na, Thixo,
Singabeki kuWe?
Soncedwa ngubani na,
Singancedwa nguWe?
Wadala thina Bantu,
Weenza iinto zonke;
Umise nenkululo,
Sisindiswe sonke.

VERSE 2
Akukho ngxako kuWe,
Unamandla onke;
Akukho nkohla kuWe,
Unokwazi konke.
Silondoloze, Bawo,
Ngaloo mandla aKho;
Sikhanyisele, Bawo,
Ngoko kwazi kwaKho.

VERSE 3
Siphahle ngezibele
Kolu hambo lwethu;
Sisize endleleni
Ngokuswela kwethu.
Sixhase ekufeni,
Singahlehli kuWe,
Samkele ezulwini
Ngosimnikwe nguWe.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Thixo Ova izikhungo

lines.translation: God! Who hears requests
Who provides for His people
In the wilderness
You guided our forefathers
We bring our supplications
To you in prayer
We bring our requests to you
Please respond in our favour
God! Of our forefathers
Be the God of their children
Be our Father
Treat us as You treated them
When we go astray
Lead us into the right path
Give us food, give us water
Protect us, clothe us
Spread Your wings
To protect Your children
Until we come to You, Father
And be saved from the evil one

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thixo! Ova izikhungo,
God! Who hears requests
Obaxhas’ abantu baKho;
Who provides for His people
Othe Wena kulentlango
In the wilderness
Wakhokel’ oobawo bethu.
You guided our forefathers

VERSE 2
Naanga amadinga ethu,
We bring our supplications
Siwabeka phambi kwaKho;
To you in prayer
Naazi nezikhungo zethu,
We bring our requests to you
Siphe impendulo yaKho.
Please respond in our favour

VERSE 3
Thixo! Wab’ oobawo bethu,
God! Of our forefathers
Yiba ngowosapho lwabo;
Be the God of their children
Yiba nguy’ uBawo wethu,
Be our Father
Usiphathe kwa nje ngabo.
Treat us as You treated them

VERSE 4
Solahleka emhlabeni,
When we go astray
Sihambise endleleni;
Lead us into the right path
Usidlise, usiseze,
Give us food, give us water
Usigcine, usambese.
Protect us, clothe us

VERSE 5
Tweza amaphiko aKho,
Spread Your wings
Ulufihl’ usapho lwaKho;
To protect Your children
Side size kuWe, Bawo,
Until we come to You, Father
Sihlangulwe kongendawo.
And be saved from the evil one
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Nkosi, Mkhululi, namhla ndikhumbula

lines.translation: Lord, Saviour, today I remember the death You suffered because of me
Your blood was shed, that paid the price for my freedom
I am reminded as I see the bread, how Your body was broken because of me
And the wine reminds me, You paid the price for me.

lines.primary: Nkosi, ma ithi leyo nyama yaKho,

lines.translation: Lord, may Your flesh give me inner strength
And may Your blood, wash all my sins away

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nkosi, Mkhululi, namhla ndikhumbula,
Ukubulawa wakuvayo ngam;
Lord, Saviour, today I remember the death You suffered because of me
Laphalazwa elo gazi laKho,
Elalihlaw’layo ityala lam.
Your blood was shed, that paid the price for my freedom

VERSE 2
Ndiya khunjuzwa ndakubon’ isonka,
Umzimba waKho watyumzwa ngam;
I am reminded as I see the bread, how Your body was broken because of me
Ith’ iwayine indazise njalo;
Ukuhlaw’la kwaKho kungenxa yam.
And the wine reminds me, You paid the price for me.

VERSE 3
Nkosi, ma ithi leyo nyama yaKho,
Iwomeleze umphefumlo wam;
Lord, may Your flesh give me inner strength
Lithi kanjako kwa negazi laKho,
Lizihlambe zonke izoono zam.
And may Your blood, wash all my sins away
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndisondela ngentobeko

lines.translation: I draw near with reverence
For You have called me
To this somber service
And remember You
That body that was broken
Will provide for me
And that blood that was shed
Brings forgiveness
When I see the cross
On a hill far away
And see You sacrificed
I will remember You
All the pain You endured
And Your love
I will meditate on them day by day
And remember You
When I grow weary
And lose my speech
When You come in glory
Jesus, remember me

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndisondela ngentobeko,
I draw near with reverence
Ngokwelizwi laKho,
For You have called me
Kule nkonzo enozuko
To this somber service
Ndikhumbule weNa.
And remember You

VERSE 2
Lowo mzimb’ owaaphulwayo,
That body that was broken
Uya kundixhasa;
Will provide for me
Nelo gazi eloophayo,
And that blood that was shed
Londithethelela.
Brings forgiveness

VERSE 3
Ndakubona umnqamlezo
When I see the cross
Kuloo ndul’ ikude;
On a hill far away
Ndikubone ulidini,
And see You sacrificed
Ndokhumbula weNa.
I will remember You

VERSE 4
Ezo ntlungu zaKho zonke,
All the pain You endured
Nolo thando lwaKho;
And Your love
Ndozicinga ndisahleli,
I will meditate on them day by day
Ndikhumbule weNa.
And remember You

VERSE 5
Ndakuphelelwa ngamandla,
When I grow weary
Ndingabi sathetha;
And lose my speech
Wakufika ngobukhosi,
When You come in glory
Yesu ndikhumbule.
Jesus, remember me
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Uyindlela yenyaniso

lines.translation: You are the Way and the Truth
Son of God
You are my reason for living
You are my life
You graciously say:
“Come one, come all
I will give you a taste of my peace
I will give you a taste of my grace”
“Hurry up, a good life I offer
That you will enjoy through me
Here is the heavenly bread
Come eat with me”
“I am the bread of life
I am the water of life
All can eat and drink
And come to heaven with me”
Lord, cheer me on
Until I receive eternal life
And be able to praise You
With all of my heart

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Uyindlela yenyaniso,
You are the Way and the Truth
Nyana lo kaThixo wam;
Son of God
Ndimi ngaWe onk’ amaxa
You are my reason for living
Wena unobomi bam.
You are my life

VERSE 2
Uthi ngobubele baKho:
You graciously say:
“Sondelani nonke kuM;
“Come one, come all
Ndonivis’ olwam’ uxolo,
I will give you a taste of my peace
Ndonivis’ ufefe lwaM”.
I will give you a taste of my grace”

VERSE 3
“Khaw’lezani nab’ ubomi
“Hurry up, a good life I offer
Eniya kubudla ngaM;
That you will enjoy through me
Naas’ isonka esezulu,
Here is the heavenly bread
Sondelani nitye naM”.
Come eat with me”

VERSE 4
“Ndisisonka sokuphila,
“I am the bread of life
Ndingamanzi abubom;
I am the water of life
Ningasela nitye nonke,
All can eat and drink
Nize ezulwini kuM.”
And come to heaven with me”

VERSE 5
Nkosi, ndomeleze mina,
Lord, cheer me on
Ndize ndidl’ ubomi nam;
Until I receive eternal life
Ndibe nokukudumisa,
And be able to praise You
Ngayo intliziyo yam.
With all of my heart
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Wasizek isonka, Yesu

lines.translation: You took the bread, Jesus
You broke it, and said:
“Take it and it, all of you
It is My body”
You took the cup, Jesus,
You gave thanks, and said:
“It is the new covenant
It is My blood”
We take this bread, Jesus
We look up to You
We take it and eat it
We remember You
We take this cup
We trust only You
We drink from it, all of us
We remember You

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Wasizek’ isonka, Yesu,
You took the bread, Jesus
Wathi, usaphule:
You broke it, and said:
“Thabathani, nidle nonke,
“Take it and it, all of you
Singumzimba wami.”
It is My body”

VERSE 2
Wayizek’ indebe, Yesu,
You took the cup, Jesus,
Wathi, ubulele:
You gave thanks, and said:
“Ngumnqophiso omtsha yona,
“It is the new covenant
Egazini laMi.”
It is My blood”

VERSE 3
Sithabath’ isonka, Yesu,
We take this bread, Jesus
Sikhangele kuWe;
We look up to You
Sithabatha sidle sona,
We take it and eat it
Sikhumbule Wena.
We remember You

VERSE 4
Siya phatha nale ndebe,
We take this cup
Sithembele kuWe;
We trust only You
Siya sela kuyo sonke,
We drink from it, all of us
Sikhumbule Wena.
We remember You
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Kulapha nKosi ndikubonayo

lines.translation: Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to face
As I kneel at Your table
As I firmly grasp Your hand
All my weariness vanishes
It is where God feeds me
And I taste the Royal wine
And feel I have laid aside all my earthly load
And taste afresh the calm of sin forgiven
This meal has been prepared
For the communion of believers
Before the chance of dining with Him passes by
Too soon symbols disappear
But love remains
And Lord You are always here
The Sun and the Shield to me
You alone are my Helper
I am looking for no other
Your arm is able
To give me strength
Feasts come and go
Yet point to the feast above
When the saints will surround
The Lamb’s great bridal feast of bliss and love

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Kulapha nKosi ndikubonayo,
Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to face
Ndakuguq’ esithebeni saKho;
As I kneel at Your table
Ndakubambelela kuWe Yesu,
As I firmly grasp Your hand
Buphela bonk’ ubuthathaka bam.
All my weariness vanishes

VERSE 2
Kulaph’ uThixo andixhasayo,
It is where God feeds me
Ndiyinchaml’ indebe yakomkhulu;
And I taste the Royal wine
Ndive ndahlukene nemithwalo
And feel I have laid aside all my earthly load
Ndive ukuzola koxolelo.
And taste afresh the calm of sin forgiven

VERSE 3
Esi sidlo se silungiselwe
This meal has been prepared
Ubudlelane babakholwayo;
For the communion of believers
Ma ndisidle xa lingekapheli,
Ithuba lokudlelana naYe.
Before the chance of dining with Him passes by

VERSE 4
Zigqitha msinya izikhumbuzo,
Too soon symbols disappear
Kodw’ uthando lona lusahleli;
But love remains
NaWe nKosi woba uselapha
And Lord You are always here
Ulilanga kwa nekhakha lami.
The Sun and the Shield to me

VERSE 5
Nguwe kuuphela ongumncedi wam,
You alone are my Helper
Noko be ndingasafuni wumbi;
I am looking for no other
Ingalo yaKho iya kwanela,
Your arm is able
Ndomelele ndinawakh’ amandla.
To give me strength

VERSE 6
Ezi zidlo zibuya zidlule,
Feasts come and go
Kodwa zikhumbuz’ esaphezulu;
Yet point to the feast above
Xa abangcwele baya kungqonga
When the saints will surround
Isithebe sothando lweMvana.
The Lamb’s great bridal feast of bliss and love
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bawo, xa siphelelayo

lines.translation: Father, as we gather
Before You in prayer
All we are asking for
Is Your grace
This grace is joy
Everywhere we go
This grace is wealth
To us at all times
It is food when we are hungry
It is medicine when we are ill
It is strength for the journey
It is help when we fall
They have received the true blessing
All who have had a taste of Your grace
May they forever praise You

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bawo, xa siphelelayo
Father, as we gather
Ukuthetha phambi kwakho;
Before You in prayer
Into esiyifunayo
All we are asking for
KuWe, ilufefe lwaKho.
Is Your grace

VERSE 2
Olu fefe luluvuyo
This grace is joy
Kuthi eendaweni zonke;
Everywhere we go
Olufefe luyimfuyo
This grace is wealth
Kuthi ngamaxesha onke.
To us at all times

VERSE 3
Lukukutya sakulamba,
It is food when we are hungry
Luliyeza xa sifayo,
It is medicine when we are ill
Lungamendu sakuhamba
It is strength for the journey
Lulusizo xa siwayo.
It is help when we fall

VERSE 4
Banenyhweba yenyaniso,
They have received the true blessing
Abaluv’ ufefe lwaKho;
All who have had a taste of Your grace
Nge behlala ngendumiso
Futhi ebusweni baKho.
May they forever praise You
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Bona, Nkosi, ezi ntsana

lines.translation: Behold, Lord, the little children that are brought before You
Have mercy and bless them now
Take and receive them before this congregation
You have lent them to us for a little while
We are delighted by this amazing act of grace
Teach the parents the right path
To provide for their children and not deviate from it
Richly bless all children
So they be taught & raised according to the precepts of Your service

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bona, Nkosi, ezi ntsana
Eziziswe phambi kwaKho;
Behold, Lord, the little children that are brought before You
Uze uzithamsanqele
Ngoku, ngal’ ufefe lwaKho.
Have mercy and bless them now

VERSE 2
Zithabathe, uzamkele,
Phambi kwale ntlanganiso;
Take and receive them before this congregation
Ngala manzi, nale nkonzo,
Ma kufezw’ owakh’ ummiso.

VERSE 3
Wena usibolekile,
Okwexesha elithile;
You have lent them to us for a little while
Sivuyiswa kukubona,
Wonke lo msebenzi waKho.
We are delighted by this amazing act of grace

VERSE 4
Bafundise abazali
Indlela elungileyo
Teach the parents the right path
Yokuzondl’ iintsapho zabo,
Zize zikhuliswe ngayo.
To provide for their children and not deviate from it

VERSE 5
Sikelela zonk’ iintsapho,
Ngalo ithamsanqa laKho;
Richly bless all children
Zifundiswe, zikhuliswe,
Kuyo yonk’ inkonzo yaKho.
So they be taught & raised according to the precepts of Your service
author: this water and this service, Your sacrament must be kept

title: Thixo, ongaphezu konke

lines.translation: Lord, God Almighty, accept this little child
That has been brought before You by the parents
It is our desire that this child may always be in Your hands
Make him/her Your child, and be raised according to Your principles
Defeat his/her nature and plant Your own
Destroy sin and human nature by Your Spirit
We acknowledge Your parenthood through our service
We declare: “He/she is Your gift to us”
Richly bless him/her
Let him/her be baptised by Your grace

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thixo, ongaphezu konke,
Yamkel’ olu sana;
Lord, God Almighty, accept this little child
Oluziswe phambi kwaKho
Ngabazali balo.
That has been brought before You by the parents

VERSE 2
Singa olu sana, Nkosi,
Lungaphathwa nguWe;
It is our desire that this child may always be in Your hands
Uz’ ulwenze’ umntwana waKho,
Lukhulele kuWe.
Make him/her Your child, and be raised according to Your principles

VERSE 3
Ma woyis’ imvelo kulo,
Utyale eyaKho;
Defeat his/her nature and plant Your own
Kuf’ isoono kwa nobuntu,
Ngay’ uMoya waKho.
Destroy sin and human nature by Your Spirit

VERSE 4
Sivum’ ubuzali baKho
Ngale nkonzo yethu;
We acknowledge Your parenthood through our service
Oku sikuphiwe nguWe,
Sitsho, Bawo wethu.
We declare: “He/she is Your gift to us”

VERSE 5
Ma lusikelelwe ngoku,
Ngethamsanqa laKho;
Richly bless him/her
Ma luphehlelelwe ngoku,
Ngal’ ufefe lwaKho.
Let him/her be baptised by Your grace
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Olo kholo olukhulu

lines.translation: Give me the faith that can sink the mountain to a plain
The childlike, praying, hopeful love, to overpower my heart
Rekindle in me the burning desire to intercede for sinners
So I may warn them of danger and lead them to the Way of Salvation
They don’t know the Saviour, let me accept and sacrifice myself for them
To attempt and focus my energy on those in the darkness so they don’t die without a relationship with Christ
Father, take all my gifts and talents and use me
To spread Your Word, friend of the sinners, with the hope that they will repent and come to You
Enlarge, inflame and fill my heart with Your love, and love them with a zeal like Yours
And make salvation of all my priority, and lead as many as I can to Thy open side

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Olo kholo olukhulu,
Olususa kwa neentaba
Ma ndiphiwe, Thixo, lona.
Give me the faith that can sink the mountain to a plain
Olo thando lobuntwana
Lukhungayo, luthembayo,
Ma ndiluve nalo lona.
The childlike, praying, hopeful love, to overpower my heart

VERSE 2
Unqwenelo olushushu,
Lulilela bonk’ abooni,
Ma lube kho, lunditshise;
Rekindle in me the burning desire to intercede for sinners
Ndibanqande engozini,
Ndibabeke endleleni
Othi ngayo usindise.
So I may warn them of danger and lead them to the Way of Salvation

VERSE 3
Ma ndivume nakaloku,
Ndizincame ngenxa yabo
UmSindisi bengamazi.
They don’t know the Saviour, let me accept and sacrifice myself for them
Ndizamele, ndiphilele
Bonke abasemnyameni,
Bangabubi bengamazi.
To attempt and focus my energy on those in the darkness so they don’t die without a relationship with Christ

VERSE 4
Iitalente, neziphiwo,
Zonke, Bawo, endinazo,
Ma zisetyenziswe nguWe;
Father, take all my gifts and talents and use me
Ndihambise izwi laKhe
Ongumhlobo wabonayo,
Bade beze ngaye kuWe.
To spread Your Word, friend of the sinners, with the hope that they will repent and come to You

VERSE 5
Ma yandiswe intliziyo,
Izaliswe, ivuthiswe
Kubathanda kwa nje ngawe.
Enlarge, inflame and fill my heart with Your love, and love them with a zeal like Yours
Ndize ndiluzondelele
Usindiso lwabo bonke,
Ndibakhaphe babe naWe.
And make salvation of all my priority, and lead as many as I can to Thy open side
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Sebenzani ngenyameko

lines.translation: Go, labour on with diligence, and do God’s will
It is the way the Saviour went, you must follow suit
You do not labour in vain, your reward is devine
Even if you may not receive accolades, the Saviour will honour you
Work while it’s still daylight, fast falls the eventide
Opportunities pass by, to save the lost souls
Those in darkness, die in despair
Take up the torch and wave it wide all distressed sinners
Pray without ceasing
Be wise
Patiently, induce the wanderer to come in
Toil on, toil and rejoice
Always remember your reward
Soon you shall hear the voice of the master calling you to come home

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Sebenzani ngenyameko,
Nenze ekaThix’ intando;
Go, labour on with diligence, and do God’s will
Weenje njalo umSindisi,
Nani ma nifuze Yena.
It is the way the Saviour went, you must follow suit

VERSE 2
Anisebenzeli lize,
Nokuzuza okwezulu;
You do not labour in vain, your reward is devine
Noko ninganconywa apha,
UmSindisi wonincoma.
Even if you may not receive accolades, the Saviour will honour you

VERSE 3
Sebenzani kusemini,
Ubusuku bukufuphi;
Work while it’s still daylight, fast falls the eventide
Amathuba aya dlula,
Okunced’ imiphefumlo.
Opportunities pass by, to save the lost souls

VERSE 4
Abahleli emnyameni,
Bafa bengenal’ ithemba;
Those in darkness, die in despair
Thath’ umlilo ubaneke,
Kwezo mfama zilusizi.
Take up the torch and wave it wide all distressed sinners

VERSE 5
Thandazani ningatyhafi,
Pray without ceasing
Sebenzani ngobulumko;
Be wise
Niyiceng’ imiphefumlo,
Edingayo emangweni.
Patiently, induce the wanderer to come in

VERSE 6
Nyamekani ninovuyo,
Toil on, toil and rejoice
Nikhumbul’ umvuzo wenu;
Always remember your reward
Kovakala kamsinyane,
Izwi lokubizwa kwenu.
Soon you shall hear the voice of the master calling you to come home
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Thetha, Nkosi, ndilindele, Oko kuthethwayo kum.

lines.primary: Thetha, Nkosi, ndilindele, Oko kuthethwayo kum.
lines.translation: Master, speak, Your servant is waiting for Your gracious Word

lines.primary: Elo lizwi lenkuthazo, Ma livakaliswe kum.
lines.translation: Longing to hear Your voice that cheers me on
I am listening, my Lord, To what You have to say

lines.primary: Kuze ndibe nokuqonda, Lakubizw’ igama lam;
lines.translation: Speak to me by name, let me know it is to me
Speak that I may follow You, my Shepherd
As You lead me to the green pastures
Where I will find joy divine

lines.primary: Noko ndingento yalutho, Ma undive Nkosi yam;
lines.translation: Though I am the least, let me not depart unheard
You alone know the desires of my heart
You know everything I truly need
Let me be blessed indeed
Master, speak! Let me prepare myself
To proclaim with diligence, Your Good News
I am listening Lord, Master speak, O speak to me

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Master, speak, Thy servant heareth
Thetha, Nkosi, ndilindele, Oko kuthethwayo kum.
Master, speak, Your servant is waiting for Your gracious Word
Elo lizwi lenkuthazo, Ma livakaliswe kum.
Longing to hear Your voice that cheers me on
Ndimamele, Nkosi yam,
Theth’ ilizwi laKho kum.
I am listening, my Lord, To what You have to say

VERSE 2
Kuze ndibe nokuqonda, Lakubizw’ igama lam;
Speak to me by name, let me know it is to me
Ndibe nokukulandela Wen’ onguMalusi wam
Speak that I may follow You, my Shepherd
Kumadlelo amahle,
As You lead me to the green pastures
Apho ndonwaba khona.
Where I will find joy divine

VERSE 3
Noko ndingento yalutho, Ma undive Nkosi yam;
Though I am the least, let me not depart unheard
NguWe wedwa olwaziyo, Ulangazelelo lwam.
You alone know the desires of my heart
Uya zaz’ iintswelo zam
You know everything I truly need
Mandisikelelwe nam.
Let me be blessed indeed

VERSE 4
Thetha, ndiv’ iliZwi laKho, Ndizilungiselele
Master, speak! Let me prepare myself
Ukufeza ngenyameko Wonk’ umyalezo waKho.
To proclaim with diligence, Your Good News
Ndimamele, Nkosi yam,
Elo liZwi laKho kum.
I am listening Lord, Master speak, O speak to me
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Singabazalwana, singabazalwana

lines.translation: We are brothers & sisters in Christ
Family of the Highest God
Let us love each other, let us love each other
There is no jealousy in heaven
We help each other, we help each other
(We worship the Greatest God
Let us not be divided, let us not be divided
There is no division in heaven
We are one army, we are one army
Heroes of the Highest God
May we fight for Him with one heart
There is no cowardice in heaven
In heaven one day – with great joy
We will thank the King of Kings
It is through the strength that Christ gives us
That we will reach heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Singabazalwana, singabazalwana,
We are brothers & sisters in Christ
Lusapho lweNkosi enkulu;
Family of the Highest God
Singe sithandana, singe sithandana,
Let us love each other, let us love each other
Awukho umona phezulu.
There is no jealousy in heaven

VERSE 2
Singabancedani, singabancedani,
We help each other, we help each other
Bakhonzi beNkosi enkulu;
(We worship the Greatest God
Nge singahlukani, ngesingahlukani,
Let us not be divided, let us not be divided
Akwenjiwa njalo phezulu.
There is no division in heaven

VERSE 3
Sisemkhosini mnye, sisemkhosini mnye,
We are one army, we are one army
Makroti eNkosi enkulu;
Heroes of the Highest God
Singe siyilwela kwa ngantliziyo – nye,
May we fight for Him with one heart
Akukho bugwala phezulu.
There is no cowardice in heaven

VERSE 4
Ezulwini linye emvuyelelweni,
In heaven one day – with great joy
Sobong’ uKumkani omkhulu;
We will thank the King of Kings
Kungawo amandla avel’ eNkosini,
It is through the strength that Christ gives us
Esoda sifike phezulu.
That we will reach heaven
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Side sihlangane
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Side sibuye sihlangane,
Wang’uThixo angaanawe,
Akuxhas’ akukhokhele;
Wanga uThixo angaanawe.

VERSE 2
Side sibuye sihlangane,
Eenyaweni zikaYesu;
Side sibuye sihlangane,
Wanga uThixo angaanawe.

VERSE 3
Side sibuye sihlagane ,
Wang’ uThixo angaanawe.
Akudlise, akuseze;
Wanga uThixo angaanawe.

VERSE 4
Side sibuye sihlangane,
Eenyaweni zikaYesu;
Side sibuye sihlangane,
Wanga uThixo angaanawe.

VERSE 5
Side sibuye sihlangene,
Wang’uThixo angaanawe,
Kuzo zonk’ iingozi zakho;
Wanga uThixo angaanwe.

VERSE 6
Side sibuye sihlangene,
Eenyaweni zikaYesu;
Side sibuye sihlangene,
Wanga uThixo angaanawe.

VERSE 7
Side sibuye sihlangane,
Wang’ uThixo angaanawe;
Akwambes’ uthando lwaKhe;
Wanga uThixo angaanawe .

VERSE 8
Side sibuye sihlangene,
Eenyaweni zikaYesu;
Side sibuye sihlangene,
Wanga uThixo angaanawe.
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ndisondela kuWe, Thixo wami

lines.translation: I draw nearer to You my God, as my time on earth comes to an end
Death is creeping in, I’m heading to my eternal home, to be with You my God
Stretch Your hand out to me, to journey through this bumpy road and reach my destination
Christ, the Way, the Truth, You are my Light, I trust only You, lead me
I’ll lose my way without You, I’ll get hurt if You are not with me
Through this dark forest and deep waters, journey with me, my Saviour

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ndisondela kuWe, Thixo wami.
Kuphel' ixesha lam Emhlabeni;
I draw nearer to You my God, as my time on earth comes to an end
Kusondel' ukufa, Ndiz' ephakadeni,
Ndibe phambi kwaKho, Thixo wami.
Death is creeping in, I’m heading to my eternal home, to be with You my God

VERSE 2
Ndolulel' isandla, Ndithantase,
Kubugaxa-gaxa Bale ndlela.
Stretch Your hand out to me, to journey through this bumpy road and reach my destination
Kristu Ndlela, Nene, Lukhanyiso Iwami,
Se ndithembe Wena; Ndikhokele.
Christ, the Way, the Truth, You are my Light, I trust only You, lead me

VERSE 3
Ndiya kulahleka, Ndingenawe;
Ndiya kwenzakala, X'ungekhoyo;
I’ll lose my way without You, I’ll get hurt if You are not with me
Kuyo le ntsunguzi, Nakumlamb' omnyama,
Ma ndikhatshwe nguWe, Msindisi wam.
Through this dark forest and deep waters, journey with me, my Saviour
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ngelo xa lokushiywa

lines.translation: At the dark hour, when we have lost loved ones
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Son of God, hear us!
When in despair, relatives having passed on
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Son of God, hear us!
When we bow our heads and feel the grief’s weight
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Son of God, hear us!
When we suffer, …
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Son of God, hear us!
When challenged by conscience, because we have sinned against You
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Son of God, hear us!
You also felt the pain of losing a loved one, and You wept
We’ll trust only You Lord
Son of God, hear us!

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ngelo xa lokushiywa,
Ngaabo sibathandayo;
At the dark hour, when we have lost loved ones
Sokhala kuWe Nkosi,
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Nyana kaThixo sive!
Son of God, hear us!

VERSE 2
Lakusishiy’ ithemba,
Kugqithe nezihlobo;
When in despair, relatives having passed on
Sokhala kuWe Nkosi,
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Nyana kaThixo sive!
Son of God, hear us!

VERSE 3
Sakuthoba intloko,
Lusisinde usizi;
When we bow our heads and feel the grief’s weight
Sokhala kuWe Nkosi,
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Nyana kaThixo sive!
Son of God, hear us!

VERSE 4
Sakuva kabuhlungu,
Imfesane isika;
When we suffer, …
Sokhala kuWe Nkosi,
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Nyana kaThixo sive!
Son of God, hear us!

VERSE 5
Sakuvuk’ isazela,
Ngokuba sikonile;
When challenged by conscience, because we have sinned against You
Sokhala kuWe Nkosi,
With tears, we’ll turn to You Lord
Nyana kaThixo sive!
Son of God, hear us!

VERSE 6
Uluvile usizi,
Walila iinyembezi;
You also felt the pain of losing a loved one, and You wept
Sothemba Wena Nkosi,
We’ll trust only You Lord
Nyana kaThixo sive!
Son of God, hear us!
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Uyeza! Uyeza! uMgwebi omkhulu

lines.translation: The Great Judge is coming
All people will see the Mighty King
The dead will rise from the graves
And be will be seen in Glory above
All visible things will be burned
The hills and mountains will be melted
The sun won’t shine, the moon will be no more
Sinners won’t be able to hide
The Judge will come with a Mighty Army
The Army of His Heavenly messengers
The Judge will see with His own eyes
Every secret, every evil thought
Sinners will be extremely anxious
They will shiver in His presence
The unrighteous will be destroyed
In the furnace of hell
Repent, fear God and seek righteousness
Listen to the Word of God and plead
Supplicate and seek His mercy
Now is the time, come, He will accept You

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Uyeza! Uyeza! uMgwebi omkhulu,
The Great Judge is coming
Abantu bobona iNkosi yezulu;
All people will see the Mighty King
Babeya kuvuswa kwa semanchwabeni,
The dead will rise from the graves
Babonakaliswe kwa sekukhanyeni.
And be will be seen in Glory above

VERSE 2
Izinto esizibonayo zotshiswa,
All visible things will be burned
Amawa neentaba zonyibilikiswa,
The hills and mountains will be melted
Ilanga locinywa, inyanga yophela,
The sun won’t shine, the moon will be no more
Abooni abakuba nakuzimela.
Sinners won’t be able to hide

VERSE 3
UMgwebi wofika nomkhosi omkhulu,
The Judge will come with a Mighty Army
Umkhosi wezaKh’ izithunywa zezulu;
The Army of His Heavenly messengers
Amehlo oMgwebi omkhulu obona,
The Judge will see with His own eyes
Izinto zasese, izinto zokoona.
Every secret, every evil thought

VERSE 4
Abooni boba nelikhulu ivuso,
Sinners will be extremely anxious
Bongcangcazelela obaKhe ubuso;
They will shiver in His presence
Abangalungile botshatyalaliswa,
The unrighteous will be destroyed
Kwa sesihogweni somlilo botshiswa.
In the furnace of hell

VERSE 5
Yekani izoono, noyike, nilunge,
Repent, fear God and seek righteousness
Liveni ilizwi leNkosi, nikhunge;
Listen to the Word of God and plead
Zithandazeleni, nifun’izibele,
Supplicate and seek His mercy
Lixesha kaloku, yizan’ anamkele.
Now is the time, come, He will accept You
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Namhla ndivuyile mina

lines.translation: Today, I full of joy, I have been blessed
My peers, rejoice with me
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations
I enjoy attending my classes/lectures
When I enter into the sanctuary, my soul is filled with joy
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations
Back in the villages and homesteads, many folk are illiterate
Our forebears have not experienced this joy
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations
May I always give You thanks for this blessing
Until my time on earth is done
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Namhla ndivuyile mina,
Ngalo ithamsanqa lam;
Today, I full of joy, I have been blessed
Balingane, nithi ni na?
Ma nise nivuya nam.
My peers, rejoice with me

VERSE 2
Nkosi ndiyakudumisa,
Ngokuba undifundisa;
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
Ndaye ndiya kuzoyisa,
Zonke ezi ncwadi zam.
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations

VERSE 3
Xa ndihleli eskolweni
Kuba mnandi futhi kum;
I enjoy attending my classes/lectures
Xa ndingena etyalikeni,
Ovuyayo oko ndim.
When I enter into the sanctuary, my soul is filled with joy

VERSE 4
Nkosi ndiyakudumisa,
Ngokuba undifundisa;
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
Ndaye ndiya kuzoyisa,
Zonke ezi ncwadi zam.
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations

VERSE 5
Kwelaa lizwe lakowethu,
Ezi ncwadi asizazi;
Back in the villages and homesteads, many folk are illiterate
Bahlel’ obawo bethu,
Olu vuyo bengalwazi.
Our forebears have not experienced this joy

VERSE 6
Nkosi ndiyakudumisa,
Ngokuba undifundisa;
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
Ndaye ndiya kuzoyisa,
Zonke ezi ncwadi zam.
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations

VERSE 7
Mandihlale ndibulela,
Ngalo ithamsanqa lam;
May I always give You thanks for this blessing
Kude kube kukuphela,
Kokuhlala apha kwam.
Until my time on earth is done

VERSE 8
Nkosi ndiyakudumisa,
Ngokuba undifundisa;
Lord, I praise You, for You help me study
Ndaye ndiya kuzoyisa,
Zonke ezi ncwadi zam.
And I am confident I will overcome all my examinations
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Yesu! Mhlobo wabantwana

lines.translation: Jesus, Friend of little children, I come to You, You are my only hope
Take my hand, lead me on, take me home
Lest I lose my way
And the devil ambush me, and make me his victim
I am encouraged, throughout my journey
My fears vanish
For You humbled Yourself, and became flesh just like me
You bore our sins, even though You were not a sinner like me
Jesus, Most Humble One
Prepare my heart for heaven
Cleanse all my sins
May I resemble You
In my worldly & finite wisdom
So I can receive the strength to worship You my Lord

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Yesu! Mhlobo wabantwana,
Ndiza kuWe themba lam;
Jesus, Friend of little children, I come to You, You are my only hope
Naas’isandla ndikhokele,
Ndise ekhayeni lam.
Take my hand, lead me on, take me home

VERSE 2
Hleze ndilahleke mpela,
Kuyo yonk’indlela yam;
Lest I lose my way
Andibaqe usathana,
Andenze ixhoba nam.
And the devil ambush me, and make me his victim

VERSE 3
Ndikhuthazwa kukubona
Kuyo yonk’indlela yam;
I am encouraged, throughout my journey
Amanyathel’aKho khona,
Kumke ukoyika kwam.
My fears vanish

VERSE 4
Kanti nawe wazithoba,
Waayinyama kwa nje ngam;
For You humbled Yourself, and became flesh just like me
Wazithwala zonk’iintsizi,
Ungemon’ofana nam.
You bore our sins, even though You were not a sinner like me

VERSE 5
Yesu! Lulam’elikhulu,
Jesus, Most Humble One
Yenza lentliziyo yam;
Ilifanele izulu,
Prepare my heart for heaven
Ngokuhlamb’izoono zam.
Cleanse all my sins

VERSE 6
Ndinga ndingafuza Wena
May I resemble You
Kubo ubulumko bam,
In my worldly & finite wisdom
Ndize ndiwazuz’amandla
Okukhonz’iNkosi yam.
So I can receive the strength to worship You my Lord
author: the sight of Your footsteps next to mine

title: Hlala nami! Litshonil ilanga

lines.translation: Abide with me, fast fall the eventide
The shadows of the evening fall
My desire is that I be not left alone
Grant me special favour Lord, abide with me
Swiftly, my earthly days fade away
Worldly pleasures are too fat for me
I see change everywhere
You, O Lord, who never changes, abide with me
Be always nearby
Drive all my enemies away
You are the only One that can protect me
In the midst of darkness; abide with me
I have no reason to worry when You are around
Pain and sorrow will not dishearten me
Where is Your victory, o grave?
I will overcome if You abide with me
Reveal Thyself before my closing eyes,
Shine through the darkness, and show me the way
Even on my deathbed, abide with me

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Hlala nami! Litshonil’ ilanga,
Abide with me, fast fall the eventide
Ubusuku bufikile, Nkosi;
The shadows of the evening fall
Ma ndingasali ndingenamncedi,
My desire is that I be not left alone
Ndenzel’ uncedo ngokuhlala nam.
Grant me special favour Lord, abide with me

VERSE 2
Buya khaw’leza obu bomi bam,
Swiftly, my earthly days fade away
Ndiya shiywa zezomhlab’ izinto;
Worldly pleasures are too fat for me
Ndibona iinguquleko zodwa,
I see change everywhere
Wen’ ongaguqukiyo: Hlala nam.
You, O Lord, who never changes, abide with me

VERSE 3
Yiba soloko ukufuphi nam,
Be always nearby
Undigxothele zonk’ iintshaba zam;
Drive all my enemies away
NguWe Nkosi onokundigcina,
You are the only One that can protect me
Phakathi kwentsunguzi: Hlala nam.
In the midst of darkness; abide with me

VERSE 4
Andinaxhala kukho Wena,
I have no reason to worry when You are around
Iintlungu neentsizi azinani;
Pain and sorrow will not dishearten me
Luphi uloyiso lwakho nchwaba?
Where is Your victory, o grave?
Ndiya koyisa xa uhleli nam.
I will overcome if You abide with me

VERSE 5
Zibonakalis’ emehlweni am,
Reveal Thyself before my closing eyes,
Uz’ undikhombise okwezulu;
Ndikhanyisele yonk’ indlela yam,
Shine through the darkness, and show me the way
Nasekufeni kwam uz’ ube nam.
Even on my deathbed, abide with me
author: Traditional Methodist

title: Ma kwenzwe indumiso

lines.translation: Glory be to
God the Father
God the Son
God the Holy Spirit
As it was in the beginning
Let it be so now
And in times to come
Until eternity

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ma kwenzwe indumiso
Glory be to
KuThixo onguYise,
God the Father
KuThixo onguNyana,
God the Son
KuThixo onguMoya;
God the Holy Spirit

VERSE 2
Njengoko kwakunjalo,
As it was in the beginning
Ma kube njalo ngoku,
Let it be so now
Nangamaxesh’ ezayo,
And in times to come
Kungabi nakuphela.
Until eternity
author: Traditional Methodist
